text.remarks:
(Nâgari characters).

Obeisauce to Gaṇâdhipati. Invocation of the Boar.

Victorious in the world, daily victor over his enemies, (with other praises), is the king Harihara,
king Bukka's son, who again established the kingdom acquired by his father.

Channapa, the son of Mallapa, wresting from the hands of the Yavanas the territory they had
seized, presented it as tribute to king Harihara, and gave land at the Kalyâṇa hill to Bhûshaṇa·
dîkshita, or Vidyâbhûshaṇa-dikshita, who named it, Vidyâranyapura.¹

Be it well. (On the date specified), when the mahâ-maṇḍalêśvara, râjâdhirâja râja-paramêś-
vara, master of the eastern western and southern oceans, champion over kings who break their word,

1 So far is in Sanskrit, the rest in Kannada.

Kunigal Taluq
viṟa-Harihara-Râya was ruling a secure kingdom :-his younger brother, vîra-Mallappa-Odeyar's son,
when the Turahkas were swarming over Âdavanî durga and kingdom, conquered those Turahkas,
took possession of the durga (or hill-fort) and kingdom, gave them to Harihara-Râya, received a
kingdom of his own, and was at peace ;-when Sigemâvinahalli in the Hêrâr-sthala in his kingdom,
was granted to (with praises of his learning) Vêdamûrti-upâdhyâ's son Vidyâbhûshana-dikshita, by
vîra-Channappa-Odeyar, to ensure his own happiness, as an agrahâra in sole enjoyment, with all
rights, and he caused this copper śâsana of the same to be written. (signed)—śrî-Triyambaka.
(Vidyâbhûshana seems to have divided the village into 15 shares, which he gave to variou¹
Brahmans. The particulars of this are missing). Then come the boundaries of Vidyâranyapura,
and names of Brahmans who received the 15 shares. Imprecations.
Harihara-Râya's sign manual,—śrî-Virûpâksha.

1. So far is in Sanskrit, the rest in Kannada.

cells.remarks: Offering¹ of the devotion of Gangamma, wife of the silk dealer Vîra-S'ettappa, son of Chenna- Basappa of Kunigal, at the feet of the god Siddalingêśvara of Kaggere, (on the date specified,-by the Christian era). To describe the eminence of that great Siddêśvara :—he who has sachidânanda (existence, with reflection and joy) and is ever completely contented, is a primeval bhakta (or faithful one). cells.remarks: (Nâgari characters) Obeisanee to Gaṇêśa. Praise of S'ambhu, the Boar, and Gaṇêśa. Usual account of the descent of Yayâti from the Moon, From him, by Dêvayâni, was born Turvasu. In that race arose Timma-bhûpati, whose wife was Dêvakî. He was as renowned among the Tuluva kings as Krishna was in his line. From him sprang Īsvara, whose wife was Bukkamâ. From Dêvakî's son was Narasa, like Dêvakî's son (Krishna). Quickly damming the Kâvêri when in full flood, he crossed over, and seizing the enemy alive, took possession of his kingdom, and making S'rîrangapaṭṭaṇa his own, dwelt there, set up the pillar of his fame, and was lauded by the learned in the three worlds. Having conquered Chêra, Chôla, and Pândya, together with the lord of Madhurâ, whose honour was his ornament, the fierce Turushka, the Gajapati king and others,—he imposed his commands on the heads of all the famous kings from the banks of the Ganges to Lankâ (Ceylon), and from the eastern to the western mountains. (Omitting laudations) From Tippâji and Nâgalâ-Dêvi were born to him Nṛisimha and Achyutêndra. (On the date specified¹) the king Achyutêndra gave to a Brahman, (who among other things is said to be a Hoysaṇiya), a Vaishṇava from the beginning, (named) Pâṇḍuraṅga (descent &c. stated), 10 shares, and other shares to 8 others (named, of whom 3 were Hoysaṇiyas, 2 Kannadi- yas, 1 a Kamme, 1 a Baḍaganâḍika, and 1 a Mulikinâḍiya), making altogether 18 shares, at Trelîṅganapâlaka, otherwise named Srinivasapuri, to the south of the Bhairava hill, which was to the east of Nalinâvati-nagara, where he was living. Boundaries, among which on its south-east is mentioned the great Bauddha town named Kalavati.—The grant is made with all usual rights. Usual final verses. (signed)—śrî-Virûpâksha.

text.location: *At Turuvēkere (Turuvekere hobli), on copper plates in possession of Vithalayya.*
text.remarks:
(Nâgari characters)

Obeisanee to Gaṇêśa. Praise of S'ambhu, the Boar, and Gaṇêśa.

Usual account of the descent of Yayâti from the Moon, From him, by Dêvayâni, was born
Turvasu. In that race arose Timma-bhûpati, whose wife was Dêvakî. He was as renowned among
the Tuluva kings as Krishna was in his line. From him sprang Īsvara, whose wife was Bukkamâ.
From Dêvakî's son was Narasa, like Dêvakî's son (Krishna). Quickly damming the Kâvêri
when in full flood, he crossed over, and seizing the enemy alive, took possession of his kingdom, and
making S'rîrangapaṭṭaṇa his own, dwelt there, set up the pillar of his fame, and was lauded
by the learned in the three worlds. Having conquered Chêra, Chôla, and Pândya, together with
the lord of Madhurâ, whose honour was his ornament, the fierce Turushka, the Gajapati king and
others,—he imposed his commands on the heads of all the famous kings from the banks of the
Ganges to Lankâ (Ceylon), and from the eastern to the western mountains. (Omitting laudations)
From Tippâji and Nâgalâ-Dêvi were born to him Nṛisimha and Achyutêndra.

(On the date specified¹) the king Achyutêndra gave to a Brahman, (who among other things
is said to be a Hoysaṇiya), a Vaishṇava from the beginning, (named) Pâṇḍuraṅga (descent
&c. stated), 10 shares, and other shares to 8 others (named, of whom 3 were Hoysaṇiyas, 2 Kannadi-
yas, 1 a Kamme, 1 a Baḍaganâḍika, and 1 a Mulikinâḍiya), making altogether 18 shares, at
Trelîṅganapâlaka, otherwise named Srinivasapuri, to the south of the Bhairava hill, which was to
the east of Nalinâvati-nagara, where he was living.

Boundaries, among which on its south-east is mentioned the great Bauddha town named
Kalavati.—The grant is made with all usual rights.

Usual final verses.
(signed)—śrî-Virûpâksha.

^20ತಾತಪ್ಯಾ*ಯುವನಹವ್ಯಾಪ್ಮಿಕೋ^22ಸ್ನವಸುಭಿ*ಯುಯುದ್ಧೇ^23ಯಮಾಯಾತೃಪ್ರೈ^24ಶಾಸನಾ^ತೆ*ಜ್ಯುತ್ಯುತುತ್ವರ್ಗಸurನಿವಸತಿಸೇ^27ದೇ*ವಮಾಯಾಸೀಪತ್ರ್ತೀ || ತದ್ವಂಶೇದೇವ*೨೬ಕೀಜನಸೀದಿ^29ದಿನಸೀತಿಂಮುಖಪ^25ತಿಃ || ಯದುಸ್ತ್ರೀಣುತುಲುವೇಂದ್ರೇಷು^26ಯುದಥಾಕ್ಷ್ಮ ^27ಇವಾನ್ವಯೇ | ತತೋ^^27ಭೂದ್ವೈಶ್ಯಮಾಜೂನಿರೇಶ್ವರಪ್ರತಿ*ಜರಾಳಾಕಃ | ತತ್ತ್ರಾ^29ಸಮಾಗೂಣ^30ಬಾ*ಜನ್ನಾ^31ಲೀದತ್ಯಮಹಿಭುಜಾಂ || ಸ^30ರಸಾದಮುದ್ಭೂತಸ್ಮ್ಯಾನರೇನಾ*ನಿಪ್ಪಾಪಾಲಕಃ | ದೇವಕೀನಂದ೨ ನೇ ಹಲಿಗೆ ಮುಂಭಾಗ^32ಸೋನೇಣಮಾದೇವೇಕೀನದನಾದಿ*ವ | ವಿವಿಧಸ್ವ್ಯಕ್ಕೃತೋದ್ದಾಮ^^34ಸರ್ವಮಂಗಳಕಾರಕಃ | ಕಾ*ಪೇರೇಮಾಶುಬದದ್ವಾಪಹಲಜಲ*ಮೂಯಾತಾಅಂವಿಲಂವ್ಯಾಧುತ್ರಜಂ^ಜೇ*ಪ್ವಗ್ರಾಹ ಸಂಗ^38ಹೀತ್ಯಸ್ಮಿತಿಭುಜಬ*38ಲಾತ^39ಸ್ವರಾಜ್ಯಂತದೀಯೇ^41 | ಕೃ*40ತ್ವಾಶ್ರೀ ರಂಗಪ್ರಿಂವಂತದಸಿ ನಿಜವರಂ*40ಪದ್ಮಣ್ಮೋದ್ಭವವ್ಯಾತ್ರೈ ^41ತ್ಸೀತಿ^*ಉತ್ಪಂಭಂನಿಬಾಯತ್ಥಿ ಭುವನವಿಬುಧ*42ಸೂ^43ರ್ಯಮುಮನೋರವಾಸನ್ಯಾಃ | ಜೇಲಂಜೋ^*44ಲಂಡಪಂಡ್ಯೊಂತಮಪಿಜಮಥುರಾವ*45ಭ್ರಂಭವಾಮಭೂಷಂ | ವೀಯೋರಾ^46ದೃಶ್ರಂತು*^46ರುಖ್ಯಂಗಜಪತ್ಯಾಪಟೊಂಬಾಪಿಜಿ*^47ತ್ವಾತದ್ವಾನ್ಯಾಕ್ | ಲಂಗೋಗಾಜಿ*^47ಂಕಪ ^48ಪ್ರಮಾಚತರಮಭುತ ^49ತಾಂಅಂ೨ ನೇ ಹಲಿಗೆ ಹಿಂಭಾಗ^50ನಿರಾಂತಕಂ | ಜನ್ಮಾತಕೋಳೋಪತೀನಾನಂತಿಪಟೂರು ತಾಲೂಕು	11549 ಸೃಜಮಿನಶಿರವಾಸಸ್ಥಾನಸಂಯೋಜ್ಯಂ50 ತಾನೀತ್ | ತಿಪ್ಪಾಟೇಣಾಗಾರದೇವೇತ್ಯುಕೌ51 ಸುಲಕ್ಷ್ಮೀ ಸ್ರುಸಮಿತ್ರಯೋರ್ದೇವೇವ್ಯಾ52 ಸ್ಯಸಿಂಹೇಂದ್ರಾಸ್ತ್ರಸತ್ಯಾಸ್ತಬ್ರಥಾ53 ಧಿವಾ | ಜಾತೋವೀರನ್ಯಸಿಂಹೇಂದ್ರಾಜಾ54 ತ್ಸೋತ್ರೇಂದ್ರೋನಸಿಹಪತೀ | ಶಕಾವ55 ಬ್ದಾಧೀಶಾಲೀವಾಹನಾಖ್ಯಾವತ್ಸರೇಣೇಯುತ56 ಶತಶಂದತಹಪಷ್ಟುಕೈ | ರಂಜೇವಸ57 ಹಸ್ಮಗಣಿತಕೃಮಾವತ್ | ನಂದನೇಮ58 ತೃಸ್ವರೇಲಕ್ಷ್ಮೀವಮಾಸೇತುಪೌರ್ಣಿಮಾ59 | ಉಪರಾಗಾಯುತೇಷುಣ್ಯೇಕಾಲೆಶು60 ಅಭಿಡೀತ್ಯು ಗೌತಂಗಭದಾ ಪ್ರಸಿದೀತಿರೇ61 ೨ನಿರೂಪಾಕ್ಷ್ಮಸ್ತಸುನಿಧಾಸುಪ62 ಸನೋಮಾಹೇಶ್ಯಾದಾರೇಅಜ್ಯತೇಂದ್ರ)63 ಸ್ಯಮಹೀಪತೇಃ । ವಂಶಿಪ್ರೋಬಸಿಹಪ್ರೋ64 ವಿದ್ಯಾಮಾನಹಲಯಾನಸೂತಃಸಹೋಯಿ೩ ನೇ ಹಲಗೆ ಮುಖಭಾಗ65 ಸುಸ್ಥೇಯೇಯಿತಿವ್ಯಾತ್ವಾಸ್ತಂಥತೋ| ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮದಿವ್ಯ66 ಷ್ಟುಮಗುರು ವಂಶೋದ್ಭವ ವೇದೀಧರಾವೇದವೇದಾ67 ಂಗವಿಚಾರಣಶಾ | ತೇಸನ್ಯತೀಜಬಲೀಜೇಯೆನ68 ತಪ್ರವಿನೇಶಾಸ್ತ | ಜ್ಕೋನಿದಾ | ನ್ಯಸಿಂಹ69 ರಾಜಸತನಯಃಪಂಡಿತರಂಗಚಾರ್ಯಣೇಮಣಿಃ70 ಹರಿದಾಸಸಧರೀಣೋಸಾಬ್‌ಕ್ಯಾತೋಭುವಿಮ71 ಹೀಸುರತನ್ಯೇಕ್ಷ್ಮೀಸತ್ಯಾ ಮಹಾರಾಜೋಜವೃ72 ತ್ತಿ ೨ನಂದಕರಕಂದಪಾ || ಯೋರಾಜಪೋಹ್ವೇತ್ಯ73 ಸನೀಕ್ಷ್ಮೃ ದ್ಯವಸೂತ್ರೇ ಭೋದೋಯಾನರೇತರತಿರು74 ಮಲಾರಾಯಾಭಿಧಾನಸ್ಯತನಯೋಹರಿಯು75 ಸ್ಯಸುಸ್ತಿಥೀತಪ್ಪುರೌಹೇರಾಯಣೀ ಶ್ರೇತಿ76 ಖ್ಯ್ಯಾತೋದ್ವಿಜವರಾಗಣೇಣೇಃ | ತಸ್ಮಾನೇ77 ತ್ರೈ ನಯತ್ಪೂರ್ಣಾಕ ತಿರುಮಲಾರಾಚಾರ್ಯತೃ78 ಣ್ಮಿತಃ | ತಸ್ಮೈಪ್ರದಾವಮಹಾಭಾಗೋಗೈವತ್ರಿಮೇ79 ಕಾಂತಮಹೀಪತೇಃ । ವೇಷ್ಟನ್ಪೋತ್ರಜಟೋ80 ಂಧ್ರೀವಣಾರುಕಬ್ಬಿವಿನಾಯನಸ್ಥಿಕಂಕಮ್ಯ81 ಮೈದೋಳೇವಿಖ್ಯಾತೋಮಾವಶ್ಯಲಾಯನಸೂತಃ |82 ೩ವಿತ್ | ಜೇಕಾಯಾರ್ಹಪತ್ಸುತಕೃಷ್ಣನಾಮಾ83 ಪುತ್ರೋ ಭವತ್ಕಸ್ಮಜಚಿಕಣಾಂಬ್ಯು ತಸ್ಯೈ84 ಧದವಾವತ್ಸಭೂಮಿನಿವಾಲೋರ್ಮವೃತ್ತಿಮನುರ್ಜ್ಞಾಂತಿಪಚೂರು ತಾಲೂಕು120ದಕ್ಷ್ಳಿಣಾಶಾಲಯನಸೂತ್ರವಿತನಾರಾಯಣ121 . ತೋಣೀಮೂನ್ನಾಭುಭಟ್ಟೋಪಾಧ್ಯಾಯಗೌರೀ122 ನಾರಾಯಣಶಾಭದೋತ್ನಪಾಜ್ಯಜ್ಯೋತ್ಪಿದ್ದಿವರೀಃ123 ಶುಚೀಶಾತ್ಮವದಾನೋನ್ಯ[ಪ]ರೀಶ್ಯೋಪವೃತ್ತಿಮೇಕರಂ124 ದ್ವಿಜನ್ಯನೇ || ಅಪ್ಪಾದ್ವತ್ಯಾವವೃತ್ತೀಣಾಂ125 ಕೃತ್ವಾ ರಾಜಾತಿಧಾರ್ಮಿಕಃ | ಆವಸನ್ಯ( 8 ನೇ ಹಲಿಗೆ ಹಿಂಭಾಗ )186ಗಾಮೇಶಾನಲಿನಾವತಿ ಸಂಜ್ಞಾತಾಂ | ತ127 ನ್ಮಾಕ್ಷ್ಳಿಪೂರ್ವದಿಗ್ಬ್ಯಾ ನೇಖ್ಯರವಾದಿ ತ್ರಿಗ್ಗಿ128 ತಾತನಾಯಪ್ರೇದಕ್ಷ್ಳಿಣಭಾಗೇನಾನಾವಾತ್ಯಲಂ129 ಗನಪಾಲಕಃ | ಶ್ರೀನಿವಾ[ಪ]ಪೂಜಿದ್ರೀತಿಪ್ರ130 ತಿಜನವನ್ಯಜವಿಶ್ರುತಾಂ | ತನ್ಮಾಕ್ಷ್ಳು ಪೂರ್ವದಿಗ್ಭಾಗೇ131 ಹುಸಿಗೇಗ್ಲರಿಸಿತಿಗ್ನಿಕ | ತನ್ಮಾಕ್ಷ್ಲ್ಯಗ್ನೇಯದಿ132 ಗ್ಗ್ಯಾ ಗೇಜಬೌಧ್ಧಾವನಾನಮಹಾಪುರೇ | ಕಪವತೀ133 ತಿವಿಮ್ಯ್ಮಾ ತರೌತೃಅ ರೇಖರಣಾಟವೀ | ಎಮವಿ134 ರಾಜಜಿಗ್ಗ್ರಾ ಮುರತ್ತ್ಯೀ ೇಸನ್ಯಮನೋಹರೇನವಭ್ಯೋ135 ದ್ವಿಜಮವೀರ್ಭೋಭ್ಯಂತ್ಯತ್ಪಲೇಕೌದದನ್ಯಪಃ | ವಾ136 ಪೀಕಪಟಾಟಕಾರದಿನೀಕ್ಷ್ಳಿಪ್ತ್ಯಕ್ಷ ಸಮನ್ವಿತಾಃ ||137 ವ್ರಾತಸ್ವೌತ್ರಾ ವ್ವಿದಿಭಭೋೇಗ್ಳಾಗ್ಯ್ಷಕುಮಾಜ್ಞ್ಚಂದ್ರತರ138 ಕಂ || ಸಹಿರಕೆಯ್ಡೇಕದರ್ಧಕರಭದಾದಾಮಷ್ಯು139 ತಪೂಪತಿಶೀದಾವನಾಲನಯೋರಮ್ಯದೃಢಾನಾಂ140 ತ್ರ್ಯೋತ್ಪೇೇವಮುಪಾಲನಂ | ದಾನವತ್ಸನ್ಯಗಮವಾಪ್ರೇನ್ನಿತ್ರಿಪಾಲನಾ141 ದ್ಯುಕ್ತೋಭವತು | ಸ್ವದತ್ತಾ_ಪತ್ರಿಕಾಧಾತ್ರೀ142 ಪಿತೃವತ್ತ್ರಾ_ಸಹೋದರೀ | ಪರದತ್ತ್ಯಾ_ಸ್ವಯಂಮಾತಾ143 ವಿಪುದತ್ತಾ_ವಸುಂಧರಾ || ಸ್ವದತ್ತಾ_ಲಂಪರದೆ144 ತ್ತ್ಯಾ_ಂವಾಯೋರೇಹರೇತ್ಕೃಷ್ಟು_ವಸುಂಧರಾಂ | ಪಷ್ಠಿ_ವ್ಯರ್ಷ145 ಸಹಸ್ರಾಣಿವಿಷ್ಠಾಯಾಂಜಾಯತೇಕೃಮಿಃ ||ಶ್ರೀನಿವಾಪಾಕ್ಷ

cells.location: *At Turuṿēkēre, (Turuvekere hobli), on a stone in the mukha-maṇṭapa of the Channigarāya temple
cells.dynasty: Hoysaṇa
cells.language: Kannada
cells.remarks: Be it well.¹ At the hands of the refuge of all the world, favourite of earth and fortune, mahâ- râjâdhirâjâ paramêśvara, boon lord of Dvârâvati-pura, sun in the sky of the Yâdava-kula, crest-jewel of omniscience, (with other usual titles), uprooter of the Magara kingdom, establisher of the Chôla kingdom, Hoysaṇa bhujabaḷa-vīra-Nârasimha-Dêvarasa,—the great minister for peace and war, Sôvaṇṇa-daṇṇâyaka having received Ṭuruveyakere, formed it into an agrâhâra of 95 shares, and placing before him the vêda-worshipper Kôtiśaṅkara-dêva, bestowed it in permanence as follows ;— (On the date specified), all the Brahmans of the great agrâhâra Sarvvajna-śrī-Vijaya-Nârasimha- pura, which is Ṭuruveyakere, agreeing among themselves, during the monthly management of Kaṇṭenupâdhyâya's (son) Viṭhappa, made the following regulations in regard to the dry fields, rice fields, tanks, ponds, dues and taxes. (Here follow minute regulations for all variety of cases arising in connection with the cultivation and irrigation). Usual final verses. Signatures. Given as S'aka 1461, the year Nandana, but Nandana = 1454. Tiptur Taluq

3. ಕೋಟಿಕ್ಕ್ರಮ || ಸಕರ್ವಷ ೧೧೫೪ ನೆಯರುಧಿರೋದ್ಗಾರಿ ಸಂವತ್ಸರದೇಷ್ಯಯತ್ರಬು ೭ ಅ | ದಂಡಸ್ಥಸ್ತಿ ಸಮಸ್ತಪ್ರಶ
4. ಸ್ತಿ ಸಹಿತತ್ರಿಮುಕ್ತಸ್ಮೃಣಮಸ್ತೃಣದಿಸಿರಿಯಗು || ಹಾರಂಸವ್ರಜಬ್ಹ ಶ್ರೀವಿಜಯನಾರಸಿಂಹಪುರ
5. ಹಾನದಚುಕುಮೇಟ್ಕೆಆಯಿಶ್ರಿಮಹಾದೇೇಶಮಹಾಜನಂಗಳತುಮ್ಮೆಲulsಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯಮತ್ಯವಾರಿಗಕಂತಿಪೌಪಾಧ್ಯಾಯದಿಯಂಶ
6. ಣಂಗಳವಾಸಿಗಗಳಕೇಡತನಲ್ಲಿಕತುಬೆಯಕೆಯಸಮಸ್ತಮಹಳ್ಳಗಳುಗದ್ದೆಬೆದ್ದಲುಗಳಕಟ್ಟುಕಿಳುಕಟ್ಟುಗಳ
7. ಹಳಗಾಮಿಗ
8. ಲ್ಸುಸುಹೀತಅನುಭವಿಎದ್ದುಂಡುವಿಗೆಬೆದ್ದುಲುಗಳಳಂಚಿನಿಂದವಂಣಾ = ದಿಂದವ್ರುಂಅರುಪುಗಳೆಲಿಂದವ್ರುಂಪೊಣ್ದುವ್ರುಂ
9. ವ್ಯವಂಸಮವಾಯ್ದೆ • ತುತತ್ವಮಾಡಿದ್ದವ್ರುಂಡಿಗೆಯನಿಕೃಕೋಂಟಬ್ಬಿವಾ
10. ದಿದಸಮೆಯಪತ್ರದಕ್ಕಮವೆಂತೆಂದಡೇಕೆತ್ತೆ ೨ದಕ್ಕವ್ಯತಿಯಣೇ ರಡೇಜಮರಿಯಾದೆಯಲೆಯಕೊಳಗೆಗೋಟ್ಟಿಯಕುಳಉಂತೆ
11. ತ್ತ್ಯಾಂದು | ಕೋಲಾಲತಾವದರಯೇಕ್ಕೊಟಾಲ್ಗೆ ವ್ವಾಜೆಯನಪಲ್ಲೆಯಉತ್ತ್ಯಾಂದು | ಚಿಕ್ಕತುಟುಯಮಕೆಯ್ಕೆ
12. ಬೆಬಿನಾಸೆಟ್ • ಒತಿಸಿಜೆಯಹಳ್ಳಿಜಿ
13. ಗಂಗಾನಹಳ್ಳಿಯುಗದ್ದೆಬೆದ್ದಲಿನಲಉಅದ್ದಳಯಿಉತುತತ್ತ್ಯಾಂದು | ಆಯ್ಯರಸನಹಳ್ಳಿ | ಮುನಿಪುರು | ಪವ್ಪುಟೆಯನಾಖ್ಯ
14. ನಹಳ್ಳಿ | ಸೋಮಗೌಡನಹಳ್ಳಿಯುಉತತ್ತ್ಯಾಂದು | ದೋಲನಹಳ್ಳಿ | ಕಲ್ಯನಕೇಟಿ | ಬೂವನಹಳ್ಳಿ | ಹಳೆಯದೋ
15. ದ್ದೆಯನಿಯಲ್ಲಿಉತತ್ತ್ಯಾಂದು | ಮಲ್ಲ
16. ನಸಗ್ಗ | ವಾದಿಯಹಳ್ಳಿ | ಕರಡಿಯುಳೇಪುತುತತ್ತ್ಯಾಂದು | ದೊಡ್ಡಗಟ್ಟ | ಎಲವದಹಳ್ಳಿ | ಸಟ್ಟಿಯಹಳ್ಳಿ | ಗಂ
17. ಗಾನಹಳ್ಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿಗದ್ದೆಬೆದ್ದಲಿಲಅದಳಉಳಿತತ್ತ್ಯಾಂದು | ಅರಳಾಲೇಕೇಟಿದಾನಹಳ್ಳಿಯಬೆದ್ದುಲುವಮಾರಗೌಡನಹ
18. ಳ್ಳ | ಮಾವಿನಹ
19. ಳ್ಳಿ |

text.location: *At Turuṿēkēre, (Turuvekere hobli), on a stone in the mukha-maṇṭapa of the Channigarāya temple
text.remarks:
Be it well.¹ At the hands of the refuge of all the world, favourite of earth and fortune, mahâ-
râjâdhirâjâ paramêśvara, boon lord of Dvârâvati-pura, sun in the sky of the Yâdava-kula, crest-jewel
of omniscience, (with other usual titles), uprooter of the Magara kingdom, establisher of the Chôla
kingdom, Hoysaṇa bhujabaḷa-vīra-Nârasimha-Dêvarasa,—the great minister for peace and war,
Sôvaṇṇa-daṇṇâyaka having received Ṭuruveyakere, formed it into an agrâhâra of 95 shares, and
placing before him the vêda-worshipper Kôtiśaṅkara-dêva, bestowed it in permanence as follows ;—
(On the date specified), all the Brahmans of the great agrâhâra Sarvvajna-śrī-Vijaya-Nârasimha-
pura, which is Ṭuruveyakere, agreeing among themselves, during the monthly management of
Kaṇṭenupâdhyâya's (son) Viṭhappa, made the following regulations in regard to the dry fields, rice
fields, tanks, ponds, dues and taxes. (Here follow minute regulations for all variety of cases
arising in connection with the cultivation and irrigation).

Usual final verses. Signatures.

Given as S'aka 1461, the year Nandana, but Nandana = 1454.

Tiptur Taluq

As he danced about on the battle field the Turushkas were shrivelled up, the Koṅkaṇa king S’aṅka was filled with fear, the Ândhras ran into holes, the Gurjaras were paralysed, the Kambôjas lost their courage, the Kaḷiṅgas were broken. His wife was Gaurâmbikâ (her praises), by whom he had a son Harihara, who made the sixteen great gifts. ಅದೇ ಹೋಬಳಿ ಕಡಸೂರು ಗ್ರಾಮ ಬೈರೇ ದೇವನ ಗುಡಿಯಮುಂದೆ ನಟ್ಟ ವೀರಕಲ್ಲು
1ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿ ಸಮಸ್ತುವನಾಶಯಂಶ್ರೀಪ್ರಥ್ವೀವಲ್ಲಭಮಹಾಜ
2ರಾಜಾಧಿರಾಜಪರಮೇಶ್ವರಂದ್ವಾರಾವತೀಪುರವರಾಧೀಶ್ವರಂ
3ಯಾದವಕುಳಾಂಬರದಿವಮಣಿಸಂವ್ರಜ್ಜೂಡಾಮಣಿಮಲೆರಾ
4ಜರಾಜಮಪರೆಳಲಗುದಂಡಗಂದಭೇರುಂಡಕದನಪ್ರತಾಪ
5ಜನೇಣ್ಕಾಂಗೆವೀರನಸಾಯಸೂ ರಸನಿವಾರಸಿದ್ಧಿ ಗಿರಿಮುಗ ಕಮ್ಮಲ
6ಜಿಡಲಂದಕರಾಯು . . . ಕೆ . . . ರವನಮಾಲವರಾಜ್ಯನಿಮೂಳವಾಣ್ಮಳಿ
7ದಿಶಾಪಟ್ಟೆತೋಳರಂಜಜಪ್ಪ ಪ್ರತಿಷ್ಠಾ ಚಾರ್ಯ್ಯನಿಮಿಂಸಘಪ್ರತಾಪ
8ನೀರಣಹೊಯ್ಸಳಬಲ್ಲಾಹಣ್ಕಾವೃತ್ತಿವಿಲಾಸೋಮೇಶ್ವರದೇವೀರು

cells.location: At Jaḍiya (Māyisandra hobli), on a stone in front of the Īśvara temple.
cells.dynasty: Hoysala
cells.language: Kannada and Sanskrit
cells.remarks: Obeisance to S'ambhu &c. Be it well. When, (with usual titles), the uprooter of the Magara kingdom, the displacer of Pāṇḍya, setter up of the Chōla kingdom,—the nissanka-pratāpa-chakra- vartti Hoysala vira-Nārasimha-Dēva was in the residence of Dōrasamudra, ruling the kingdom of the earth:—(with numerous praises of his exploits in war) was the mahā-sāmanta, bhujabala-Vira- Ganga-Hoysala's sāmanta, the Kadamba lion, ruler of Marugal-nāḍ, champion over the Telunga chieftains, ganda-peṇḍāra, a hero's bracelet to chieftains, worshipper of the lotus feet of (the god) Rāmanātha,—Kayidāla Malli-Dēva's son Ganga-Dēva.—Be it well. (On the date specified), his ārrādhya (with numerous praises) the S'iva yōgi Siddha-chakravartti Hiriya Aghaniya having set up in Jidaha (the god) Sōmanātha,—for the offerings and services of that god, he granted lands (speci- fied). Usual final verses. That Aghaniya-dēva's daughter Kālala-dēvī will enjoy the lands given for that god Sōmanātha and carry on the services. Tiptur Taluq 47

text.location: At Jaḍiya (Māyisandra hobli), on a stone in front of the Īśvara temple.
text.remarks:
Obeisance to S'ambhu &c. Be it well. When, (with usual titles), the uprooter of the Magara
kingdom, the displacer of Pāṇḍya, setter up of the Chōla kingdom,—the nissanka-pratāpa-chakra-
vartti Hoysala vira-Nārasimha-Dēva was in the residence of Dōrasamudra, ruling the kingdom of
the earth:—(with numerous praises of his exploits in war) was the mahā-sāmanta, bhujabala-Vira-
Ganga-Hoysala's sāmanta, the Kadamba lion, ruler of Marugal-nāḍ, champion over the Telunga
chieftains, ganda-peṇḍāra, a hero's bracelet to chieftains, worshipper of the lotus feet of (the god)
Rāmanātha,—Kayidāla Malli-Dēva's son Ganga-Dēva.—Be it well. (On the date specified), his
ārrādhya (with numerous praises) the S'iva yōgi Siddha-chakravartti Hiriya Aghaniya having set up in
Jidaha (the god) Sōmanātha,—for the offerings and services of that god, he granted lands (speci-
fied). Usual final verses.

That Aghaniya-dēva's daughter Kālala-dēvī will enjoy the lands given for that god Sōmanātha
and carry on the services.

Tiptur Taluq	47

ಬಿಟ್ಟುಸಂಗರಸರನಗ್ಗದಗ್ಲಿಗುಡಿಗೆಟ್ಟಬಾಲಜಯಲಕ್ಷ್ಮಿಯೊಂಬೆವಲಂ || ಜಡಿಯಲಿದ್ದದ್15. ಯೊನಿಏನಕಡಗಣ್ಣು ರುಣೋದಯಮವಳಗಾಲವಿಲ್ಲದನಡಬೆಕ್ಕುದಾಂಅದಲವಂದೆದಮಾಳವನಪ್ರತಗಂಗ16. ಕಳಿತುಬೆದದಿದಿರಂತವೈರಿಯಸಿರಂಗಳನಿನ್ನಿನಪದಾವಂಬುಜಜ್ಘಿನಂದೊಣಿಸೇನೆಯೆನೆದಿಂದಿನವಿಸಿತುದ್ದದು17. ಬಿಲವ ವಿದೇಂಪ್ರಸಾಪಯೇ || ಅದಳಕಳಕಳಮಹಿತಉದಿತೋಡೀತಿಕ್ರೀತ್ಪಮಲ್ಲದೇವದೃಪತಂಜಕ18. ವನದೋಳಂತರಿಕೀರದಮದವಮದಂಮೃತ್ಸುಸನಿಸಿಂಭ್ರೂವರಂಗನಂ || ಅತನಪ್ರಸಸ್ಯೆ || ಶ್ರೀಮನ್ಮಹಾನಾ19. ಮುತಭುಜಬಲವಿಲೀರಗಂಗೆಹೊಯ್ಯಲನಾಮಂಟಕಡೆಬಕಂರೇರವರಮೂಲಗಳನಾದಾಳುತ್ತೆಲುಂಗಮಂಡಲಿಕರ20. ಗೊಂದಗಂಡೆಂದಪಾರಮಂಡಲಿಕರವಿಘಾತಕೇಸಿ ರಾಮನಾಥದೇವದವಿಧೃತ್ಯಶ್ರೀಪಾದಪದವಮಾಳಾಧಕುರುಂಪರಬಲನಾಥಕ ರುಮ21. ಪ್ಪಕಾಯಿದಲ್ಲಿದ್ದಮಲ್ಲದೇವನಮಗಂಗೆವೆನಮು || ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿ ಶ್ರೀಸಕವರುಷ ೧೧೪೧ ನೇಸಿದ್ಧಾರ್ಥಿ .. ಜೆಯಿತ್ಸೃ ಸು ೪ ಸೋ| ಜೇದಹಡಲತುಂತವಾರಾ22. ದ್ರ್ಯುರಷ್ಟುಸ್ತಿ ಶ್ರೀಮನ್ಮಥಮಯೋಂಗೇಂದ್ರಸಕೇಲಕಳಕೌಣಿದಾತಿಶಯಗುಣಸಾಸ್ಥಿತ | ಬೋಧಾನಂದಸ್ವರೂಪ | ಅಗ ಣ್ಯಾಭೂ

cells.location: At Taṇḍaga (Māyisandra hobli), on a stone in the enclosure of the Īs’vara temple.
cells.dynasty: Poysaḷa
cells.king: Vira-Ganga Poysaḷa-Deva
cells.language: Kannada and Sanskrit
cells.remarks: Be it well. When Tribhuvanamalla Vira-Ganga Poysaḷa-Deva was ruling the kingdom of the earth :—(on the date specified), the head ruler in Taṇḍiga, the gaṇḍa-bhêruṇḍa, (with various epithets), Bimmanna, made for the Mûlasthâna god a grant of lands (specified) under the Kâru tank in front of the temple. The masters of the lands thus given for the offerings of the temple are the two, Amṛitarâsi-paṇḍita and Karttâra-jîya. Imprecation. Muddaiya's son Honneya's writing.

plunderer of the Chôḷa camp (or capital); the champion who pursued after A[di]yama, Chengiri,
Iruṅgôḷa, Pâṇḍya and Masâṇeya, and took the head of Tailapa ;—the capturer of Talakâḍu Gaṅga-
vâḍi Noṇambavâḍi Banavase and Hânungal ; bhujabala Vira-Ganga (with other usual epithets),—
the nissaṅka-pratâpa-chakravartti bhujabala Hoysaḷa Vira-Ballâḷa-Deva was ruling the kingdom of
the earth :—(in the year specified), (with various epithets) Tuḷuvâ ... carried off the cows of
agrahâra Saṅkaranârâyaṇapura, which is Taṇḍaga, in the .... nád,,... .... slaying many, gained the
world of gods. His wife set up this vîragal to his memory.

ಅದೇ ಸ್ಥಳದಲ್ಲಿ ೨ ನೇ ವೀಠರಕಲ್ಲು
^1ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿಶ್ರೀಮನ್ಮಹಾಮಂಡಲೇಶ್ವರನ್‌ತಳಕಡುಕೊಂಡುಗಂಗಾಳುಂಜಿನ
^2ವಾಸವಹನಂಗಲಗೊಂಡಬುಜಬಲವೀರಗಂಗವಿಷ್ಣುವರ್ಧನಪ್ರತಾಪ
^3ಹೊಸಳಸನರಾಸಿಂಹದೇವನೂರೋಸಮುದ್ರದಬೇದಿಡಿಯಲುಸುಬಂಸಕತ
^4ವಿನೋದೆದಿದಂರಜ್ಯಂಗಯ್ಯುತ್ತಿರಲುಸುಭಾತುಸಂವತ್ಸರದ್ವಾಮಹಸುದ
^5ಪಂಜೆಮಿಬೃ ಹವಾರದಂದುತಂಡಗಡತಯುಹರಿಪಲ... ಕೀಹುಹೋನ್ನೇ
^6ಯುಸುಪುತಊರಡಕಿಹೈೆಯುತುವಂಗಮಗುರ್ಚಿಸುರಲೋಕಪ್ರಾಪನಾದ
^7ಆತನಅಳಾಣ್ಬ ತಳಾವಣೆಯುಹಳ್ಳಿಯವಹೇಂದತೀೕಳಕಥೇಪವೋಕ್ಷವಿ
^8ನೆಯವಾಗಿಕಲ್ಸಿನಲಿಸಿದರು || ಕೇಶರಿಯುಪುತ್ರಸುರಸುತಗಣಂಗಲ . ಸಿ
^9ಮಜ್ಜೆರಿಪಪ್ರಸಾದೀಲಗೆಮತ್ಕಸುಲಅಳಿದಿರುದಪ್ರ ಸದಿನಿಗಳ
^10ಗಂಗದೀತರತೋದದರಅಂಕುಸಬದಿಯಮಯತೋರ್ಜಮಡಿದ
^11ಕಲುಮಂಗಲಮಂಗಲಮಮಹಾಶ್ರೀ ೪ ೪

^5ಣ್ಯಕಾಲದಲಿಕೇ ಶ್ರೀಮನ್ಹಾಮಂಡಲೇ
^6ಶ್ವರ • ಟಲ . . ರಾಮರಾಜು ಕೊಮಾರ
^7 . . ದೇವ . . ಅರಸುಗಳೇುಮಾಳುವನು
^8 . . ಗಳೂತಂಡಗಡತೋಂಭಿಗರಾಯಗೆ
^9 . . . ದಕಟ್‌ . . ದಿನಲುಪಿಂದೋಕೇವರದಪಡಿಅ
^10 . . . ವೆಮಕೋ . . ಆಮಿಗುಳವಗದ್ದೇನುದಾ
^11 . . . . . . . . . . . ಹವರುಷ
^12 . . . . . . . . . . . . ಗೆದಾವಳ •

^2ಯಮಜುಸನ್ಧಹಪಜಮಿಅದಿವಾರದಂದು | ಅ

Of the various families, whether they stay or whether they go, the loss or gain whatever it is, belongs to the shareholders of their respective tattus. Maṇḍala-svāmi had this śāsana prepared, and having set up the god Muddēśvara, made for it a grant, washing the feet of Kalla-jiya's son Maṇchu-jiya. And for the perpetual lamp and daily offerings, the citizens granted the customs dues from the fair. Date 1395 A.D. Be it well. (On the date specified), when, (with usual titles), the rājādhirāja rāja-paramēśvara, vīra-Bukka-Rāya's son vīra-Harihara-Rāya was in the city of Vijayanagara, ruling the kingdom of the earth:—the mahā-sāvantādhipati, the Âlûr Bhīma, (with other epithets), Ālambûr Gängeya- Nāyaka's son was Gōpeya-Nāyaka,—whose son Chenneya-Nāyaka, in the capture of Rangini, fought with the Turakas, broke their army, and giving up his body in the service of his lord, ascended to Vayikuṇṭha. By two among men is the disk of the sun burst through,—he who is perfect in yoga, and he who falls facing the foe in battle. Fortune to Chenneya-Nāyaka's vīragal. Date ? 1237 A.D. ....... (In the year specified), in the war of .... the mahā-maṇḍalika, (with other epithets), vira ... Vodeyar's son Bayicheya-daṇṇāyaka, marching upon Maleyāla, (stops here). Date about 1164 A.D. Be it well. When the mahā-maṇḍalēśvara Tribhuvanamalla, capturer of Tala-kāḍu, bhujabala Vira-Ganga Vishnuvarddhana-Hoysala-Narasimha-Dēva was ruling the kingdom:-(in the year specified, details gone), Māra-Gauṇḍa and Jaya-Gauṇḍa made a grant. Imprecation. (With various epithets), Kaloja's son Malōja of the basadi made this stone. Date about 880 A.D. When Rāchamalla-Permānādi was ruling the kingdom of the world:—under Polaruva's orders, ... ...,-when the Nolamba mahā-sāmanta named Pōlalchōra marched upon ... dūr in this nād, thinking to capture the fort,—Sīnga-Veṇṇama, puliya-Ganga, Prabhumalla, son-in-law of Obbāguṇṭa, slaying to the north, took ... and died. Date 1214 A.D. Repeated obeisance to the Vāmana of destiny, to Nārāyaṇa, the most powerful, bearer of (the bow) Sārnga, the discus, the sword and club,—obeisance to him, for Purushōttama. 52 — Tiptur Taluq Having done obeisance to the lord of the world, the guru of all things movable and immovable,— the worship of the great rishi do I perform, the great one of the world. When a certain king named Sâla was with unshaken mind worshipping the goddess Vâsantikâ of S'asâkapura; a fierce unchained (tiger) sprang forth, on which the Jina munipa at her side gave him his kuncha (or peacock's feather fan) saying—with this rod (sele) hit Sala (poy Sala) the tiger;—whence those kings became the Poysalas (or Hoysalas). Thence forward, having a rod and a tiger on their flag, from that time, on the kings of the Hoysala line displaying the flag with the rod, hostile kings fled from them in battle. Be it well. When, (with usual titles), the nissanka-pratâpa-chakravartti bhujabala vira-Ballâla- Dêva was in the residence of Dôrasamudra, ruling the kingdom of the earth in peace and wisdom :— A dweller at his lotus feet,—Be it well.—the mahâ-pasâyta, supreme favourite, the crown com- mander of the elephants and horse, (with other epithets, as in No. 43 above), worshipper of the lotus feet of the god Lakshmi-Nârâyana, the patta-sâhani Mâdiyanna, the Âlambûr Gauda Kêta- malla-Nâyaka and Mâcheya-Nâyaka, made grants of lands (specified) for the god Prasanna-Chenna- Kêsava, (on the date specified). And the great minister Goyvana-dannâyaka directed that every year whatever minister should have charge of the hejjunka should give for the god ga 2. The Kaniba- veggade of the place, Ilittamarasa, Dêvanna, and any others who may come in their room, will maintain this. And the great minister, sarvvâdhikâri, Appana-dannâyaka granted for the god every year 1 rice-field. The pattana-sâmi Mahadeva-Setti and other authorities, with all the citizens, will grant the customs dues of the fair. These grants were made over with washing the feet of Savitâra-bhatta. Pâtta-sâhani Mâdi- yanna's son, patta-sâhani Singeya will maintain them. Usual final verses. Date 1230 A.D. Be it well. The mahâ-pasâyta, supreme favourite, Kâmeya-Nâyaka's (son) Bayichaya, (in the year specified) at the time of an eclipse of the moon, made an annual grant from the siddâya for the same god. This the Nâyakas will maintain. Date 1693 A.D. (The greater part in Nâgari characters). (On the date specified), some grant, much defaced. Imprecations. Date 1522 A.D. Glorious as a myriad suns, bearer of the conch club lotus and discus, Indirâ and Vasumati shining at his two sides, the myriad constellations his garland, brilliant as a lotus with yellow garments and the kaustubha, …… having the śrivatsa sign on his chest,—him do I extol. Be it well. (On the date specified), in order that merit might be to the mahârâjâdhirâja para- mêsvara vira-pratâpa Krishna-Dêva-Râya-mahârâja's true servant Mârappa-Nâyaka-Vodeyar,—his servant Ta .. gâtapa-Nâyaka made, for the gods Gopinatha and Tirumala of Nonabinakere, a grant deposited in the Kaidâla village of the Sakata-sthala in the Nonabinakere-sime, together with all rights (specified). Imprecations. Tiptur Taluq

cells.remarks: (On the date specified), a memorial to some one who fell in battle. Date ? 1561 A.D. Be it well. (On the date specified), to ...... worshipper of the lotus feet of the god Sampat- kumāra of Nârâyanapura, (with other epithets), ............—the mahâ-maņdalêśvara .. Râju-Râjaya-Dêva mahâ-arasu granted a dharma-sâdhana for service, as follows:—the Bajagûr- sthala in the .... which the mahârâjâdhirâja râja-paramêśvara vîra-pratâpa, master of the eastern western southern and northern kingdoms, Sadâsiva-mahârâja had favoured to us for the office of Amara-Nâyaka ...... Date 1228 A.D. Obeisance to S'ambhu and praise of S'iva. Usual account of the origin of the Yadu-vamsa and rise of the Hoysalas. That Hoysana's son was ......; his son, Ereyanga-Dêva; his son, Biţţi-Dêva; his son, Nârasimha Dêva; his son, Ballâla-Dêva; his son, (with usual titles), uprooter of the Magara kingdom, establisher of the Chôla kingdom, the nissanka-pratâpa-chakravartti vîra-Nârasimha- Dêva, when ruling the kingdom of the earth:—in the great minister, râya-dandanâtha, (with other epithets) Appaya-daņņâyaka's government, Bojagûr .. (with various epithets), Hiriya-Mahadêva- Nâyaka and others (named) granted, for the god Mallikârjuna, lands (specified) under the Gôvindasamudra and other tanks. Imprecation. Written by sênabôva Mallarasa. Date about 880 A.D. Be it well. When Satyavâkya-Râchamalla-Permmânadi was ruling the kingdom of the earth:—Nanniya-Ganga's raiders coming and entering Belgere and Kundûr, were going off,—hearing of which, Dôrabbe's son Malluga, running to the affray, placed the cows in safety, fought and died. Date 961 A.D. Be it well. (On the date specified), hearing that Manaldûr Rajâvanduka was coming to demand Belgere as his,—the brave Chettiga slew him. This stone, prepared by Nâgavarmma, was set up by Cheţţimayya's son. Date 1091 A.D. Be it well. In the Châlukya-Vikrama 16th year &c.,—in the kingdom of Tribhuvanamalla Vinayâditya-Hoysala-Dêva, Dôra-Gauņda and Jakkamâra had a new stone built in Alariguppe, and had a sluice fixed, granting to the god Mahadêva land (specified). The sênabôva Muddayya wrote this. Tiptur Taluq Date about 1120 A.D. Obeisance to Mahâdêva. Obeisance to S'ambhu, beauteous with his lofty crest kissed by the châmara-like crescent moon, the foundation-pillar of the city of the three worlds. Other refuge there is none; thou only art my refuge; therefore of thy mercy save me, Mahêśvara. Be it well. When the favourite of earth and fortune, the mahârâjâdhirâja paramêśvara parama- bhaṭṭāraka, glory of the Satyâśraya-kula, ornament of the Châlukyas, whose wife was Keleyabarasi. To them was born Ereyanga, who was a rod in the right hand of the Châlukya king, a thunder- bolt in splitting the mountains hostile kings, like a cloud in pouring down their desires on the needy, his wide-spread exalted fame-white as the celestial elephant born from the milk ocean, the autumn cloud, the moon, or jasmin,-illuminated the world. To Ereyanga and Echala-Dêvi were born the sons Ballâla, Vishnu and Udayâditya. Of them the middle one, Vishnu, became the chief. The celebrated Koyatûr, like Talavana-pura, with Râyarâyapura and Belvala were burnt in the flames of his glory. How many hill-forts of powerful enemies he captured, how many kings he smote with the blows of his weapons in war, to how many who submitted he in compassion restored their rank,-to count up all these even the able Brahma would become confused. Without exertion he took by the might of his arm Talemale, Kongu, Nangali, Virâṭapura, Talakâḍu, Koyatûr, the powerful Kanchi, Râyapura, the Seven Male, Kongana, Chengiri, Mâlava, the beautiful Chakragotṭa, and the Tulu country. Be it well. When, entitled to the band of five chief instruments, the mahâ-maṇḍalêśvara, boon lord of Dvârâvatî-pura, a submarine fire to the ocean the Tuluva forces, an elephant to the lotus the Pândya-kula, gaṇḍa-bhêruṇḍa, hunter of the chieftains, plunderer of the Chôla camp, a Bhîma in war, the Kâma of the Kali age, gratifier of the desires of his supplicants, delighting in all gifts, obtainer of a boon from the goddess Vâsantikâ, sun in the sky of the Yâdava-kula, crest-jewel in the crown of chieftains, of unshaken valour, champion among the Malapas,-with these and all other titles, Tribhuvanamalla, the capturer of Talakâḍu Kongu Nangali Noṇambavâḍi Banavase and Hânungal, bhujabala-Vîra-Ganga pratâpa-Hoysala Biṭṭi-Dêva, putting down the evil and upholding the good in the region of the South, was ruling the kingdom in peace and wisdom :- A dweller at the lotus feet of that father-king Vishnu,-Be it well,-was the mahâprabhu Hinchanûr Toṇḍi-Gauḍa's son Êcha-Gauḍa, whose son Honna-Gauḍa, the god Kali of Hincha- nûr, washing the feet of Padmarâsi-paṇḍita's son Jakkâṇḍa-paṇḍita, made grants of land (specified). Benediction and imprecation. Praises of Honna-gauḍa's son Mâdi-gauḍa. Date 1193 A.D. Be it well. When the superintendent of honourable great feudatories, mahâ-pasâyita, master of policy (or schemes), the senior Saudore, Hariyappa was ruling Hinchanûr ;-(on the date speci- fied), he granted for the Mûlasthâna god lands (specified), washing the feet of Jakkâṇḍa-paṇḍita's sons Honna-jîya and Padma-jîya. Imprecations. Tiptur Taluq

text.location: At Hichandru (Nonavinakere hobli), on a stone near the Kallēśvara temple.
text.remarks:
(On the date specified), a memorial to some one who fell in battle.

Date ? 1561 A.D.
Be it well. (On the date specified), to ...... worshipper of the lotus feet of the god Sampat-
kumāra of Nârâyanapura, (with other epithets), ............—the mahâ-maņdalêśvara ..
Râju-Râjaya-Dêva mahâ-arasu granted a dharma-sâdhana for service, as follows:—the Bajagûr-
sthala in the .... which the mahârâjâdhirâja râja-paramêśvara vîra-pratâpa, master of the eastern
western southern and northern kingdoms, Sadâsiva-mahârâja had favoured to us for the office of
Amara-Nâyaka ......

Date 1228 A.D.
Obeisance to S'ambhu and praise of S'iva.
Usual account of the origin of the Yadu-vamsa and rise of the Hoysalas.
That Hoysana's son was ......; his son, Ereyanga-Dêva; his son, Biţţi-Dêva; his son,
Nârasimha Dêva; his son, Ballâla-Dêva; his son, (with usual titles), uprooter of the Magara
kingdom, establisher of the Chôla kingdom, the nissanka-pratâpa-chakravartti vîra-Nârasimha-
Dêva, when ruling the kingdom of the earth:—in the great minister, râya-dandanâtha, (with other
epithets) Appaya-daņņâyaka's government, Bojagûr .. (with various epithets), Hiriya-Mahadêva-
Nâyaka and others (named) granted, for the god Mallikârjuna, lands (specified) under the
Gôvindasamudra and other tanks. Imprecation.

Written by sênabôva Mallarasa.

Date about 880 A.D.
Be it well. When Satyavâkya-Râchamalla-Permmânadi was ruling the kingdom of the
earth:—Nanniya-Ganga's raiders coming and entering Belgere and Kundûr, were going off,—hearing
of which, Dôrabbe's son Malluga, running to the affray, placed the cows in safety, fought
and died.

Date 961 A.D.
Be it well. (On the date specified), hearing that Manaldûr Rajâvanduka was coming to
demand Belgere as his,—the brave Chettiga slew him. This stone, prepared by Nâgavarmma, was
set up by Cheţţimayya's son.

Date 1091 A.D.
Be it well. In the Châlukya-Vikrama 16th year &c.,—in the kingdom of Tribhuvanamalla
Vinayâditya-Hoysala-Dêva, Dôra-Gauņda and Jakkamâra had a new stone built in Alariguppe,
and had a sluice fixed, granting to the god Mahadêva land (specified). The sênabôva Muddayya
wrote this.

Tiptur Taluq
Date about 1120 A.D.

Obeisance to Mahâdêva. Obeisance to S'ambhu, beauteous with his lofty crest kissed by the
châmara-like crescent moon, the foundation-pillar of the city of the three worlds. Other refuge
there is none; thou only art my refuge; therefore of thy mercy save me, Mahêśvara.

Be it well. When the favourite of earth and fortune, the mahârâjâdhirâja paramêśvara parama-
bhaṭṭāraka, glory of the Satyâśraya-kula, ornament of the Châlukyas, whose wife was Keleyabarasi.
To them was born Ereyanga, who was a rod in the right hand of the Châlukya king, a thunder-
bolt in splitting the mountains hostile kings, like a cloud in pouring down their desires on the needy,
his wide-spread exalted fame-white as the celestial elephant born from the milk ocean, the autumn
cloud, the moon, or jasmin,-illuminated the world. To Ereyanga and Echala-Dêvi were born the
sons Ballâla, Vishnu and Udayâditya. Of them the middle one, Vishnu, became the chief. The
celebrated Koyatûr, like Talavana-pura, with Râyarâyapura and Belvala were burnt in the flames of
his glory. How many hill-forts of powerful enemies he captured, how many kings he smote with the
blows of his weapons in war, to how many who submitted he in compassion restored their rank,-to
count up all these even the able Brahma would become confused. Without exertion he took by the
might of his arm Talemale, Kongu, Nangali, Virâṭapura, Talakâḍu, Koyatûr, the powerful Kanchi,
Râyapura, the Seven Male, Kongana, Chengiri, Mâlava, the beautiful Chakragotṭa, and the Tulu
country.

Be it well. When, entitled to the band of five chief instruments, the mahâ-maṇḍalêśvara,
boon lord of Dvârâvatî-pura, a submarine fire to the ocean the Tuluva forces, an elephant to the
lotus the Pândya-kula, gaṇḍa-bhêruṇḍa, hunter of the chieftains, plunderer of the Chôla camp, a
Bhîma in war, the Kâma of the Kali age, gratifier of the desires of his supplicants, delighting in all
gifts, obtainer of a boon from the goddess Vâsantikâ, sun in the sky of the Yâdava-kula, crest-jewel
in the crown of chieftains, of unshaken valour, champion among the Malapas,-with these and all
other titles, Tribhuvanamalla, the capturer of Talakâḍu Kongu Nangali Noṇambavâḍi Banavase
and Hânungal, bhujabala-Vîra-Ganga pratâpa-Hoysala Biṭṭi-Dêva, putting down the evil and
upholding the good in the region of the South, was ruling the kingdom in peace and wisdom :-

A dweller at the lotus feet of that father-king Vishnu,-Be it well,-was the mahâprabhu
Hinchanûr Toṇḍi-Gauḍa's son Êcha-Gauḍa, whose son Honna-Gauḍa, the god Kali of Hincha-
nûr, washing the feet of Padmarâsi-paṇḍita's son Jakkâṇḍa-paṇḍita, made grants of land (specified).
Benediction and imprecation.

Praises of Honna-gauḍa's son Mâdi-gauḍa.

Date 1193 A.D.

Be it well. When the superintendent of honourable great feudatories, mahâ-pasâyita, master
of policy (or schemes), the senior Saudore, Hariyappa was ruling Hinchanûr ;-(on the date speci-
fied), he granted for the Mûlasthâna god lands (specified), washing the feet of Jakkâṇḍa-paṇḍita's
sons Honna-jîya and Padma-jîya. Imprecations.

Tiptur Taluq

text.text_original: 1 ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿ ಸತ್ಯವಾಕ್ಯ ರಜಚೆಮ್ಮಲಜೆಮ್ಮ ನಡಿಸಿಪ್ರುಥಿವೀರಾಜ್ಯಂಗೈಯ್ಯುತ್ತವಿಲೆ . ನ್ನಿಯುಗೊಗನಪರಿಬನ್ನಿದಿ2 ಲಗ್ಯಾಯುಂಕುಸೊದ್ರುವನುಟುದಹಹೋಗೀಕೇಳ್ಳುದೋರಕ್ಷ್ಮೀಯುಮಂಗಮುಳಗಂಕುಪ್ಪುಯ್ಯಳ್ದಿರು3 ಕೊಟ್ಟಯಲ3ಪರಿಮಕಳಕ್ಕ4ಸಿದೆ5ಬೆಟ್ಟಿಗನು6ನಾಗಮಯ್ಯನ ದಕ್ಷಿಣದಲ್ಲಿನಿಸಿದರು7ಸೆಟ್ಟಿಯಮುಖ್ಯನಮಗಂಅದೇ ಗ್ರಾಮದ ಕೆರೆ ತೊಬಿನ ಕಲ್ಲಿನಮೇಲೆ1ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿಶ್ರೀಮತುತಾಳುಕ್ಯವಿಕ್ರಮಸಂವತ್ಸರಹ ೧೬ ನೆಯ . . ಸಂವತ್ಸರದಲಮಾಘಬಹುಳಗಳು . [Footnote 24] ರ್ಬೂಂಗಣಚೆಗಿಮಾಲವಂಸುಲಲಿತಕ್ಕಗ್ಗೊಲ್ಲ ತುದಲರ್ದೇಮನಕೃಮದಂದಿವಂಪು ಭೂಲನೂಾಧೀಶನಪತ್ರಿಮ8. [Footnote 25] ನೂರಾಧೇಕೋಂಡಭುಜಪಾಶಿತಂ ॥ ಗದ್ಯ॥ ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿ ಸಮಧಿಗತಪಂಚಮಹಾಶಬ್ದಮಹಾಮಂಡಳೇಶ್ವರಂದಿತ್ಯ9. [Footnote 26] ರಾವತೀಪುರವರಾಧೀಶ್ವರಾಂತುಲುಮವಳಜಾಳಬಡಾವನಲ್ವಪೌಂದ್ಯ ಕುಲಕಮಲವೊಡುದಂಗದಬೆಳ್ಳುಂದಮಡಲಿ10. [Footnote 27] ಕಚೇಬೀಟಾಜೀರಕೇಟಾಜಕಸುತ್ತೂಟಕಾಸಂಗಮಾಮುಭಿಮಕಲಿಕಲಕಾಮಸಕಲಕವಂಬಿಸುಂದಂಸತರ್ಪಣಾ11. [Footnote 28] ಸಮಗ್ರವಿಚರಣಾನೇವೇದವಾಪಸಂತಿಕಾಳೇದನಿಯಲಬ್ಬ ವಧ್ಯ ನಸದಾಯೋದವಕುಳಾಂಬರಮೃಗಮಣಿಸಂದೆ12. [Footnote 29] ಳಕಮಕುಟದೇಡಮಾಮಣಿಕದವನಬಂಡಮಲಪೇರುಲಗಂಡನಾಪಮದಿಸಮಸ್ತೃಪತೃಸಿಂಹಿತಾಂಶ್ರೀಮ13. [Footnote 30] ತ್ತ್ರಿ ಭುವನಮಲ್ಲತಳಕಡಚೇಕೋಂಗನಗಲಣೌಣಾಬಾವಿನವನಹಸಾನುಗಳುಗ್ಗುಂಗೂಟಬುಜಿಲವೀರೆಂಗಂಗ14. [Footnote 31] ಪ್ರಾತಾಪಹೌಯ್ಯಲಬೆಟ್ಟಿದೇವದುದ್ದಧಾಮಮೂಮದಂಡೊಂದುಮದುಪ್ಪಿನಗ್ರಾಹ್ಮಪುತ್ರೀಪಲನಪ್ರೌಣ್ವಗ್ವಾಸು15. [Footnote 32] ಬ್ರೂಸಕಧಾ就行ದೊಡೀಯರಜೊಂಗಯುಕ್ತ ಮಿರೆದೇಳೆಯುತಿಪ್ಪಸಿಮ್ಮ ಭೂಪಾಲನೋರ್ದಜಾಧಿರಾಜಿನೆ ॥16. [Footnote 33] ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿಶ್ರೀಮತ್ ಮಹಾಪ್ರಭುಷಿಂಜೆನರಕೌಂಡಿಗೊಂಡದನಸುಪುತ್ರ ನೆಜಾಗೌಂಡಾನತನಸುತಹ ೪ ಣ್ಣ ಗೌಂ17. [Footnote 34] ಡನುಹಿಂಜೆನರಕೌಂಡಿಗೇವರಿಗಮ್ಮ ರಾಜಾಂಡಿಂಕರಸಪುತ್ರಜಕ್ಕಯ್ಯದೋಪಂಡಿತಕರಕಾಳಿ F ಧಾರೋಪಣ್ಯಂಕರ18. [Footnote 35] ಮಾುಡಿದಿಪತ್ನಿ ಗದ್ದೆ ಸಲಿದೆ ೨ ಬೆಡ್ಡಲೆಸಲಗೆ ೧ ಕೊಲಗ ೧ ಮುಲಿಸಾನ್ಯನದೇವಲಿಗೆ ಗದ್ದೆಸಲಿಗೆ ೧ ಬೆದ್ದೆಲಸಲಗೆ ೧19. [Footnote 36] ಕೊಲಗೆ ೧ ಗೆಗ್ಗಾಣೆ ೧ ಕಳದಲಯ ೧ ಇಂತೀಧಮ್ಮ೯ಮಂಪ್ರತಿಪಾಲಿಸಿಸಿದವಗ೯ಗಂಗೆವಾರಣಾಸಿಗುರುಕ್ಷೇ20. [Footnote 37] ತೃಪ್ರಯಾಗತೀರ್ಥಗಳಲ್ಲಿನಾಯತೈಯಾಪೋಧಾ೯ನೆಗ್ಗುಯಿಸಾಸಿರೊಡ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣಗರಿಗೆಸಾಯಿರಕವಿ21. [Footnote 38] ತೆಯೊಂದವನಗೊಟ್ಟಫಲಮಕ್ಕು ! ಇಂತೀಧಮ್ಮ೯ ಮಂಕಡೇಸಿದೆರೈಗಸಾಯಿರತಸ್ತ್ರಯೇದನರೇಷಾಯಿರಬ್ರಹ್ಮಣಾವು22. [Footnote 39] ರಕವಿಲೆಯುವಾರಣಾಸಿಯಲ್ಲಿವಧೆವ್ಯಾನಿ ದ್ದೆಸುವಿನೋಪವಕ್ಕು || ಉಲವಂಗೊಂಬುಗವಾಪಹಬಿನಸುರಪ23. [Footnote 40] ಧ್ವಂಸಿಗಲಕ್ಮಿ ಗಂಗುಮನುಪೇಬಾಣೇದಂಛುವುಟ್ಟಿಸಿ ಜಸಮಂತಾಲ್ಗಿ ದ್ದ ೪ ದಂತಿರೀಳುತ್ತ ಮೆಯ್ಯಪ್ರೇಜಿವಗಂಪೆರಾಕ್ರಮ24. [Footnote 41] ನಿಪ್ಪಾಹೋಂಗಂಗೋಂಡಮುವ್ಯಮನುಗಂಗೋಂಡಿ ರೇವಾದಿಗೆಗೌಂಡೆದದಯಗಂಗಯ್ಯ ೦ಜಯಸಿಪ್ರಿಯಂ ॥ ತೊಂಡಿಯರ26. [Footnote 43] ಜೀವನದಿಗೌಂಡಂಗಂಭೀರವಾದಿಬಂಟರಬಾವಂಗಂಡಗುಣದೋಡಯನಡತರನಡಳಿಯುತಿಪ್ಪಸಿಗಣಾಹಸಘೀ28. [Footnote 45] ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿ ಶ್ರೀಮತ್ಮುನ್ನೆಯುಮಮಹಾಷಮಿಂತರಾಧಿಸ್ಪಾ ಯಕಂಚಮಹಾಪನಾಯುತಂತತ್ರಾಧಿಪಾತ್ಯಕಂಚಿರೋಳಿಯ29. [Footnote 46] ನಾಗಾದಹೇರಿಯಣ್ಣ ೧ಂಗಲಹಿಂಜೆನರವರಉಳುತ್ತ ಸಂಕವಸ ೧೧೧೦ ೧೧ ಪೆಲಿಧಿಲಿಸಂವತ್ಸರದಪುಷ್ಯಬಹುಳ ೧೧ ಶುಕ್ರ30. [Footnote 47] ವಾರಮಉಲತ್ಯರಾಯಣಸಂಕ್ರಾಮಣೇದಂದುಮಾಲನಸ್ಮನ್ನದೇವಿಗೀತಿಗೆಗದ್ದೆಸಲಿಗೆ ೧ ವನುಜಕ್ಕಯ್ಯದಪಂಡಿತರಸು31. [Footnote 48] ಪುತ್ರಹೊಂಬನಜೆಯಿರತ್ತೆ ಬೆಯ್ಯರಕಶಲಕಅಕ್ಕ್ಯ ಥಾರೋಪಣ್ಯಂಕರಮಾಡಿಬೆಟ್ಟಿದುತ್ತಿ ಕೂಡವಗಟ್ಟ ದಲ್ಲಿಗದ್ದೆ32. [Footnote 49]ಗಳಿಗೆ ೧ ಬಿದ್ದಲೇಕೋಳಗ ೧ ನಾವಕಮಾಲಯನಹಳ್ಳಿಯಗದ್ದೆಸಲಿಗೆ ೧ ಸಲಿಗೆ ೧ ಬಿದ್ದಲೇಕೋಳಗ ೧ ಸಿಂಹಿಸಿಗಣೆಯಗ

cells.remarks: Obeisances to S'âmbhu &c. Be it well. When, (with usual Châlukya titles), Tribhuvanamalla-Dêva’s victorious kingdom was extending on all sides, to continue as long as sun moon and stars :— Be it well. When, (with usual titles, including), the breaker of the pride of Irungôla,—with these and all other titles, the mahâ-maṇḍalêśvara, capturer of Taḷakâḍu Kongu Nangali Ganga- vâdi Noṇambavâdi Banavâse and Hânungal, Tribhuvanamalla bhujabala-Vîra-Ganga Kadamba Vishnuvarddhana Hoysaḷa Nârasimha-Dêva, putting down the evil and upholding the good in the Gangavâdi 96000 and the Noṇambavâdi 32000, was in the residence of Dôrasamudra, ruling the kingdom in peace and wisdom :— And, a dweller at his lotus feet,—entitled to the band of five chief instruments, the mahâ- sâmanta Manaleya-Nâyaka and to Nâmave-Nâyakiti was born the mahâ-sâmanta Uttama-Chôḷa, with the badge of a Ballâla, beloved of the goddess of valour, a Rêvanta to horses, (with numerous other epithets, including) plunderer of the enemies’ countries, champion over traitors to his lord, obtainer of a boon from the goddess Chaṇḍikâ, worshipper of the feet of Hoysaḷa-Dêva, considered an orna- ment to Hoysaḷa-Dêva’s camp,—the mahâ-sâmanta Uttama-Chôḷa was ruling the Noṇambanakere Twelve, Tippaṭûr, Duṇḍa and Madhure, in peace and wisdom;—His other half (with praises) was Êchilavve. To Êchilavve-Nâyakiti and to Uttama-Chôḷa was born (with prais es) Bilauve-Nâyakiti, whose son was Manaha. That Manaha-Nâyaka, (on the date specified), having set up, in the name of his father, the god Chôlêśvara,—washing the feet of Gangarâśi paṇḍita,—granted lands (specified) for the offerings and perpetual lamp for the god. Also lands (specified) for the Mâlasthâna god Kali. And for the daily enjoyment of the god Chôlêśvara he granted lands (specified) to paṇḍita-Bammapa. Also lands (specified) for the Honnudike goddess. Imprecations.

text.location: At Tiptur (Tiptur hobli), on a stone in the Kallesvara temple.
text.remarks:
Obeisances to S'âmbhu &c.

Be it well. When, (with usual Châlukya titles), Tribhuvanamalla-Dêva’s victorious kingdom
was extending on all sides, to continue as long as sun moon and stars :—

Be it well. When, (with usual titles, including), the breaker of the pride of Irungôla,—with
these and all other titles, the mahâ-maṇḍalêśvara, capturer of Taḷakâḍu Kongu Nangali Ganga-
vâdi Noṇambavâdi Banavâse and Hânungal, Tribhuvanamalla bhujabala-Vîra-Ganga Kadamba
Vishnuvarddhana Hoysaḷa Nârasimha-Dêva, putting down the evil and upholding the good in the
Gangavâdi 96000 and the Noṇambavâdi 32000, was in the residence of Dôrasamudra, ruling the
kingdom in peace and wisdom :—

And, a dweller at his lotus feet,—entitled to the band of five chief instruments, the mahâ-
sâmanta Manaleya-Nâyaka and to Nâmave-Nâyakiti was born the mahâ-sâmanta Uttama-Chôḷa, with
the badge of a Ballâla, beloved of the goddess of valour, a Rêvanta to horses, (with numerous other
epithets, including) plunderer of the enemies’ countries, champion over traitors to his lord, obtainer
of a boon from the goddess Chaṇḍikâ, worshipper of the feet of Hoysaḷa-Dêva, considered an orna-
ment to Hoysaḷa-Dêva’s camp,—the mahâ-sâmanta Uttama-Chôḷa was ruling the Noṇambanakere
Twelve, Tippaṭûr, Duṇḍa and Madhure, in peace and wisdom;—His other half (with praises) was
Êchilavve. To Êchilavve-Nâyakiti and to Uttama-Chôḷa was born (with prais es) Bilauve-Nâyakiti,
whose son was Manaha.

That Manaha-Nâyaka, (on the date specified), having set up, in the name of his father, the
god Chôlêśvara,—washing the feet of Gangarâśi paṇḍita,—granted lands (specified) for the offerings
and perpetual lamp for the god. Also lands (specified) for the Mâlasthâna god Kali. And for the
daily enjoyment of the god Chôlêśvara he granted lands (specified) to paṇḍita-Bammapa. Also
lands (specified) for the Honnudike goddess. Imprecations.

cells.location: *On a 2nd vīrakal in the same temple.* [→ At Tiptur (Tiptur hobli), on a stone in the Kallesvara temple.]
cells.dynasty: Hoysala
cells.king: Nârasimha-Dêva
cells.language: Kannada
cells.remarks: Be it well. (On the date specified), when ...... the pratâpa-chakravartti vîra-[Nârasimha- Dêva] was in the residence of Dôrasamudra, ruling the kingdom of the earth in peace and wisdom :— A dweller at his lotus feet,—Be it well. Entitled to the baud of five chief instruments, mahâ-sâmantâdhipati, (with other epithets), considered an ornament to Hoysala's camp,—-Chôlėya- Nâyaka's son Kâmeya-Nâyaka, when, by order of vira-Nârasimha-Dêva, he was marching against Bâna Kalyâna-daṇṇayaka,—the twelve crown Nâyakas of the eastern nâḍs uniting, came in anger and surrounded and attacked him,—he pierced through the line (sâlu) and slaying the principal Nâyakas, obtained the name Sâla-Kâmeyya, and gained the world of gods. His praises.

cells.remarks: Om. Obeisanced to Śiva. Obeisance to S'ambhu &c. Be it well. When, (with usual titles, including) a submarine fire to the ocean the Tulu forces, an elephant to the lotus Pândya, the capturer of Gangavâḍi Talakâḍu Koṅgu Naṅgali Noṇamba- vâḍi Banavâse Hâṇuṅgal and Uchchangi, bhujabala Vishṇuvarddhana pratâpa-Hoysaṇa Nârasinga- Dêvarasa was in the residence of Dôrasamudra, ruling the kingdom in peace and wisdom :— The Kaḍipat-thalę daṇḍâya heggaḍe Mâdimayya, in Sivura belonging to his government, (on the date specified), set up the gods Mahadeva and Chenna-Kėsava, and for their decorations and offerings, in the presence of all the subjects and farmers, made grants of land (specified). And as a gift to the âchâryya Appana-thaṭṭôpâdhyâya who consecrated those gods, washing his feet in the presence of the gods, he made over to him those two temples. Date 1174 A.D. (In the year specified), adorning the office of great minister charged with the burden of the whole kingdom, possessed of the three powers of government, counsel and energy, the royal inspector heggaḍe-Nakkanna, made a grant of land (specified) for the god Kėsava, washing the feet of âchâryya Appana-bhaṭṭôpâdhyâya. And in the same year, the Sunka-veggaḍe Mañchayya granted for the god one hand oil-mill, from which will be taken only 4 hapu as tax, and what is over be used for the god's perpetual lamp. Imprecations.

cells.text_original:
ಅದೇ ಹೋಬಳಿ ಶಿವರದ ಗ್ರಾಮದ ನಾಯಾರಣಸ್ವಾಮಿ ಈಶ್ವರದೇವನಸನ್ನಿಧಿಯಲ್ಲಿ

ತಿಪೂರು ತಾಲೂಕು
1ಶ್ರೀಮದ್ವಿಸ್ಮದ್ವತ್ನಪವತಾಪಹಯೋಸ್ಥಾನರಸಿಂಗದೇವಳಸರುದೋಲಸಮುದ್ರದನೆಲ
2ವಿಂಹಿನಲಸುವಿನಸಂತಾ ತಿನೇವೋದಿಂದರಾಜಂಗೊಯುಕ್ತ ಮ್ಮಲರುಶ್ರೀಮತುಕದಿಪಡ್ಡ ಳದಣ್ಣಾಯ
3ದಣ್ಣಗ ದೇಮಾದಿಮಯುಂಗಲುತಮ್ಯಾ ಲೈಯಸಿವೃದ್ರಲಶರ್ವಷದ ೧೧೮ ನೆಯೊಚೇತ
4ಬ್ರಾನುಸಂವತ್ಸರದಫಲಗ್ಗು ಣಾಸು ೧೩ ಬುಧವಾರದಂದುಶ್ರೀಮಹಾದೇವಿಯವಂಶೀನಂಜೇಕವೇಪದೇ
5ರರುಮಂಪತ್ರಿಪಟ್ಟ ಯಾಮದಿನಂಗೌರಭೋಗಕ್ಕಾನಿನಿವೇದ್ಯಕ್ಕಅಳಿಯಮಸಮಸ್ತ ಪ್ರಜೆಗಳೂಂಡುಗಳುಮುಂ
6ತಾತಗಿಹಿನುತ್ತೆ ಒಳಯಕೆಳಗೆಮೋದಲೇರಿಯಬೆಳ್ಳ ಗೆಆಗ, ಕೊ ೧ ದೇವರಹೊಡಪಡುವಹಟ್ಟು
7ಣಿಸೆಯೊಂಬಡಗಳುಬಿಟ್ಟು ಬಿದ್ದ ಲುವಬೆಜಕೋ ೧ ಗೆ ಕಳದೇವರೇಮೂಡಲುಹವೆಮ್ಮ ವಿನಮನರೋಹಣಗಾ
8ಗಿನವರಾಯಣದೇವರಿಗೆಪಿಚ್ಚೆ ಹೊವಿನತೋಟ ೧ ಗೆ ಆದ್ದೇವರಪೃತಿಷೆ ಮಾಡಿದೆದಚಾರ್ಯಅಪ್ಪ
9ಣಾಭಟ್ಟ ೧ ಪಾದ್ವಾಯ್ವೆಯಗೆಪ್ರ ತಿಸ್ಮೆಯದಕ್ಷಿಣೆಗೆದೇವತಾಸ್ತರದೈ ಸ್ಥಾನದಉಳುಕಾಲಂ ಕ
10ಜ್ಯೋತ್ಪಾಧಿಯೆಯಉದಯಉದೆಯದೇವಸ್ಥಾನಮ್ಯನಕೊತ್ತು ರುಏಜಯಸಂವತ್ಸರದವೃಷ್ಯಬಿ ೪ ಮಂಗ
11ಳವಾರದಲುತ್ತ ರಾಯಣಸಂಕೃಮಣದಲಸಮಸ್ತ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಭರನಿನೋಪಿತಮಹಾವಾ
12ತ್ಸವಪದವಿವಿರಾಜಮಾನವಾನನೋನೇತ್ಯ ತಪ ಭೂಮಮತೋತ್ಸಾಹಸಹಕ್ತಿ ತಾಯುಸವನ್ನ ಪಪ್ಪ
13ರಾಜಾಧ್ಯಕ್ಷಗೆಧನಕಾನ್ಯ ನುಕೇಶವದೇವಳಗಾ ಟ್ಯಯಹತ್ಯ ರಿಮೋದದೇಸೆಯಉಲಚಾಚ್ಚ್
14ಅವ್ವಣಾಭಟ್ಟ ೧ಲ್ಪಾ ಧ್ಯಯರಿಗೆಕಾಲಂಗಾಕ್ಕಿ ರ್ಧಾರೆಯೊಡಮಕೊಟ್ಟ ಗಟ್ಟ ಳ ೧
15ಆಲಿಸುನವ್ಯರದಲಸುಂಚವಗ್ಗೇ ದಮದಷ್ಟಾನುನದೇವರವರುಮೂಕಾಣಿಗಾ ೧ ಕಂ
16ನ್ನಾಲು ಹಾಣವನೆತ್ತೆಯುನೆಕ್ಕಣ್ಸ ೧ ಮ್ಯೆಲಾದುದಂಡದೇವಳರಂದದಿನಿಗೆಗೊಯೆನೆ ಗೆಲಸಿ
17ದದಮ್ಮ ೧ಮಂಪ್ರತಿಪಾಲಿ ಸುವರು || ಇಧರ್ಮ್ಯವನಾರೊಮ್ಯ್ಮಯ೯ರೂಂಪ್ರತಿಪಾಲಿಸಿನಡೆಸಿನದವರಿಗೆ
18ಪೃಥಿಗಾಗದೇವಿನಾರಾಯಣಸಲಿಲವೇದದಪಾರಗೃಪ್ರ ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮ ಣರಿಗೆ ಸಾಸಿರಕಳಿರಗಲಿದಯಾಧನಂ
19ನಾವಾಧಿಪವದವೇಪದವರು || ಇಧರ್ಮ್ಯ ವನಪಾವನಗೈ ಯೋಸ್ಕ್ಯಹ ೩ ಶಿಹಿಸಿವಂದುಮ ನಜ ತೇದಧವಾ
20ಪರಕಮ್ಮ್ಯ ೯ ಸನ್ಮ್ಯೆ ೪ ಉಜನ್ಯ ಮುಮ್ಮಹೋರಮ್ಯಪು ನರಕದಲಸ್ಮನ್ನು ॥ ಸ್ವದತ್ತ ಂವರದತ್ತ ಂವಾಲೊವೇಹರೇತಿವ
21ಸುಂದಂರಹಪ್ಪೆ ತ್ವಸ್ಥ ಪಹಸಹಶ್ರಾ ಯೋನಿನಾ ಯ್ಕಾಜಲಯತೆಯಕಿನ್ನು ॥

text.text_original: ಅದೇ ಹೋಬಳಿ ಶಿವರದ ಗ್ರಾಮದ ನಾಯಾರಣಸ್ವಾಮಿ ಈಶ್ವರದೇವನಸನ್ನಿಧಿಯಲ್ಲಿತಿಪೂರು ತಾಲೂಕು1ಶ್ರೀಮದ್ವಿಸ್ಮದ್ವತ್ನಪವತಾಪಹಯೋಸ್ಥಾನರಸಿಂಗದೇವಳಸರುದೋಲಸಮುದ್ರದನೆಲ2ವಿಂಹಿನಲಸುವಿನಸಂತಾ ತಿನೇವೋದಿಂದರಾಜಂಗೊಯುಕ್ತ ಮ್ಮಲರುಶ್ರೀಮತುಕದಿಪಡ್ಡ ಳದಣ್ಣಾಯ3ದಣ್ಣಗ ದೇಮಾದಿಮಯುಂಗಲುತಮ್ಯಾ ಲೈಯಸಿವೃದ್ರಲಶರ್ವಷದ ೧೧೮ ನೆಯೊಚೇತ4ಬ್ರಾನುಸಂವತ್ಸರದಫಲಗ್ಗು ಣಾಸು ೧೩ ಬುಧವಾರದಂದುಶ್ರೀಮಹಾದೇವಿಯವಂಶೀನಂಜೇಕವೇಪದೇ5ರರುಮಂಪತ್ರಿಪಟ್ಟ ಯಾಮದಿನಂಗೌರಭೋಗಕ್ಕಾನಿನಿವೇದ್ಯಕ್ಕಅಳಿಯಮಸಮಸ್ತ ಪ್ರಜೆಗಳೂಂಡುಗಳುಮುಂ6ತಾತಗಿಹಿನುತ್ತೆ ಒಳಯಕೆಳಗೆಮೋದಲೇರಿಯಬೆಳ್ಳ ಗೆಆಗ, ಕೊ ೧ ದೇವರಹೊಡಪಡುವಹಟ್ಟು7ಣಿಸೆಯೊಂಬಡಗಳುಬಿಟ್ಟು ಬಿದ್ದ ಲುವಬೆಜಕೋ ೧ ಗೆ ಕಳದೇವರೇಮೂಡಲುಹವೆಮ್ಮ ವಿನಮನರೋಹಣಗಾ8ಗಿನವರಾಯಣದೇವರಿಗೆಪಿಚ್ಚೆ ಹೊವಿನತೋಟ ೧ ಗೆ ಆದ್ದೇವರಪೃತಿಷೆ ಮಾಡಿದೆದಚಾರ್ಯಅಪ್ಪ9ಣಾಭಟ್ಟ ೧ ಪಾದ್ವಾಯ್ವೆಯಗೆಪ್ರ ತಿಸ್ಮೆಯದಕ್ಷಿಣೆಗೆದೇವತಾಸ್ತರದೈ ಸ್ಥಾನದಉಳುಕಾಲಂ ಕ10ಜ್ಯೋತ್ಪಾಧಿಯೆಯಉದಯಉದೆಯದೇವಸ್ಥಾನಮ್ಯನಕೊತ್ತು ರುಏಜಯಸಂವತ್ಸರದವೃಷ್ಯಬಿ ೪ ಮಂಗ11ಳವಾರದಲುತ್ತ ರಾಯಣಸಂಕೃಮಣದಲಸಮಸ್ತ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಭರನಿನೋಪಿತಮಹಾವಾ12ತ್ಸವಪದವಿವಿರಾಜಮಾನವಾನನೋನೇತ್ಯ ತಪ ಭೂಮಮತೋತ್ಸಾಹಸಹಕ್ತಿ ತಾಯುಸವನ್ನ ಪಪ್ಪ13ರಾಜಾಧ್ಯಕ್ಷಗೆಧನಕಾನ್ಯ ನುಕೇಶವದೇವಳಗಾ ಟ್ಯಯಹತ್ಯ ರಿಮೋದದೇಸೆಯಉಲಚಾಚ್ಚ್14ಅವ್ವಣಾಭಟ್ಟ ೧ಲ್ಪಾ ಧ್ಯಯರಿಗೆಕಾಲಂಗಾಕ್ಕಿ ರ್ಧಾರೆಯೊಡಮಕೊಟ್ಟ ಗಟ್ಟ ಳ ೧15ಆಲಿಸುನವ್ಯರದಲಸುಂಚವಗ್ಗೇ ದಮದಷ್ಟಾನುನದೇವರವರುಮೂಕಾಣಿಗಾ ೧ ಕಂ16ನ್ನಾಲು ಹಾಣವನೆತ್ತೆಯುನೆಕ್ಕಣ್ಸ ೧ ಮ್ಯೆಲಾದುದಂಡದೇವಳರಂದದಿನಿಗೆಗೊಯೆನೆ ಗೆಲಸಿ17ದದಮ್ಮ ೧ಮಂಪ್ರತಿಪಾಲಿ ಸುವರು || ಇಧರ್ಮ್ಯವನಾರೊಮ್ಯ್ಮಯ೯ರೂಂಪ್ರತಿಪಾಲಿಸಿನಡೆಸಿನದವರಿಗೆ18ಪೃಥಿಗಾಗದೇವಿನಾರಾಯಣಸಲಿಲವೇದದಪಾರಗೃಪ್ರ ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮ ಣರಿಗೆ ಸಾಸಿರಕಳಿರಗಲಿದಯಾಧನಂ19ನಾವಾಧಿಪವದವೇಪದವರು || ಇಧರ್ಮ್ಯ ವನಪಾವನಗೈ ಯೋಸ್ಕ್ಯಹ ೩ ಶಿಹಿಸಿವಂದುಮ ನಜ ತೇದಧವಾ20ಪರಕಮ್ಮ್ಯ ೯ ಸನ್ಮ್ಯೆ ೪ ಉಜನ್ಯ ಮುಮ್ಮಹೋರಮ್ಯಪು ನರಕದಲಸ್ಮನ್ನು ॥ ಸ್ವದತ್ತ ಂವರದತ್ತ ಂವಾಲೊವೇಹರೇತಿವ21ಸುಂದಂರಹಪ್ಪೆ ತ್ವಸ್ಥ ಪಹಸಹಶ್ರಾ ಯೋನಿನಾ ಯ್ಕಾಜಲಯತೆಯಕಿನ್ನು ॥

cells.location: On a stone in the same temple. [→ At Keregōdi (Tiptur hobli), on the dhvaja-stambha of the S'aṅkarēs'vara temple.]
cells.language: Kannada
cells.remarks: Hara-S'ankarêśvara-svâmi. May it be prosperous. Be it well. (On the date specified), at the feet of the god S'ankarêśvara of Keregôḍ, the paradêsi-ayya who was in the temple of the god Ranga of Rangâpura; for 35 years taking upon himself the restriction to a fruit diet, from the proceeds of begging, caused to be made the temple, the upper storey, the doorway, the mahânavami maṇṭapa, and two tanks, and presented them. In this service of a work of merit he was assisted by the Channarâyapaṭṭaṇa subedâr, Giriyappayya.

and a *bali-pîṭha* built for the god Chandrasêkhara, the processional form of the god S'ankarêśvara
of Keragôḍi.

cells.location: At Karadi (Tiptur hobli), on a stone in the Gôpâla-Krishna temple.
cells.dynasty: Hoysala
cells.language: Kannada and Sanskrit
cells.remarks: Obeisance to S’ambhu &c. The wearer of white garments, Vishṇu, bright as the moon, four armed, of a smiling face,—be worshipped, for the removal of all obstacles. Obeisance to the gurus. Be it well. When, (with usual titles, including) the uprooter of the Magara kingdom, the settler up of the Chôla kingdom,—the nissanka-pratâpa-Hoysaḷa vira-Sômêśvara-Dêvaḽ was in the residence of Dôrasamudra, ruling the kingdom :— A dweller at his lotus feet,—champion over the sâvantas, (with various epithets), treading down Maleya, a white elephant to Male, obtainer of a boon from the Idugûr goddess, was Karuviḍi Mâreya-Nâyaka’s son Mâreya-Nâyaka. And a crest-jewel of Yôgêndras, a bee at the lotus feet of his guru S’rîdhara-sadânanda, was Karuviḍi Narasimha-svâmi. (On the date specified), having set up the god Gôpâla, for the daily offerings and temple repairs, Mâreya-Nâyaka’s son Mâreya-Nâyaka, for his own prosperity, gave into the hands of Narasimha-svâmi the lands (specified). And the mahâ-sâvanta Karadiyahâlu Bâveya-Nâyaka’s son Dâseya-Nâyaka granted lands (specified), washing the feet of Narasimha-svâmi, for the offerings to the god Gôpâla, in order that Mâreya-Nâyaka may go to *svargga*. This work of merit is equal for all. Usual final verses. Bâvâchâri’s son Jakhôja made this. And in the year specified (name gone), Mâreya-Nâyaka gave further lands (specified) for the same god.

text.location: At Karadi (Tiptur hobli), on a stone in the Gôpâla-Krishna temple.
text.remarks:
Obeisance to S’ambhu &c. The wearer of white garments, Vishṇu, bright as the moon, four
armed, of a smiling face,—be worshipped, for the removal of all obstacles. Obeisance to the gurus.

Be it well. When, (with usual titles, including) the uprooter of the Magara kingdom, the
settler up of the Chôla kingdom,—the nissanka-pratâpa-Hoysaḷa vira-Sômêśvara-Dêvaḽ was in the
residence of Dôrasamudra, ruling the kingdom :—

A dweller at his lotus feet,—champion over the sâvantas, (with various epithets), treading down
Maleya, a white elephant to Male, obtainer of a boon from the Idugûr goddess, was Karuviḍi
Mâreya-Nâyaka’s son Mâreya-Nâyaka. And a crest-jewel of Yôgêndras, a bee at the lotus feet of his
guru S’rîdhara-sadânanda, was Karuviḍi Narasimha-svâmi. (On the date specified), having set up
the god Gôpâla, for the daily offerings and temple repairs, Mâreya-Nâyaka’s son Mâreya-Nâyaka,
for his own prosperity, gave into the hands of Narasimha-svâmi the lands (specified).

And the mahâ-sâvanta Karadiyahâlu Bâveya-Nâyaka’s son Dâseya-Nâyaka granted lands
(specified), washing the feet of Narasimha-svâmi, for the offerings to the god Gôpâla, in order that
Mâreya-Nâyaka may go to *svargga*. This work of merit is equal for all. Usual final verses.

Bâvâchâri’s son Jakhôja made this.

And in the year specified (name gone), Mâreya-Nâyaka gave further lands (specified) for the
same god.

cells.remarks: (Nâgari characters.) Obeisance to the gurus and to Gaņâdhipati. Be it well. (On the date specified), when the pratâpa-chakravartti Hoysala vira-Ballâla-Dêva- rasa was ruling the kingdom of the earth :—during the administration of the mahâ-prabhu Toya Singeya-daņņâyaka, his son ... ., placing Kêsava Dêvaņna before him,—all the Brahmans of the immemorial agrahâra Hiriya-Narasimhapura, which is Karuviði, agreeing among themselves, resolved to divide the estate equally among the families, setting up a stone in (the temple) of Hoysalêśvara. Collecting into one all the garden, wet and dry land, and all other parts of Halliyûr and Hiriyûr, they divided them into 125 shares. (Here follow details and regulations of their distribution). Boundaries. Whoso enjoying land under this śâsana transgresses these regulations is excommunicate from the thirty-two thousand and a traitor to the agrahâra. Imprecation. Signature. Whoso transgresses the regulations of this śâsana will come under the order of vira-Ballâla- Dêvarasa and of Toya Singeya-daņņâyaka.

1ಶ್ರೀಗುರುಭ್ಯೋನಮಃ | ಗಣಾಧಿಪತಯೇನಮಃಸ್ವಸ್ತಿಶ್ರೀಜ

4ತಿ೯ತ್ರಿಭುವನಮಲ್ಲಶ್ರೀವೀរបಲಾಲದೇವಿನರಸರುಪೃಥ್ವಿರಾಜ್ಯವ

6ಗೀಯದನ್ನ ಯುಕ್ತಆಭಾರಕದ್ರದಳ್ಳಿವರಮಕ್ಕಳೂ
7 . . . • ಆಳಶವರದೇವಾಣವರಮುಂತಿತುಶ್ರೀಮದನಾದಿಯಗ್ಗಕಾರಂ

10ಧಿಕೊಂಬವೆಂದುಮಾಡಿದಸ್ಥಸ್ತಿಹೊಯುಿಸಳೆಣ್ಗ ರಜೇನರಳಿಕ್ಕಳಟ್ಟುಹಳ್ಳ

12ನೂರಾಶಿನಾಡಿವೃತ್ತಿ ೧೫ಕ್ಕೆಕ್ಯೊಪಂಚಿಕ್ಕೊಂದಹಸುಗೆಯಕ ಣುತಹಳ್ಳಿ
13ಹಿರಿಯಊರೋತೋಟಗದ್ದೆಬೆಡ್ಡಲುಮನಮಂತಾದಎಲ್ಲಾಸ್ಥಾಪ್ರಿಗಳಿಗೆಸಂಬಂ
14ತ್ಕಾಗಿ ಕರಿಯಕೇರಿಯನುಸೇರ್ಪನಾಯಕರಿಗೆಆಮುಡಿತವಹವೃತ್ತಿ
15೪ | ಕೈಕೊಟ್ಟುಹಿರಿಯಉರೋನರಹೊಲದಕಟ್ಟ ವನಾಮವೃತ್ತಿ ೧೫೦ || ಕೈ
16ಸಮವಗಾರಿಹೊಚ್ಚಿಕೊಂಟುಅಳಿದಡಲ್ಲಗಳನೂವೃತ್ತಿ ೧೧೦ || ಕೈ
17ಉಳಿದದಳ್ಳಿಗಾಲನುಸಮವಾಗಿಎತ್ಕ ಕಟ್ಟಿಉಂಡಿಗಯಸಿಕ್ಕಿಹೊಂಜಿ ಕೋಂ

19 ೧೧೨ || ಮೆದಿಲಗುವದನಯಲ್ಲಿಮಗ್ಗಿ ಸೆಟ್ಟಿಯಹಳ್ಳಿಗೂದಿವೃ
20ತ್ತಿ ೯ ಸೆಟ್ಟಿಯಹಳ್ಳಿಕೂಬೈಯನಹಳ್ಳಿಗೂದಿವೃತ್ತಿ ೯ ಮೊದಲಿಯ

ತಿಪಟೂರು ತಾಲೂಕು.

23 ತ್ತಿ ೧೧ ಕೊಟಿಪಸೆಟ್ಟಿಯ ವಹಳ್ಳಿಕೊಟ್ಟಿಗೆಯಹಳ್ಳಿಗೊದಿವೃತ್ತಿ ೧೩ ಕ

25 ಯಕನಹಳ್ಳಿಯನಾಯಕರಹಳ್ಳಿಗೊದಿವೃತ್ತಿ ೪ | ಹೊಂಗಾಲದನಹಳ್ಳ್ಯ
26 ಕುಡಿಕಿಲ್ಲಹಳ್ಳಿಗೊದಿವೃತ್ತಿ ೪ | ರಾಮಗವ್ಯದನಹಳ್ಳಿಸಿ
27 ಗೆಯಹಳ್ಳಿಗೊದಿವೃತ್ತಿ ೪ | ಇಂತೀಮರಿಯಾದೆಯುಳನಯೂಸಪ್ಪ

33 ಪ್ರಹಾರಕ್ಕೆಹೊಲಿಗೆರಕೆಟಿಲಸೊಲ್ಲಗೆಅಡ್ಡ ಗಲ್ಲಹ . .

40 ಕ್ರಾ ದಿಯ ಮುಭಿ ಸುವಮುಖಿಯಶಾ ಸ ಸಮರಿಯಾದೆಯನುಅರು
41 ವೀಸಾಆವರುಮೂವತ್ತಿ ತ್ಯಾಸೀರಕೆಹೊಟಗುಗೂ ) ವುದೋತ್
42 ರುಗುಗೆಯ ತಡಿಯಲುಕಪಿತೆಯ ವಧಿಸಿದವರುಎಂಟು
43 ಯುದಕ್ಕ ಗ್ಗೆ ಹವರದಲೇಶಮಹಾಜನಂಗಳಗೆ ಶ್ರೀ ಹಸ್ಥ ದೋ

text.text_original: ಅದೇ ಗ್ರಾಮದ ಬಾವಡಿಮುಂದೆ ಇರುವಿನ ಕಲ್ಲುನಾಗರಲಿಪೀ1ಶ್ರೀಗುರುಭ್ಯೋನಮಃ | ಗಣಾಧಿಪತಯೇನಮಃಸ್ವಸ್ತಿಶ್ರೀಜ2ಯಾಭ್ಯುದಯಾಶುಕೇವಷೃಂ ೧೦೯೯ ಶ್ರೀಮುಖಸಂವತ್ಸರದವಶಾ3೧ಗೆಶಿರಶುದ್ದಪೂಣ೯ಮಿಮೇಷುವಾರದಂದುಸ್ವಸ್ತಿಶ್ರೀಮತ್ಸತಾಪಚಕ್ರವ4ತಿ೯ತ್ರಿಭುವನಮಲ್ಲಶ್ರೀವೀរបಲಾಲದೇವಿನರಸರುಪೃಥ್ವಿರಾಜ್ಯವ5ಮಾಡೂತಿದ್ದ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿಲಕ್ಷ್ಮಿನಾಥಪ್ರಭು • ತೋಯುಂಗೆ6ಗೀಯದನ್ನ ಯುಕ್ತಆಭಾರಕದ್ರದಳ್ಳಿವರಮಕ್ಕಳೂ7 . . . • ಆಳಶವರದೇವಾಣವರಮುಂತಿತುಶ್ರೀಮದನಾದಿಯಗ್ಗಕಾರಂ8ಹಿರಿಯನರಸಿಂಹಪ್ರಸಾದದಕರುಡಿಯುಶ್ರಿಮದಮಹೇಷಮಹಾಜನಂಗ9ಳತಂಬೆಎಂಳುಸರ್ವಕತಮ್ಯವಾಗಿಒಡಂಬೆಟುಕಲಕ್ಕೇ ಸಮವಾಗಿಮಾ10ಧಿಕೊಂಬವೆಂದುಮಾಡಿದಸ್ಥಸ್ತಿಹೊಯುಿಸಳೆಣ್ಗ ರಜೇನರಳಿಕ್ಕಳಟ್ಟುಹಳ್ಳ11ಯೂಊರಹಿರಿಯಉರೋತೋಟಗದ್ದೆಬೆಡ್ಡಲಬಕ್ಕಲುಮುಂತಾದವಎಲ್ಲಾಉತಗಳ12ನೂರಾಶಿನಾಡಿವೃತ್ತಿ ೧೫ಕ್ಕೆಕ್ಯೊಪಂಚಿಕ್ಕೊಂದಹಸುಗೆಯಕ ಣುತಹಳ್ಳಿ13ಹಿರಿಯಊರೋತೋಟಗದ್ದೆಬೆಡ್ಡಲುಮನಮಂತಾದಎಲ್ಲಾಸ್ಥಾಪ್ರಿಗಳಿಗೆಸಂಬಂ14ತ್ಕಾಗಿ ಕರಿಯಕೇರಿಯನುಸೇರ್ಪನಾಯಕರಿಗೆಆಮುಡಿತವಹವೃತ್ತಿ15೪ | ಕೈಕೊಟ್ಟುಹಿರಿಯಉರೋನರಹೊಲದಕಟ್ಟ ವನಾಮವೃತ್ತಿ ೧೫೦ || ಕೈ16ಸಮವಗಾರಿಹೊಚ್ಚಿಕೊಂಟುಅಳಿದಡಲ್ಲಗಳನೂವೃತ್ತಿ ೧೧೦ || ಕೈ17ಉಳಿದದಳ್ಳಿಗಾಲನುಸಮವಾಗಿಎತ್ಕ ಕಟ್ಟಿಉಂಡಿಗಯಸಿಕ್ಕಿಹೊಂಜಿ ಕೋಂ18ದಹಸೂಗಾಯಕೃಮ || ಲಾಕಿಯಹಳ್ಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿಗಳ್ಜೂಕೊಂಡಿದೃತ್ತಿ19 ೧೧೨ || ಮೆದಿಲಗುವದನಯಲ್ಲಿಮಗ್ಗಿ ಸೆಟ್ಟಿಯಹಳ್ಳಿಗೂದಿವೃ20ತ್ತಿ ೯ ಸೆಟ್ಟಿಯಹಳ್ಳಿಕೂಬೈಯನಹಳ್ಳಿಗೂದಿವೃತ್ತಿ ೯ ಮೊದಲಿಯತಿಪಟೂರು ತಾಲೂಕು.21 ಹಳ್ಳಿಯಸಣಿಸೆಟ್ಟಿಯ ಮಜ್ಜಿಗೆಗೊದಿವೃತ್ತಿ ೧ | ಬಲ್ಲೆ ಯಕೆರೆಕೆಳ್ಳ22 ಹಳ್ಳygೊದಿವೃತ್ತಿ ೧೧ ಗೀಠಕೆಯಕೆರೆಅಲಪ್ಪಿ ನವಮಜಲಹಳ್ಳಿಗೊದಿವೃ23 ತ್ತಿ ೧೧ ಕೊಟಿಪಸೆಟ್ಟಿಯ ವಹಳ್ಳಿಕೊಟ್ಟಿಗೆಯಹಳ್ಳಿಗೊದಿವೃತ್ತಿ ೧೩ ಕ24 ನಡಿಹಾಳುಚಂಡೆರೆಯನಹಳ್ಳಿಯಮುಂದುನಹಳ್ಳಿಗೊದಿವೃತ್ತಿ ೧೦ ಕೋಟೆಯನಾ25 ಯಕನಹಳ್ಳಿಯನಾಯಕರಹಳ್ಳಿಗೊದಿವೃತ್ತಿ ೪ | ಹೊಂಗಾಲದನಹಳ್ಳ್ಯ26 ಕುಡಿಕಿಲ್ಲಹಳ್ಳಿಗೊದಿವೃತ್ತಿ ೪ | ರಾಮಗವ್ಯದನಹಳ್ಳಿಸಿ27 ಗೆಯಹಳ್ಳಿಗೊದಿವೃತ್ತಿ ೪ | ಇಂತೀಮರಿಯಾದೆಯುಳನಯೂಸಪ್ಪ28 ತ್ತಿ ಯುದ್ಧವೃತ್ತಿಗಹಂಬಿಕೊಂಡೆಹುಸುಗೆಯದ್ಯದವಜಚಂದ್ರತ್ರ29 ಸ್ಥಾಯಿಯಿಂದೆತ್ತಿ ನವರಮುತ್ತು ೧೩ ದುತತ್ತಿ ನವರನುಸಂಖ್ಯಾ30 ಸ ಸಮವರ್ಣಸವನಿಲಿಲ್ಲ ಒಂದು ಬಡೆಸุล್ಲತವೊಳಗಳಿಗೆ ಆಹಾ31 ರಹಂಜಿ ಕೊಂಡುಹ ಸುಗೆಯಲುದ್ದು ವಚಆಪಲ್ಲಿ ಗಳಪ್ಪಿ ಸ32 ದ್ಧಸೀಮಾಸಂಬಂಧಣಆಕಳ್ಳ್ಯಾಗಳ ಗೆಯಣಿಕಾವಪ್ಪ. .33 ಪ್ರಹಾರಕ್ಕೆಹೊಲಿಗೆರಕೆಟಿಲಸೊಲ್ಲಗೆಅಡ್ಡ ಗಲ್ಲಹ . .34 ಉಯಿಪ್ಪೆ ತೈ ಮುಮಪ್ಪಾ ಗಕ್ಕೆ ಮಧ್ಯೆ ಕಹಳ್ಳಿಗೆಣೇ ೧೧. ಕ್ಯೆ ಕೆಮಧ್ಯಕತಮು35 ತಾಮತತ್ತೈ ನಲಿಕೆಜಾಯ ಕಟ್ಟು ವೃತ್ತರುತವಣಿಕ್ಕಾವರುಕೆಯುರುಕಟ್ಟೀ36 ಣಿ ಸೂತಿ ದದಂದದುತ್ತತಿ ನವರನಿರೆಲೋತ್ತಿ • ನಸಕ್ಕೇಆಗಲಿಗಳಿಗೆ •37 ಕೊಳಲುವಗಲುಪುನರ್ದದಲುನಡಕಮರಿಯಾದೆಯುಳಬೆಹವುಪ್ರದೆವಾದನನಾ38 ಸ್ಮಾನ .. ಕೂಡಗೆಯಿಂಡಬಹಲಿಯ ೧. ೧೩ ಕೆಮ್ಮದ್ರಕ್ | ನು39 ಡಿಗುಡಿಯಿಂದೇಮಾಸಸಮಂಧಗಳ್ಯತೋಟ .. ಹಡಿ ೧. ೧೩ ದು40 ಕ್ರಾ ದಿಯ ಮುಭಿ ಸುವಮುಖಿಯಶಾ ಸ ಸಮರಿಯಾದೆಯನುಅರು41 ವೀಸಾಆವರುಮೂವತ್ತಿ ತ್ಯಾಸೀರಕೆಹೊಟಗುಗೂ ) ವುದೋತ್42 ರುಗುಗೆಯ ತಡಿಯಲುಕಪಿತೆಯ ವಧಿಸಿದವರುಎಂಟು43 ಯುದಕ್ಕ ಗ್ಗೆ ಹವರದಲೇಶಮಹಾಜನಂಗಳಗೆ ಶ್ರೀ ಹಸ್ಥ ದೋ44 ಪ್ಪು ಶ್ರೀ ಗೋಪಿ ನಥಾಥ | ಇಂತೀಶಾಸನಮರಿಯಾದೆಯ45 ನುಅರುನಾರಿ ದಡೇಡಕ ವೃತ್ತಿ ೪ | ಶೀ ವೀ ರಬಲ್ಲಾ46 ಳದೇವಸರಾಣೇತೋಯಿಸಿಂಗಯದಣಣ್ಣಾ47 ಯಕರಣ ಮಂಗಳಮಹಾ ಶ್ರೀ ಶ್ರೀ ಶ್ರೀ

cells.location: *At Kōṭenāyakanahaḷli (Tiptur hobli), on a stone in the enclosure of the Banas'aṅkarī temple.*
cells.language: Kannada
cells.remarks: (In the year specified), a number of Bâgûr made some regulations regarding women who lapsed from marriage (unfortunately the inscription is too much defaced to make them out).
cells.text_roman:
S'ukla-samvatsaradā Jyēshṭha-śu 5 lu śrīmtu Seṭṭi ......... Hirê-Bâgura Hōte-Timma-S'eṭṭi (other
Seṭts named) ......... .................................. ent endade bâḷu-tappida heṇṇugaḷige â
heṇṇu gaṇḍanu........... dare.. ..... kasabu ........ ... maga ...... koṇḍu gaṇḍana maneya uṇṭu-
māḍyānu andare â-heṇṇu.. ...... â-mariyādiyali ẏirisuvadu â-heṇṇu yishṭaku vaḷanu andare......
.. maneya māḍabēkādare ...................nālvattu-varahava...... kaṭida.... kulada.... dolage anta sākshi
tappidava-rige kulake hanneraḍu-varahaa..... vara-hana teravu koḍal-oppidu volenu andare Hari-sa
........ ..daka ḷoragu panti-saṅkarake horagu Rāmarāy jayanti māḍiḍade ...................
.............yembattu-varaha yidake tappidavaru haddarei-samaya........................ ... āga dharma māḍi
.................. bhaktaru

Tiptur Taluq.
cells.text_original:
ಅದೇ ಹೋಬಳಿಯ ಕೋಟೇನಾಯಕನಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಬನಶಂಕರಮ್ಮನ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದ ಪ್ರಾಕಾರದಲ್ಲಿ
1ಶುಕ್ಲ ಸಂವತ್ಸರದಜೇಷ್ಠ ಶು ೪ ಲಕ್ಷ್ಮೀಮುತಸಬೆಗಯಿ . . . .
2ಹಿಲೇಕಾಗಾರಹೊಟಿತಿಯಮಸತಿಬಾಗಾಗೂಮಲ್ಲಸತಿ . . .
3ಮಲಸತಿಜಟಿಕಳನಡೇದೋಮಸತಿಜೆಂಗಿಸೆಸಿನರು ...
4ಹೊಂನವಳೆಯಸೂಲಿಸತಿಪಾದಲ್‌ಕಂಜಿಬೆಟಿಅಂಬರಮೋಡ ...
5ಮಲಸತಿಟಿಪಿಸೇಟಿಹೊದೆರಸೊಂ ... ... ... ...
6ಕನ ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...
7ಸತಿ ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...
8ವೆಂಕಟದೇವಾಲುತಷಿದಹೆಣ್ಣು ಗಳಿಗಾಹೊಂಉಗಂಡೆನು . . .
9ವರೇಕಸಬು . . . . ಮಗಾ . . . . ಕೊಂಡೆಗಂಡೆನಮು
10ನೆಯುಉಂಟುಮಾಡಾಧಾನುಆದವರೆಅಹೊಂಪು . . . ಅಮರಿಯಾದಿಯುಲಿಯಿರಿ
11ಸುವದೂಅಹೊಂಉಯಿಸುಷ್ಯ ಕುವ್ಯೊಲನುಅಂದರೆಳೆ ... ...
12ಮನೆಯುಮಾಡಬೇಕಾದರೆ . . . ವರೆವರಹ. . . ನಾಲ್ವತ್ತುನವರಹವ. ಕೆಟ್ಟದ . .
13ಕುಲದ . . . ದೊಳಗೆಅಂತಸಕ್ಷಿತೆಪ್ಪಿದವರಿಗೆಕುಲಕೆಹಂನರೆಡುವರಹಳು . .
14. ಕುಮರಹನತರೆವುಕೋಡಲೇಉಪ್ಪಿದಪುಲೈಲ್ಯುನುಅಂದರಹರಿಸ
15 . . ದಹಳೆಳಾಗುಪಂತಿ ಸಂಕರಹಕೆಹೊಳ್ಳಗುರಮಾರಯಜಯಂತಿ ನಾಡಿದಾಡೆ
16 . . . ಯೊಂಬತ್ತುವರಹಹುಡುಕಿತಪ್ಪಿದವರುಹರಿಸಮಯ . .
17 . . . ಲಾಗದಧರ್ಮವಾ . . . . . . ಭಕ್ತರು

cells.location: At Karadālu (Tiptur hobli), on a stone near the Īśvara temple.
cells.dynasty: Hoysala
cells.remarks: Obeisance to S'ambhu &c. Be it well. When, (with usual and some other titles), the mahâ-mandaleśvara Tribhuvana- malla, a spear to the heart of hostile kings, his father's warrior, Vishnuvarddhana-Biţți-Dêva's son 60 Tiptur Taluq Nârasimha-Dêva's son, Giridurggamalla, a spear to the heart of hostile chiefs, the mahâ-maṇḍa- lêśvara Ballâla-Dêva was in the residence of Dôrasamudra, ruling the kingdom of the world in peace and wisdom :- And, a dweller at his lotus feet,-a crest-jewel of sâmantas, treading down Maleya, a white elephant to Male, champion among Malapas, (with other epithets, including) guardian of the Yâdava camp, champion over feudatories with the title of Nanniga, champion over feudatories who entering the truthful Hoysana service desert it, champion over feudatories who wear their hair in a knot behind, boon lord of Idagûr-pura, the mahâ-sâmanta Hunisayya-Nâyaka's son the mahâ-sâmanta Mâchayya- Nâyaka, and (with various epithets) Sobbayya-Nâyaka's younger brother (with epithets) Bûveyya- Nâyaka were in peace and wisdom in Karaḍihâlu, ruling the kingdom of the earth ;-for the temples of the four gods Sobbêśvara, Mâchêśvara, Bammêśvara and ... svara,-(on the date specified) Bayalavâḍi .... sayya-Nâyaka, born in the Ettila-kula, and other Nâyakas (named),-washing the feet of (with the usual ascetic virtues), the obtainer of a boon from the goddess Sâradâ, the âchâr- yya who was a moon to the Kâḷamukhas, Banavâse-nâḍ Kiruvaḍe Bamma-jiya's son Gangarâsi-jiya,- made grants of land (specified). And mahâ-sâmanta Bûveyya's father-in-law Bammeya-Nâyaka having made a temple in his village, granted for it lands (specified). Imprecations. The writing of Bamma-jiya, son of Gangarâsi, of the Karaḍihâlu mûlasthâna. Maliyôja's son, the sculptor Bammôja engraved the letters.

ಅದೇ ಹೋಬಳಿ ಕರಡಾಲುಗ್ರಾಮದ ಈಶ್ವರದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದಬಳಿಕೆ
1ನಮಸ್ತುಂಗಶಿರಸ್ಸಂಗಚಂದ್ರಾಮರಚಾರವೇತ್ರೈ ಲೋಕ್ಯನಗರಾರಂಭ . :

3ಶಬ್ದಮಹಾಮಂಡಲೇಶ್ವರದ್ದಾರಾವತೀಪುರವರಾಧೀಶ್ವರ
4ಯಾದವಕುಲಾಂಬರಸಮುದ್ಯತ್ಚೂಡಾಮಣಿಮಂಡಲೇಕಜೂಡಾವ
5ಸಹಾಯದಕುಲಕಳತಿಪಕುಲಹವೃಮ್ಮೂಲಸ್ತಂಭಒನಪತಿ
6ಹಿತನಿಜಿತ್ವಿಜಯಾ . . ಶಪಕಪುರನಿವಾಸವಾಸುಸಂತಿಕಾರದೇ
7ನಿಲುವಚ್ಛ ವರಪ್ರಸಾದಶ್ರೀಮನು . .
8ಅಗ್ನಿಗರಮಗ್ಗ . . . . . ಗ್ರಾಮಮಂಡಲಕಣೇ
9ಅಕ್ಕಳಿಸಸಹಜದೆಲಬು . . ಸಮು . . ಮು . ಪ್ರಸಂತ
10ಗಿಗಿಮಗ್ಗ ೯ಮಲಂಸನೀವಾರಸಿದ್ಧಿಅಸಹಾಯಶೌರ್ಯ್ಯಶ್ರೀಸೆಪಣ್ಣಹಾ
11ಮುಂದಳೇಸ್ವರ್ತಪ್ರಿಭುವನಮಲ್ಲಅಭಿರೂಪಾಲಹವೃದಯಸೇಲಪ್ಪನಂ
12ಕಕಾಆಚೆಲದಂಕರಾವ . . . . . ವಿಷ್ಣು ವಧ್ಧ ನಬಿಟ್ಟೆ
13ದೇವನಸೂನುನವಾರಸೋಹೇವದೇವನೃಪತಿಗಿರಿದುಗ್ಗ ೯ಮಲ್ಲಾಠಿಲಂ
14ದಳೇಕಾಫಿಪ್ರೆಯಸellಶ್ರೀಮನು ಹಾಮಂಡಲೇಶ್ವರಬಲ್ಲಾಳದೇ ವದೋರ
15ಸಮುದ್ರದವನಲವಲಿದೆನಸುಸುಖಸಂಕರದವಿನೋರಡೊಂಪಿತ್ಸೆರ
16ಜ್ಯಂಗಯುತ್ಸೆತ್ರೇ || ತತುಪಾದೋಪಸೇಜವಿನಸಮಂತಚೂಡಾಮಣಿಮಳೆ
17ಯತೋತ್ರೇ ಲಮದಲಮಚಿಗೆಬಿಲ್ಲಾನ್ಯನಮಲಪರೆಳೊಗಂದನುಡಿದಂತೆ

1ಗಂಡೆಪದಮಿಜ್ಜೆಗೆ ಗಂಡೆಯದವಕಟಕದಕ್ಷ್ಮಾಲ... ಕಟ್ಟಿ ತೊಳೇಟಬೀ
2ಸುನಪವಿನಂಸ _ರಾಂದನನಿಗರಬೆರುದೇವಸಾಮಾಮಂತ್ರಗಂಡಹೋರಣಾನಂ
3ನಿಯುಚಾರದಲಪೋಕ್ತಹೋಊವದವಶಾವಮನ್ನ _ಗಂಡಮಂಡೆ . ಯುಹಿಂತೆ
4ತುಟುಬ್ಯುಲ್ಲಸಾಮಂನ್ನ _ರಗಂಡೆದಡುಗೂರಪುದವರ:ಧೀಸ್ಪರಶ್ರೀಮನ್ನಹಸಾಮ
5ನ್ಯ_ಹುಣಿಶಸ್ಮ್ಯನಾಯಕರಥ್ಷಗೀತ್ರಪಪತ್ರವರಂಗನಾಪತ್ರಶ್ರೀಮಮ್ಮ ಹಸಾಮಾ
6ಮಂನ್ನ _ದಾಸಯ್ಯನಾಯಕರಸೂನುಮಹಾಪಾಮನ್ನ _ವಜೆಯ್ಯನಾಯಕರ
7ಆರಿದಾಮಂನ್ನ_ಪಭುಸಪ್ಯೀರ್ಬರುದನಸಾಮಂನ್ನ _ಬೆರೊಂದೆ . . . ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ _ ಹೀಯೇದ೧ಗೆಳ
8ಸೊಬಯ್ಯನಾಯಕರನುಜಮಹಾಪಾಮಣ್ಣ _ರಾಥ್ಹಾಳಸದಭೇರುಂಡಕದನವಣ್ಣಂ
9ದಪಮಹಾಪಾಮಣ್ಣ_ಜತುಮ್ಯ್ಕರ್ಮಮಹಾಪಾಮಂತಬೊಮ್ಮಯ್ಯನಾಯಕರಸುಕಹೆಂ
10ಕತಾವಿನೋಂದದಿಂಕದಿರಹಾಲುಪವತ್ರಿ_ರಾಜ್ಯಂಗೆಯ್ಯುತ್ತಿಕೆ || ಸೂಪೇಷ್ಠ _ಸ್ಕರವೇದಗ್ಗಳ _ ರವಾಜೇ
11ಸ್ವರದೇ(ವಗೇ)೨ಬಮ್ಮಿ _ಸ್ವರದೇವಗೇ೧೯ . . ಸ್ವರದೇಮಗೇ_ಕಯ್ಯಾಂತಿಣಲ್ಯುವದೇವಪಾಲಾಕಸಕವ
12ರಿಸಾಸಾನಿರನತೂಂಭತೂಂಭತ್ಥ್ಯ _ನೇ(ವಿರೋಧಿ ಸಂವತ್ಸರಡಜ್ಜ್ಯಕ್ಷ)ಸುದ್ದಬಿದಿಗಿಅದಿವಾರದಂದು
13ಅದ್ದೇವರಂಗಲಅಲ್ಲಿಜಾನ್ಯ _ಸ್ಪಸ್ತಿ_ಯುವಮಿನಮ್ಯನಪಧ್ಯಾಧ್ಯಾಯನದಾರಉಣಮಾಣನಮವಾನ್ಯಾಜ
14ಪಸನವದಿ . . . ಸಸಸ್ಯ _ನಾರವಾದವೀಚಿಉಟ್ಯ_ವರವ್ಯಸಾಡಶ್ರೀ (ಮದಾಸಾಚಾರ್ಯ್ಕಕಳಾಮುಖಿಕವ
15ಳಾಯಬಾಣ್ಠವವನಾಸನಾದಕಿಉನವಕೆಯಮಂಬಜೀೆಯರಮಗಂಗ[೧೫]ಗೇರಾಸೀಜೇ
16ಯ್ಯಂಗಲಕ_ರಾಯಾನಸಕತ್ಯಮಣಪೇಷ್ಠೆಸ್ವರಪದಮದುಎಕಟ್ಟಿಲಕುಟೇಡ್ಯವಬುಳವವಾಡಿ
17೪ . ಸಯ್ಯನಾಯಕರು . ಮೈಯ್ಯನಾಯಕರುಬವಮ್ಯನಾಯಕರು . ಕಾಲಂಕರಜ್ಜಿ
18ಧಾರಾರಪ್ರಿಮ್ಯ್ಕಕಂವಂಡಿಬಿಟ್ಟಪದ್ಧಿ _ಎಂತೇದಮನ್ನು ಬಾಳಉಳಿಯಿರಿಕಳಿಯುನಡು
19ಬಯಲಆರಲೆಯಿಂದಬಡಗೆಕಲಡಹಪುಸಲಗೆ ಎರಡುಕಡೇಹಿಂದೆಂತಕಾಅಟೀ
20 . . ದಹಸಲಿಗೆಎಡಕ೯ಲಗಳಸಕ್ಷ್ಯ ಅಆಹಸಿಂಹೆತಕುಹಿಯುಹದಕಸ
21ಉಲಗಮೂಲಅಕಡಹಿಂಎತಂಕಚೋಳೇತ್ಯ್ಪರಡೇವಗೆ ೯ಸಹಸಿಂಸೆಯ್ಯಬೀಟ್ಯಸಲಗಿಬೆಂದುಅಂತ
22ಮನಬಾಳಉಬಯಲರ . ಕೋ ೧೦ ಊರಮುಂದಣಕೇಳೆಯುತೇಕರಕರಿಯಕೇಜೆಯನೋಗಳಿಗೆ .
23ಯುಬೆಡ್ಡತಿಮತ್ವ_ಲುಮಮೂಲೂಉಗರಿಂದಬಡಗೆಯುಬಯಲಬೀಬೆಡ್ಡತೇಕುಳಿಗಹತ್ಪದೇ
24ವರದೀವಿগেಕಟುಿಗಾಣಮಹಾಮಹಾನಾ _ಬೂವಯ್ಯ ನಮಾವಬಂಮೆಯನಾಯಕ
25ತೇನಸಹಲಿಮದ್ವೇಲೀಯವಣಾಬಿಟ್ಟಪದ್ಧಿ _ಮೋದಲೇಅರಯಗ್ಗದೇ ಸಲಗಮ್ಮೂಟೂಚಿದ್ದಲೆ .
26 . ಜೀಯಮುಂವದಾ೯ಕೋಡಿಸಗ ಯಂ೧ತೆಧವ್ಯ _ಮೂನಸದಿದವರುಗಂಗೆಯತಡಿ
27ಯುಸನಾಸಿರಬಹ್ಯ್ಹಾರಿಗಸಾಸಿಕವಿತೆಲುದಾನವಮಾದಿಫಲಊಳಾಧಮ೯ವಕ೯ದಿಸಿ
28ದವರಿಗೆಂಗೆಯತಡಿಯುನಾಸಿರಬ್ರಹ್ಮ _ಹಾರಿಡಾಸೀರಕವಿತೆಯುಳೇ೧೮ದೂಸಿನಸ್ತದತ್ವಂ
29ಪರದತ್ವ_ವ್ವಾಳಯೇಹರೇತುವಸುಂಧರಾಸಹಪ್ಪಿ _ವರಿವಸಹಸ್ರಬ್ರೇಣಿಯುತ್ತಿ .
30 * ಜಾಯತೇಕೃನಿ || ಕರಡಿಸಿಹಾಳಮುಲಸ್ಮಾನ _ನಡಗಣಗರಸಿಯಮಂಗಂಬಂ .
31_ಬಿಯುಬಯನರಪವಲೀಯೋಜ್ಜಮನುಗೂರವಿಬೋಂವಜ್ಯೋಹೋಯಿದಅಕ್ಷ .

text.location: At Karadālu (Tiptur hobli), on a stone near the Īśvara temple.
text.remarks:
Obeisance to S'ambhu &c.

Be it well. When, (with usual and some other titles), the mahâ-mandaleśvara Tribhuvana-
malla, a spear to the heart of hostile kings, his father's warrior, Vishnuvarddhana-Biţți-Dêva's son

60                               Tiptur Taluq

Nârasimha-Dêva's son, Giridurggamalla, a spear to the heart of hostile chiefs, the mahâ-maṇḍa-
lêśvara Ballâla-Dêva was in the residence of Dôrasamudra, ruling the kingdom of the world in peace
and wisdom :-
    And, a dweller at his lotus feet,-a crest-jewel of sâmantas, treading down Maleya, a white
elephant to Male, champion among Malapas, (with other epithets, including) guardian of the Yâdava
camp, champion over feudatories with the title of Nanniga, champion over feudatories who entering
the truthful Hoysana service desert it, champion over feudatories who wear their hair in a knot behind,
boon lord of Idagûr-pura, the mahâ-sâmanta Hunisayya-Nâyaka's son the mahâ-sâmanta Mâchayya-
Nâyaka, and (with various epithets) Sobbayya-Nâyaka's younger brother (with epithets) Bûveyya-
Nâyaka were in peace and wisdom in Karaḍihâlu, ruling the kingdom of the earth ;-for the temples
of the four gods Sobbêśvara, Mâchêśvara, Bammêśvara and ... svara,-(on the date specified)
Bayalavâḍi .... sayya-Nâyaka, born in the Ettila-kula, and other Nâyakas (named),-washing the
feet of (with the usual ascetic virtues), the obtainer of a boon from the goddess Sâradâ, the âchâr-
yya who was a moon to the Kâḷamukhas, Banavâse-nâḍ Kiruvaḍe Bamma-jiya's son Gangarâsi-jiya,-
made grants of land (specified).
    And mahâ-sâmanta Bûveyya's father-in-law Bammeya-Nâyaka having made a temple in his
village, granted for it lands (specified). Imprecations.
    The writing of Bamma-jiya, son of Gangarâsi, of the Karaḍihâlu mûlasthâna.
    Maliyôja's son, the sculptor Bammôja engraved the letters.

ಸಮಧಿഗതಪಂಚಮಹಾ3ಶಬ್ದಮಹಾಮಂಡಲೇಶ್ವರದ್ದಾರಾವತೀಪುರವರಾಧೀಶ್ವರ4ಯಾದವಕುಲಾಂಬರಸಮುದ್ಯತ್ಚೂಡಾಮಣಿಮಂಡಲೇಕಜೂಡಾವ5ಸಹಾಯದಕುಲಕಳತಿಪಕುಲಹವೃಮ್ಮೂಲಸ್ತಂಭಒನಪತಿ6ಹಿತನಿಜಿತ್ವಿಜಯಾ . . ಶಪಕಪುರನಿವಾಸವಾಸುಸಂತಿಕಾರದೇ7ನಿಲುವಚ್ಛ ವರಪ್ರಸಾದಶ್ರೀಮನು . .8ಅಗ್ನಿಗರಮಗ್ಗ . . . . . ಗ್ರಾಮಮಂಡಲಕಣೇ9ಅಕ್ಕಳಿಸಸಹಜದೆಲಬು . . ಸಮು . . ಮು . ಪ್ರಸಂತ10ಗಿಗಿಮಗ್ಗ ೯ಮಲಂಸನೀವಾರಸಿದ್ಧಿಅಸಹಾಯಶೌರ್ಯ್ಯಶ್ರೀಸೆಪಣ್ಣಹಾ11ಮುಂದಳೇಸ್ವರ್ತಪ್ರಿಭುವನಮಲ್ಲಅಭಿರೂಪಾಲಹವೃದಯಸೇಲಪ್ಪನಂ12ಕಕಾಆಚೆಲದಂಕರಾವ . . . . . ಅವೇ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದಬಲ ವೀರಕಲ್ಲು

^1ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿ ಸಮಸ್ತಭ್ಯುದಯಕಶವರಷ ೧೩೧೧ ನೆಯಸಿದ್ಧಾರ್ಥಿ೯ ಸಂ
^2ವತ್ಸರದಕತ್ತ೯ಜಸು ೧೪ ಸೋಂ | ದುಂದುಮಲೆರಾಜರಾಜಮಪರೊಂ
^3ಲಗೊಂದೆರಾಯಹಲೆಯರಾಯಗಂಡೆಬೆಲಂದ್ರೆ ಕ್ರೀ೯ಣೆನೀರಾರಂ
^4ಹದೇವಿವನುವಾರಕಿಲೈಣೀರಬಲಲ್ಯಾಲದೇವ್ಯರಪ್ಪುತೀ೯ರಾಜ್ಯಂಗೆ
^5ಯುತ್ತಿ ಕೀ ! ತತವಾದೂರ್ಪಜೇವಿಶೆಮಂತಚೆಹೊಡಮಣಿಮಲೆಯು
^6ತೊತ್ತ ಅದuhವಮಳಗೆಬೆಲ್ಯಾನಮಲಪರೊಲುಂಗಂದಿನುದಿದಂ
^7ತಂಗಂವಡಹಿಮೆಪ್ಪೆ ಗಂಡೆಯಾದವಕಟಕರಕ್ಷಾಪಾಲಕಣಡೆಗೂರು
^8ಪೂತವರಾಧಿಷ್ಯಕರಕಡಿಕಾಲಳದಟಮ . . ನಾಯ್ಯನಮಗಳೆರಮನಾ
^9ಯ್ಯನು, ರಕಕಾನಮಲ್ಲಿ . ಕಮರುಣಸ . . ಕಹತಿ ಬಟ್ಟೆಳಕಾಡಿ
^10ಕೋದೆನಯುದಿನ . . ಬಿದ್ದು ದೃವಗ್ಗಸ್ತ್ರನಾದ ! ಕಲಕಲಿತಾಳಿಬೆಸಿಜೆ
^11ದವನಾವಂತರಗಂೆದಿನಿನಗೆ . ಬ್ಭುದಿಂಸಾವಂತರಗಂಡ !

cells.location: Tiptur taluk, Tumkur district
cells.remarks: (With praises), the mahâ-sati Haryyale, at the time of her death, called her son Bûvaya- Nâyaka, and said,-Even in your dreams think not of me, but think of dhamma. Always perform dharmma, for by so doing you will reap the rewards (named)-thus Bûvaya-Nâyaka do I beseech you. That both I and you may obtain boundless merit, make a Jina temple, Bûvi-Dêva. Always honour the friends of my god, and take special care of your junior uncle. After this, anointing Jina- pati, she received the sandal water, with the resolve to wash away all her sins. Then, in the presence of the feet of Jinêndra, repeating with a loud voice the five words without forgetting them, breaking the net of all desires by which she was surrounded,-so that all the people in the world applauded, the woman Haryyale, by means of the tomb, entered the Indra-lôka. Hearing of her arrival, the celestial nymphs of the city of the immortals came forth, adorned her with garlands and jewels, and invited her to mount the car of glory. And bearing her along with songs and music and waving of châmaras, she thus made her entry into the Surêndra-lôka. Tiptur Taluq

cells.dynasty: Hoysala
cells.language: Kannada and Sanskrit
cells.remarks: Having the honourable supreme profound *syâd-vâda* as a fruit-bearing token, it may prevail, the doctrine of the lord of the three worlds, the Jina doctrine. Be it well. When (with usual Chalukya titles) Bhûlôkamalla Sômêśvara-Dêva's victorious kingdom was extending &c :— Descended in the family born to Tribhuvanamalla Ereyanga-Hoysala-Dêva and to Êchala-Dêvi,— Be it well. When (with usual titles) the nissanka-pratâpa-bhujabala-chakravartti Vira-Ballâla-Dêva was ruling the kingdom of the world ;— A dweller at his lotus feet,—to the mahâ-sâmanta Gaṇarâditya and to Huggiyavve-Nâyakitti were born the sâmantas Subbaya, Sâtayya, and Bavayya. ____________________ 1 This is the date in the original, but it belongs to the time of Vinayâditya (see No. 105 below) and not to that of his son Ballâla (1101-1104) nor to that of Bhûlôkamalla (1126-1138). 62 Tiptūr Taluq Praisers of the mahâ-sâmanta Mâchayya, among whose epithets are—entitled to the band of five chief instruments, obtainer of a boon from the Idagûr goddess, causing the Yerttila forest to blossom, worshipper of the feet of Hoysala-Dêva, his father's lion (*ayyana singa*), treader down of Maleya, a white elephant to Male. Mahâ-sâmanta Mâchayya's descent was as follows;—Belugere Mâcheya- Nâyaka's matchless jewel (or wife) Mâkala-Dêvi, besides being noted for her gifts, had erected a chaitya which was a fit ornament to the city. Mâreya-Nâyaka's wife Banniyavve, who can rightly describe? Praisers of the Belugere ballan (or able man), Immaḍi Balla. His other halves were Kêtave and Dêviyakka. When sâmanta Baili-Dêva, with his other halves Kêtave-Nâyakiti and Dêviyakka-Nâyakiti, and their sons Suyya-Dêva, perumâlu-Dêva, Mârayya and Mâchi-Dêva were ruling the kingdom in peace and wisdom;—Delighting in gifts of shelter and food from the desire to secure the Lakshmi of *mōksha*, Sâsala Samayya was a glory of the Bhavyas (or Jains) in the world. The eldest son Mânikya, Jâki-Setti his younger brother and Erakâṭi-Seṭti, these three men were celebrated as wishing-stones in making gifts. Mâchi-Seṭti was learned in logic and grammar, able in commen- tating, supremely wise in all the sayings of the scriptures, and celebrated for devoting wealth to works of piety. Mâchi-Seṭti's younger brother Kâli-Seṭti was his equal in liberality. Kâli-Seṭti's son Bammayya in bestowing money and clothes was like the tree of plenty. May Jinêsa grant him happi- ness. Other Seṭṭis praised. Also the crest-jewel of the line of gaṇadharas, Mânikanandi-dêva. (On the date specified), for the Nakhara Jinâlaya were granted lands (specified), the dues on 10 loads from the god's endowment brought into the city, and for oil for the lamps 1 oil mill. Imprecation. Of the śri-Mûla-sangha, Dêsiya-gaṇa, Postaka-gachha, and Koṇḍakundānvaya, was Nâgachan- dra-Chândrâyaṇa-dêva's disciple Ṛuṇikachbagoṇḍi-dêva; his wife was Boppave, his children Kâchave, Mallave, Mâdave, Mâchave and Bilachandara-dêva. Certain Seṭṭis made further grants of land. Roḍa Halôja's son Birôja engraved this śâsana.¹ Footnote 1. This is the date in the original, but it belongs to the time of Vinayâditya (see No. 105 below) and not to that of his son Ballâla (1101-1104) nor to that of Bhûlôkamalla (1126-1138).

text.remarks:
Having the honourable supreme profound *syâd-vâda* as a fruit-bearing token, it may prevail,
the doctrine of the lord of the three worlds, the Jina doctrine.

Be it well. When (with usual Chalukya titles) Bhûlôkamalla Sômêśvara-Dêva's victorious
kingdom was extending &c :—

Descended in the family born to Tribhuvanamalla Ereyanga-Hoysala-Dêva and to Êchala-Dêvi,—
Be it well. When (with usual titles) the nissanka-pratâpa-bhujabala-chakravartti Vira-Ballâla-Dêva
was ruling the kingdom of the world ;—

A dweller at his lotus feet,—to the mahâ-sâmanta Gaṇarâditya and to Huggiyavve-Nâyakitti
were born the sâmantas Subbaya, Sâtayya, and Bavayya.

____________________
1 This is the date in the original, but it belongs to the time of Vinayâditya (see No. 105 below) and not to that of his son
Ballâla (1101-1104) nor to that of Bhûlôkamalla (1126-1138).

62	Tiptūr Taluq

Praisers of the mahâ-sâmanta Mâchayya, among whose epithets are—entitled to the band of five
chief instruments, obtainer of a boon from the Idagûr goddess, causing the Yerttila forest to blossom,
worshipper of the feet of Hoysala-Dêva, his father's lion (*ayyana singa*), treader down of Maleya,
a white elephant to Male. Mahâ-sâmanta Mâchayya's descent was as follows;—Belugere Mâcheya-
Nâyaka's matchless jewel (or wife) Mâkala-Dêvi, besides being noted for her gifts, had erected a
chaitya which was a fit ornament to the city. Mâreya-Nâyaka's wife Banniyavve, who can rightly
describe? Praisers of the Belugere ballan (or able man), Immaḍi Balla. His other halves were Kêtave
and Dêviyakka.

When sâmanta Baili-Dêva, with his other halves Kêtave-Nâyakiti and Dêviyakka-Nâyakiti,
and their sons Suyya-Dêva, perumâlu-Dêva, Mârayya and Mâchi-Dêva were ruling the kingdom in
peace and wisdom;—Delighting in gifts of shelter and food from the desire to secure the Lakshmi
of *mōksha*, Sâsala Samayya was a glory of the Bhavyas (or Jains) in the world. The eldest son
Mânikya, Jâki-Setti his younger brother and Erakâṭi-Seṭti, these three men were celebrated as
wishing-stones in making gifts. Mâchi-Seṭti was learned in logic and grammar, able in commen-
tating, supremely wise in all the sayings of the scriptures, and celebrated for devoting wealth to
works of piety. Mâchi-Seṭti's younger brother Kâli-Seṭti was his equal in liberality. Kâli-Seṭti's son
Bammayya in bestowing money and clothes was like the tree of plenty. May Jinêsa grant him happi-
ness. Other Seṭṭis praised. Also the crest-jewel of the line of gaṇadharas, Mânikanandi-dêva.

(On the date specified), for the Nakhara Jinâlaya were granted lands (specified), the dues on 10
loads from the god's endowment brought into the city, and for oil for the lamps 1 oil mill.

Imprecation.

Of the śri-Mûla-sangha, Dêsiya-gaṇa, Postaka-gachha, and Koṇḍakundānvaya, was Nâgachan-
dra-Chândrâyaṇa-dêva's disciple Ṛuṇikachbagoṇḍi-dêva; his wife was Boppave, his children Kâchave,
Mallave, Mâdave, Mâchave and Bilachandara-dêva.

Certain Seṭṭis made further grants of land.
Roḍa Halôja's son Birôja engraved this śâsana.¹

cells.remarks: Be it well. (On the date specified), when Satyavâkya-Kongunivarmma-dharmma-mahârâjâdhi- râja, boon lord of Kôlâla-pura, lord of Nandagiri, chalad-uttaranga, the Noḷambakulântaka, orî- mat Permmânaḍigal, having slain all the Noḷambas, was ruling the Ninety-six Thousand:— Voparasa ruling the Maṇḍa .. dhikâra-maṇḍala;—the crown-.... Gâvaga-arasa having paid a visit to Belgere, made a grant of the *bittuvaṭṭa*. Imprecations. The stone was written by Gâvayya's sênabôva Kâmayya. Kambayya-gauṇḍa engraved it. 104² Date 1130 A.D. Obeisance to S'ambhu &c. Be it well. When, (with usual Chalukya titles), Bhûlōkamalla-Somêśvara-Dêva's victorious king- dom was extending &c:— Tiptur Taluq 68 To Tribhuvanamalla Ereyanga-Poysala-Dêva and Echala-Dêvi was born Vishnuvarddhana- Dêva. Be it well. When (with usual titles), the mahâ-mandalêśvara, the capturer of Talakâdu, bhujabala-Vira-Ganga Poysala-Dêva, putting down the evil and upholding the good in the Gangavâdi Ninety-six Thousand, was ruling the kingdom in peace and wisdom;— A dweller at his lotus feet,—to the mahâ-sâmanta Gandarâditya and to Huliyave-Nâyakitti were born the sâmantas Subayya, Sântayya and Bûvayya. Praises of the mahâ-sâmanta Mâch- ayya (as in No. 101 above). The mahâ-sâmanta Mâchiyayya having ruled in peace Arakere, Kâli- gunda, Beluvali, Karividi, Hinchanûr, MannamBâru, Karadihâlu, Alariguppe, Kundûr, Bâlasam- udra, Idagûr, Patana, and Belugere, which he had as his residence (bidike), gained the Sîva-lôka. Be it well. The mahâ-sâmanta, beloved of the Lakshmi of valour, to horses a Rêvanta, to hostile armies Kritânta, beloved by the good, hymned by the learned, referenced by the groups of chiefs, a refuge for all people, his father's scimitar, skilful with both forces, self-sufficient hero, a bee at the lotus feet of Bitti-Dêva, his head at the feet of Sîva,—the mahâ-sâmanta Gandarâditya ruling in peace,—(on the date specified), at the time an eclipse of the sun,—washing the feet of Sîva-pandita's son Sakalêśvara-pandita,—made for the god Mâchêśvara a grant of lands (specified), two oilmills, and a bittuvalta of five ploughs on a khanduga of rice-land for the tank. Imprecations. To Mûka-gavunda and Bamma-gavunda was born (with praises) hergade Mayinda. Champion over the crowds at the palace, champion over those who praise themselves, he performed the funeral rites, and set up (the god) Mâchêśvara,-the hergale Mayindayya, to endure as long as sun and moon, Vinayâditya-bhatta's son Honnâdimayya wrote this. The Karividi goldsmith Huliyâchâriya's son Jakôja's work... .... Date 1078 A.D. Obeisance to S'ambhu &c. Be it well. When, (with usual Châlukya titles), Tribhuvanamalla-Permmâdi-Dêva was ruling the kingdom :— Be it well. (On the date specified),—when, entitled to the band of five chief musical instruments, the mahâ-mandalêśvara, boon lord of Dvârâvati-pura, champion among the great Malapas, Vinayâ- ditya-Hoysala-Dêva was ruling the Gangavâdi Ninety-six Thousand ;— A dweller at his lotus feet,—Be it well. Entitled to the band of five chief instruments, the mahâ-sâmanta Gandarâditya was ruling Arakere, Kâligunda, Karivide, Belugere, Kundûr, Bâlasa- mudra, .... gumane and Avâlu. Date 1107 A.D. To him was born a son, the glory of the Ettila-kula, (with numerous epithets, mostly like those of his father in No. 104 above), the mahâ-sâmanta Sântayya, (who (on the date specified) set up the god Sântêśvara, and washing the feet of his guru Rudrasiva-pandita, made for it grants of land (specified). Imprecation. When Belugere.. taya was ruling the kingdom in peace and wisdom ;—he had (the tank) widened and granted the bittuvaltam. Imprecation. The mahâ-sâmanta Sântayya's hadapala Bumayya's son hadavala Baumayya wrote this. Kêtaya Mâlappa's stone-worker's performance and skill are imperishable. Sântiya's stainless beauty, and Bammiyaka's writing,—how rare are they in the world. The stone is now in the Victoria Jubilee Institute at Mysore. Tiptur Taluq Be it well. cells.location: At *Hāḷukurki* (*kasaba hobli*), on a copper plate in *possession of Nañjappanavara Krishnappa*.
cells.king: Krishṇa-Râja-Vadeyaraiya
cells.language: Kannada and Sanskrit
cells.remarks: May it be prosperous. Invocation of the Boar. Obeisanc to S'ambhu &c. Be it well. (On the date specified) the râjâdhirâja râja-paramêśvara apratima-prauḍha- pratâpa vira-narapati Mahiśûr Krishṇa-Râja-Vadeyaraiya caused to be written and given to Râmaiya a copper śâsana of a deed of sale and gift of land as follows ;—Whereas you have applied that the village of Yerehaḷḷi and its pond, in the Hâluḳurike-hôbali of the Honnavalli-sthala attached to the hôbaḷi-vichâra-châvaḍi of Paṭṭaṇa, may be sold and granted to you,—and according to the accounts written by Veṅkaṭramaṇaiya, śânabhâga of the vichâra-châvaḍi, the revenue derived from it in the year Pramâthi (1759 A.D.) on the rēkkhe of wet and dry land, Gûlûr ga 17, and the money dues, grain dues, customs and pommu, amounted altogether to 28 varaha 7 haṇa,—and whereas you have paid into the treasury through the merchant Narasimba-Dâsu the mortgage, the full estimated value, 287 varaha,—this Yerehaḷḷi village is made over to you as a gift by deed of sale, and all the eight rights of possession within its boundaries belong to you,—and as mortgage, bequest, exchange or disposal of it in future belongs to you, you may enjoy it to sons and posterity without hindrance, free of all imposts, in permanence. Usual final verses. (signed)—Śrî-Krishṇa-Râja. Tiptur Taluq 85

text.location: At *Hāḷukurki* (*kasaba hobli*), on a copper plate in *possession of Nañjappanavara Krishnappa*.
text.remarks:
May it be prosperous. Invocation of the Boar. Obeisanc to S'ambhu &c.
Be it well. (On the date specified) the râjâdhirâja râja-paramêśvara apratima-prauḍha-
pratâpa vira-narapati Mahiśûr Krishṇa-Râja-Vadeyaraiya caused to be written and given to Râmaiya
a copper śâsana of a deed of sale and gift of land as follows ;—Whereas you have applied that the
village of Yerehaḷḷi and its pond, in the Hâluḳurike-hôbali of the Honnavalli-sthala attached to
the hôbaḷi-vichâra-châvaḍi of Paṭṭaṇa, may be sold and granted to you,—and according to the
accounts written by Veṅkaṭramaṇaiya, śânabhâga of the vichâra-châvaḍi, the revenue derived from
it in the year Pramâthi (1759 A.D.) on the rēkkhe of wet and dry land, Gûlûr ga 17, and the
money dues, grain dues, customs and pommu, amounted altogether to 28 varaha 7 haṇa,—and
whereas you have paid into the treasury through the merchant Narasimba-Dâsu the mortgage, the full estimated
value, 287 varaha,—this Yerehaḷḷi village is made over to you as a gift by deed of sale, and all
the eight rights of possession within its boundaries belong to you,—and as mortgage, bequest,
exchange or disposal of it in future belongs to you, you may enjoy it to sons and posterity without
hindrance, free of all imposts, in permanence.
    Usual final verses.
