cells.remarks: Obeisance to S'ambhu &c. Be it well. Possessed of the highest fortune, the favoured abode of the goddess of victory, a source of exaltation for the goddess of fame, was the Hoysala-vams'a. In the Yadu-kula (omitting laudations) arose the king Hoysala. And as a branch of the tree of plenty the Yadu-vams'a, was born Vinayâditya. His wife was Keleyabbarasi, and their son was Ereyanga. The great Dhâre, considered the loft *(mât)* of the Mâlava kingdom he subdued with his own army and made it over to the emperor, thus increasing his conquests, and (then) lowered from his door-frame the flag of his fame as conqueror of the regions, even as the lord of the day (the sun) appears to sink down. Ereyanga's wife was Êchala-Dêvi, and to them were born three sons,—Ballâla, Vishnu and Udayâditya. Making his own by the might of his arm the entire world bounded by the Perddore and Sêtu,the western and eastern oceans,—destroying the evil, gaining satisfaction, and to the good showing himself as an unparalleled man like Râma, was Vishnuvarddhana. His senior wife was Lakshmâ-Dêvi, and their son was the brave Narasimha. To those two was born a son vira-Ballu. Trampling on Chôla and Kalinga, thrashing down the Mâlava army, harassing Nêpâla's force, defeating Pândya who attacked him, raging in all quarters, vîra-Ballu's might spread terror throughout the territories of hostile kings. His son was Narasimha; whose son was Sôma; whose son was Narasimha; whose son was Ballâla. Be it well. When, (with usual titles, also) the champion over the three kings, uprooter of the Magara king, setter up of the Chôla king, supporter of the Pândya king, Kandarppa (the god of love) to the Kâdava king, the Vishnuvarddhana nissanka-pratâpa-chakravartti Hoysala bhujabala viraNâra- simha-Dêvarasa was in his own royal city Dôrasamudra, ruling the kingdom in peace and wisdom:— (On the date specified),—a dweller at vira-Nârasimha-Dêvarasa's lotus feet, Hiriya-Haḍibâra Alâla-Dêva and his younger brother Haḍihâri Sôvaṇṇa, in the name of their mother Manchavre, daughter of the Kellangere paṭṭana-svâmi Kêti-S'eṭṭi, set up in Gaṭṭiganakere a S'ivalinga, built a tank, and for the daily worship of that god Manchêsvara, the five parbbas, the decorations and illuminations, temple repairs, gifts of food to the head of the maṭha. and ascetics,—the supporter of the Vâgila-kulâgama-samaya, Alâla-Dêva, his brother and their sons (named), all washing the feet of the priest of the Manchêsvara temple, Alâla-Dêva and his brother made grants of land (specified). Imprecations. Praise of the two brothers. 123 *bis* *Date 1200 A.D.* Obeisance to S'ambhu &c. From the tree of plenty the Yadu-vams'a sprang many as branches in the Hoysalânvaya, distinguished among whom was born Vinayâditya. (Omitting laudations), to him and to Keleyabbarasi was born Ereyanga. Trampling on the Mâlava army, without effort burning Dhâre, bringing down Chôla, he completely plundered his camp by force, broke the servile Kaḷiṅga . . . . . . . . . plundered . . . . . . . . . . . . and [increased] the Châlukya [emperor's conquests]. To him and to 65 Tiptur Taluq Echalavve were born Ballâla, Vishnu and Udayâditya.... Kongu Naṅgali Talakâdu Râyarâyapura Male.... Gaṅgavâdi.... with countless hill forts of hostile kings did king Vishnu capture. To him and to Lakshmâmbike was born his eldest son Nṛisimha. His son was Ballâla. It be well. When, (with usual titles, including) S'anivâra-siddhi, Giridurggamalla,—bhujabala Hoysala vîra-Ballâla-Dêvarasa was the residence of ...... , ruling the kingdom of the earth :— A dweller at his lotus feet, the greatness of Umâ-Dêvi was as follows ;—(what follows is greatly effaced). Praises of various Seṭṭis, ending with Mahadeva-Seṭṭi, whose wife was Mâravve. He made a tank and the Banaûr Sivâlaya and exalted his fame in the world. May Kareḳovalêsvara grant the fulfilment of all his wishes. It be well. Mahadêva-Seṭṭi renowned throughout the Hoysana country, ruling Alûr and Sârata- vaḷḷi, had the Gattiganakere tank constructed, caused a temple to be erected, and (on the date specified) for the offerings to the god Chaudêśvara, the perpetual lamp, decorations, temple repairs, gifts of food to the head of the maṭha and the ascetics,—washing the feet of the promoter of the Vâgilâ-kulâgama-sameya, Sôma-jiya's son Mâra-jiya,—made grants of land (specified). Imprecations. **Date 1234 A.D.** (In the year specified), the temple priests of Bijayêsvarapura, which is Mâchanakaṭṭa, (apparently made some grant for the livelihood of Maleya-Nâyaka's ... ). *(rest effaced).*

4 ನಂದ ಚಂದ್ರೋಜಿ ತೋದಿಂದೊಗೇದಂ ಕವದಳಗುಣಸಮೃದ್ಧ ತಾತೋನ ತಕೀರ್ತಿ ಹೂಯ್ಯಲ ಪ್ರೀತಿ
5 ದಾಲಂ || ಯದುವಂಶ ಕಲ್ಯಣ ವಿಸ್ತಾರ ದೊಳಗದವಸಿಜಲಪತಿ ತಾನ ನುಕುದು ಮ್ಬನೋಸೌ ದ್ರ ಮಳ ಕೀರ್ತಿ ಕವಿಳ ಸಂ(ದ್ರು)
6 ಮುದವಿಂ ಭುಜವೈಭವವಿನಿಯಾದಿತ್ಯಂ || ಆದಿನಾಯಕ ನಿತ್ಯನ ಸಭಾವೋದ್ಯ ವೆಮಂತ್ರ ದೇವತಾ ಸಂನಿಭಸದ್ಭಮಿನೆ
7 ಕಲಿಮಬೀಳಿಗೆಯನೆ ವಕುಧೆಯೊಳ್‌ ಎಳಲಬುಂಬಿಕೊಂಬಧಿನೀಧರಂ || ಯಾವದವಶಕ್ಯಮರೆ ಮಹೋ ದೇವಮನೆ
8 ತುಂಗಂಗಿಸಿ ಸತಿನಿನಮಾದಿಕ್ಕೇಗದಾಂ ತತ್ರ್ಯ[ವಿ]ನಮನುಸೋದದ ಮಸತನಗಗಳ್ಧಿಲೋದಾತಂ || ಮಾಳವರಾ
9 ಜ್ಯಮಾಳವಿನಿಕಗ್ನ ದಧಾರೆಯನತ್ತ ಸೆನಾನಿ, ಉಂಟಾಳ್ಯ ತಕ್ಕನ್ನ ಗೆ ನಿಜಮುನಿಗೀ ತನಿಭುಜಪ್ರತಾಪಂಂಪಾ
10 ಳ್ಳಲ ನಿಜ್ಜುಮಪುತ್ರ್ಯ ಕೀತ್ತಿ ತಕತಾಕಿಯು ನತ್ತ ರಾ ಸುವೆಳು ಕೊಳ್ಳಿ, ಸುದಿನೇಶ್ವನ ಗಿ ದಿಕ್ಷುಮಂತತಿಯಂಗ ಭಾಭು
11 ರಂ || ಮೇರುಮೇಳುಕುಬಮಬುಲಿವಾರಿಯಉಭಪಂಗಪ್ರಸನ್ನಣ ಳಾಬೊದವಗಂಧರಂಗಳಗಜೇಂದ್ರೀಗಭೀತೆ
12 ೧ಗೇಔಮಂಗನಿಪ್ರತಿಗೊಪ್ಪುವದಂಗೆ || ಅಸ್ತ್ರ[ಯ್ಯ] ಕುಲಶುದ್ಧೋಪಾದಶುಭಲಕ್ಷ್ಮಣಸುಚರಿತಡೇ
13 ತತಸಿನಿನಪ್ಪ್ರಭುಗಾಮುನ ತನ್ನ ಕ್ರ ಮನುಸಭತ್ಯಲ್ಲಾ ಅವಿಮ್ಮುಲನುಸಾದಿತ್ಯರು | ಪೆದ್ದೌ ಜಿಸೇತುವಪ್ಪನು
14 ಹೆಮೌನಿ ಸಧಿ ಪ್ರಭುವೇ ಇರೇಧಿ ಮೇವೆ ಚಾಗಿನ್ನ ದದತಿಯು ನುನೆಥಯೆತೇ ಮೊಲ್ಲಿನವಿಂದಿನಮಿದದುಪದಂ
15 ವನ್ನಿ ನಿಸೆ ತೃಪ್ಪಿಯಂದದ ಮಸಿಸ್ಸಜನಪ್ರಕೃತಿರಮಣನುತ್ಯ ವನಾರವರಲು ಸುಳಮೆತನ್ಮಣ್ಣೋಳೊಡಬುಡನಿ
16 ಸಣ್ಣ ವಸ್ಲ ನಂ || ಯೆತ್ತ ದಮುನವೇತಿ ನದೆಗೊಳ್ಳುಮುದಮುನವುತ್ತ ಕೋಪಂ ವಮುತ್ತ ದಮುನ ವಡೌ ಕುವಿನೆತೆ
17 ತ್ತ ತ್ರಿತ್ರಿ ತ್ರಿವತ್ತ ದುರ್ಗ =ಮುಮತ್ತನವೇದೆ ನಿಗ್ಗೆ ಸಮಿಚಿದಮುವಿಲೋಧಿನಿರಲಪ್ಪಿ ತಾ ಣುತೃಕನಿ
18 ಣ್ಮಕ ವಿಕ್ರಮುಮವಕ್ಕ ನವಕೃತನಿ ಸುತ್ತು, ಲೋಕಂ || ಲಕ್ಷಣಿ ದೇವಿಯ || ಗಾವಳಚೆ ಗಣಿ ಸದಿಚ್ಚವಿಸ್ತಣ್ಣಂ
19 ೨ಕಂತಕೆಲಿಲಂತಕ್ಕ ದೇವಿಸಿಲಂವಿಗಿಳಕ್ಕ ನವಿನೆಮ್ಮ ಗಗ್ರಸಹಿಯೆನ[ಎ]ನೆಗ್ಗಲಳ್ಳು || ಅವಂ
20 ಪರ್ಗಿತನ ಭವನಾದೆ ಸುಚರಿತ ನಿನಿತ ಗೋತ್ರ ಪ್ರಸುತ್ತಿಯಾದವನ ವಿಪ್ರಕಲಿತಕಲೊಮೆದಿನಿ
21 ಯೊಳ್‌ಲಕೇಣಿವಗಲನಕದನೆರೋಸಂಪು || ಅದಟೆಗೌರನನವಿದದವಸನಜಿ ಚನುಸುಭತ ತ್ರಿ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ
22 ೨ನಾಲಿಯತಲದಂಕ ರಂಮನತಿವೀಳೇಭಯಕರನಕ ದಾರನೋದ್ವೇದಕಲಿವಲೆಮೃಲಿಳ ವಿಭಾಗ ಕ್ಯಾನಿನರಸಿ
23 ೨೦ಹತ್ಯನೆಮುಖ ಕಾದವಸೆಕರಂಬುಡಬೀತಿಯ ಗ್ಮ ೀಮಹೇಳದೇವರದೇಲಂ || ಕದವನುಲಿದಕ್ಕಿ ಗದವಬ್
24 ರಮದ ರದವನಿಯುನಿ ಸುನಿನ್ನಿ ಣತ್ತು ಸರುಬಾವಂದ ವಂದೆ ಇಅಲಕ್ಕಿ ಳುಲುವುಂ ದದಮದವನಿ ಹನ ರಲೆಸಿಂ
25 ೭ಹೇವದೇವನಗಿ ನೊ || ಅಬರಿಬ ೨ ಗಿ ೧೧ ಗನವದನವನ ವಸಂ ಫ್ರೂನ್ಯನ ಮೂರ್ತಿ ನಮನುಜಮ ನೋಜು ವನ ಯು ತ
26 ೨ ನಿಧಿಯಸೆದು ರವಿನಯದಿಂವಿಚೆ ಬಲ್ಲಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಕುಳಕೆಳಕೆಲಂ || ಜೋಳಕಳಿಗಂಗನತುಳಿದುಮಾವಳ ವಸೆನೆಂ
27 ೪೬ಣಿಕೆಯ್ಮ ಲಕ್ಷ್ಮಣೆಸಳಳ ನಮಡೇನನುದೆಳೆಯ ನುಸಿಕ್ಕಿ ಆಯುಟ್ಟಿ ಸಾಂದ್ಯ ಸಂಚಾಳಿ ಯೊತ್ತ ಲುತ್ತಿ ಮುಲ್ಲೊಸನ
28 ೨೦ಡತದಪವೀರಲು ಭುಪಾಲಕ ತನಬಕುಂಭ ಜನಮೆವ್ರಿ ನಿ ಸರಳರಮಂಡಲಗೊಳಂ || ೧೦
29 ೨೦ದವೆಲೊ ಪ್ಯೆ ತೋಪ್ಯೆ =ಕುಲಯಾಳೇವಪು ವಿನಂಕಿ ಬ್ಬಯಿ, ವಾ(ಬೊಂದನನೂಕಿ ಬ್ಬುವಾವ)
30 ೨೧ ಬುವನಿಕೆಪೋಡಕ್ಕ ಯುದೆಸೆ ಯೊಳುನ್ನುಗ್ಗಿ ೨ ತಂದು ಲಬ್ಬಲ್ಲು, ಕಡಗಂದೆಯೋಂದಿರದೋಂದನೆಳೊಲನಿತುಂ
31 ೨೨ ತೂರಗಾವಳಿನೋಂಬಿಬ ಯು ವ್ರಾ ಬಿದುಂವದನೊ ಜ್ಞೆ: ನಾಯತನ ತೇಸಂಭ್ರಮಧಿ ದವಮೋಧ್ಯಾ ನಯೊಡಿ
32 ೨೩ದಂ || ತೆತ್ತ್ವನಜುಶಿ ಹರ್ಜೆಸಹೌವನ ಕಸರುತಂಸೇನಪಾವನಿ ಭಾಲಕಮನುಜಾಧಿಕನ ಶರನೆಂಹ್ಯ
33 ೨೪ಸಾನಸ್ಥನಮಗಂ ಬಲಲ್ಯ ಲತ್ತ್ವೇ ಭಿತಂಮ || ೨ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿ ಸಮಸ್ತ ಭುವನಶ್ರಯುಂಶ್ರೀ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿ ನಿ ವಲ್ಲಭಂ
34 ೨ ಮಹಾರಾಜಾಧಿರಾಜಪರಮೇಶ್ವರಂದಲ್ಯಾರಾವತೇ ಪ್ರವರವಿಥ್ವೇಶ್ವರನ ಯಾದಕುಲಂಜಾ ತ
35 ೨ದ್ಮಮುನಿಸಪ್ವಸ್ಥಾನ ದೋದಾವಮನಿಮಲರಜಣಮಲಪರಲುಗಂಗದಣ್ಬೀಸುಂಡಕದವ
36 ೨೯ಹೌದಂಡನೆಹಾಯಶಯಗೆಯಕಾಂ೧ನಿರಶನಿನರಸಿಧಿ ಗಿಲಿ ದುಗ್ಗು < ಷ್ಮಲ್ಲದಮೋಕರ ಕಮಚ್ಚರಿ ೪ ೮ಕಂ
37 ೨೧ರೈವರವಂದಯಪುಹಲಲಯಂಗದಂ ದೀಂದ್ರುಂಡಮಾವರುಯರಗಡಂಡಮಗಾರಯನಿನುಗ್ಗಳೆಜೋಳೇ
38 ೨ಳರಾಯುನ್ನಾ ಸನಾಚಾಯೌದಂದಾರದ್ಧ ರಾಜಸುಮುದ್ರಾ ರಣಿಕಾದವರಾಯಾಯ ಕಂವೃಪ = ಶೀಮತಿಯುನ್ನಿನಣ್ಣನ ||
ಇಗ್ಗೂರು ತಾಲೂಕು
181.

(ಮುಂದೆ ಕಾಣುವುದಿಲ್ಲ)

text.remarks:
Obeisance to S'ambhu &c. Be it well. Possessed of the highest fortune, the favoured abode
of the goddess of victory, a source of exaltation for the goddess of fame, was the Hoysala-vams'a.
In the Yadu-kula (omitting laudations) arose the king Hoysala. And as a branch of the tree of
plenty the Yadu-vams'a, was born Vinayâditya. His wife was Keleyabbarasi, and their son
was Ereyanga. The great Dhâre, considered the loft *(mât)* of the Mâlava kingdom he subdued with
his own army and made it over to the emperor, thus increasing his conquests, and (then) lowered from
his door-frame the flag of his fame as conqueror of the regions, even as the lord of the day (the sun)
appears to sink down. Ereyanga's wife was Êchala-Dêvi, and to them were born three sons,—Ballâla,
Vishnu and Udayâditya. Making his own by the might of his arm the entire world bounded by the
Perddore and Sêtu,the western and eastern oceans,—destroying the evil, gaining satisfaction, and to
the good showing himself as an unparalleled man like Râma, was Vishnuvarddhana. His senior wife
was Lakshmâ-Dêvi, and their son was the brave Narasimha.

To those two was born a son vira-Ballu. Trampling on Chôla and Kalinga, thrashing down the
Mâlava army, harassing Nêpâla's force, defeating Pândya who attacked him, raging in all quarters,
vîra-Ballu's might spread terror throughout the territories of hostile kings.

His son was Narasimha; whose son was Sôma; whose son was Narasimha; whose son was
Ballâla.

Be it well. When, (with usual titles, also) the champion over the three kings, uprooter of the
Magara king, setter up of the Chôla king, supporter of the Pândya king, Kandarppa (the god of love)
to the Kâdava king, the Vishnuvarddhana nissanka-pratâpa-chakravartti Hoysala bhujabala viraNâra-
simha-Dêvarasa was in his own royal city Dôrasamudra, ruling the kingdom in peace and wisdom:—

(On the date specified),—a dweller at vira-Nârasimha-Dêvarasa's lotus feet, Hiriya-Haḍibâra
Alâla-Dêva and his younger brother Haḍihâri Sôvaṇṇa, in the name of their mother Manchavre,
daughter of the Kellangere paṭṭana-svâmi Kêti-S'eṭṭi, set up in Gaṭṭiganakere a S'ivalinga, built a
tank, and for the daily worship of that god Manchêsvara, the five parbbas, the decorations and
illuminations, temple repairs, gifts of food to the head of the maṭha. and ascetics,—the supporter
of the Vâgila-kulâgama-samaya, Alâla-Dêva, his brother and their sons (named), all washing the
feet of the priest of the Manchêsvara temple, Alâla-Dêva and his brother made grants of land
(specified). Imprecations. Praise of the two brothers.

123 *bis*

*Date 1200 A.D.*

Obeisance to S'ambhu &c.

From the tree of plenty the Yadu-vams'a sprang many as branches in the Hoysalânvaya,
distinguished among whom was born Vinayâditya. (Omitting laudations), to him and to Keleyabbarasi
was born Ereyanga. Trampling on the Mâlava army, without effort burning Dhâre, bringing down
Chôla, he completely plundered his camp by force, broke the servile Kaḷiṅga . . . . . . . . . plundered
. . . . . . . . . . . . and [increased] the Châlukya [emperor's conquests]. To him and to

65	Tiptur Taluq

Echalavve were born Ballâla, Vishnu and Udayâditya.... Kongu Naṅgali Talakâdu Râyarâyapura
Male.... Gaṅgavâdi.... with countless hill forts of hostile kings did king Vishnu capture. To him
and to Lakshmâmbike was born his eldest son Nṛisimha. His son was Ballâla.
   It be well. When, (with usual titles, including) S'anivâra-siddhi, Giridurggamalla,—bhujabala
Hoysala vîra-Ballâla-Dêvarasa was the residence of ...... , ruling the kingdom of the earth :—
   A dweller at his lotus feet, the greatness of Umâ-Dêvi was as follows ;—(what follows is
greatly effaced). Praises of various Seṭṭis, ending with Mahadeva-Seṭṭi, whose wife was Mâravve.
He made a tank and the Banaûr Sivâlaya and exalted his fame in the world. May Kareḳovalêsvara
grant the fulfilment of all his wishes.
   It be well. Mahadêva-Seṭṭi renowned throughout the Hoysana country, ruling Alûr and Sârata-
vaḷḷi, had the Gattiganakere tank constructed, caused a temple to be erected, and (on the date
specified) for the offerings to the god Chaudêśvara, the perpetual lamp, decorations, temple repairs,
gifts of food to the head of the maṭha and the ascetics,—washing the feet of the promoter of the
Vâgilâ-kulâgama-sameya, Sôma-jiya's son Mâra-jiya,—made grants of land (specified). Imprecations.

**Date 1234 A.D.**

   (In the year specified), the temple priests of Bijayêsvarapura, which is Mâchanakaṭṭa,
(apparently made some grant for the livelihood of Maleya-Nâyaka's ... ). *(rest effaced).*
text.text_original: ಅದೇ ಹೊಂಬಾಳಿ ಘಟಕನಕೇರೆ ಗ್ರಾಮದ ಕಲ್ಲಿಶ್ವರದ ದೇವೂರ ಗುಡಿಗೆ ಮುಂದೆಪ್ರಮಾಣ — 2' 6" × 5'1ನಮಸ್ತುಂಗಸಿರಸ್ಸುಂಗುಬಿಚಂದ್ಭುತಚಾಮರಚಾರವೇ ತ್ರೈಲೋಕ್ಯನಗರಾರಂಭಇಗ್ಗೂರು ತಾಲೂಕು181.1 ೨ಬಂಮೌಲ್ಯ ಭಂಬಯಸಂಪುಭುವೆ ! ಸೃಷ್ಟಿ ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠ ಯುಕ್ತಮಾನುಸೃಜಿ2 ಶ್ರೀಯವಿಲಸಿತವಾರ ಸಂಕಲೋಗ್ನ್ಯತುಯಶೋವಿನವಿನಿಯಾಸರತ್ನವನೇಮಸಮಹಂ3 ಲ್ಲಿಸಲವಸಂ || ಯದುಕುಲಸುಧಾಂಬುಧಿನೊದ್ಯುಮುದ್ವದಿಂ4 ನಂದ ಚಂದ್ರೋಜಿ ತೋದಿಂದೊಗೇದಂ ಕವದಳಗುಣಸಮೃದ್ಧ ತಾತೋನ ತಕೀರ್ತಿ ಹೂಯ್ಯಲ ಪ್ರೀತಿ5 ದಾಲಂ || ಯದುವಂಶ ಕಲ್ಯಣ ವಿಸ್ತಾರ ದೊಳಗದವಸಿಜಲಪತಿ ತಾನ ನುಕುದು ಮ್ಬನೋಸೌ ದ್ರ ಮಳ ಕೀರ್ತಿ ಕವಿಳ ಸಂ(ದ್ರು)6 ಮುದವಿಂ ಭುಜವೈಭವವಿನಿಯಾದಿತ್ಯಂ || ಆದಿನಾಯಕ ನಿತ್ಯನ ಸಭಾವೋದ್ಯ ವೆಮಂತ್ರ ದೇವತಾ ಸಂನಿಭಸದ್ಭಮಿನೆ7 ಕಲಿಮಬೀಳಿಗೆಯನೆ ವಕುಧೆಯೊಳ್‌ ಎಳಲಬುಂಬಿಕೊಂಬಧಿನೀಧರಂ || ಯಾವದವಶಕ್ಯಮರೆ ಮಹೋ ದೇವಮನೆ8 ತುಂಗಂಗಿಸಿ ಸತಿನಿನಮಾದಿಕ್ಕೇಗದಾಂ ತತ್ರ್ಯ[ವಿ]ನಮನುಸೋದದ ಮಸತನಗಗಳ್ಧಿಲೋದಾತಂ || ಮಾಳವರಾ9 ಜ್ಯಮಾಳವಿನಿಕಗ್ನ ದಧಾರೆಯನತ್ತ ಸೆನಾನಿ, ಉಂಟಾಳ್ಯ ತಕ್ಕನ್ನ ಗೆ ನಿಜಮುನಿಗೀ ತನಿಭುಜಪ್ರತಾಪಂಂಪಾ10 ಳ್ಳಲ ನಿಜ್ಜುಮಪುತ್ರ್ಯ ಕೀತ್ತಿ ತಕತಾಕಿಯು ನತ್ತ ರಾ ಸುವೆಳು ಕೊಳ್ಳಿ, ಸುದಿನೇಶ್ವನ ಗಿ ದಿಕ್ಷುಮಂತತಿಯಂಗ ಭಾಭು11 ರಂ || ಮೇರುಮೇಳುಕುಬಮಬುಲಿವಾರಿಯಉಭಪಂಗಪ್ರಸನ್ನಣ ಳಾಬೊದವಗಂಧರಂಗಳಗಜೇಂದ್ರೀಗಭೀತೆ12 ೧ಗೇಔಮಂಗನಿಪ್ರತಿಗೊಪ್ಪುವದಂಗೆ || ಅಸ್ತ್ರ[ಯ್ಯ] ಕುಲಶುದ್ಧೋಪಾದಶುಭಲಕ್ಷ್ಮಣಸುಚರಿತಡೇ13 ತತಸಿನಿನಪ್ಪ್ರಭುಗಾಮುನ ತನ್ನ ಕ್ರ ಮನುಸಭತ್ಯಲ್ಲಾ ಅವಿಮ್ಮುಲನುಸಾದಿತ್ಯರು | ಪೆದ್ದೌ ಜಿಸೇತುವಪ್ಪನು14 ಹೆಮೌನಿ ಸಧಿ ಪ್ರಭುವೇ ಇರೇಧಿ ಮೇವೆ ಚಾಗಿನ್ನ ದದತಿಯು ನುನೆಥಯೆತೇ ಮೊಲ್ಲಿನವಿಂದಿನಮಿದದುಪದಂ15 ವನ್ನಿ ನಿಸೆ ತೃಪ್ಪಿಯಂದದ ಮಸಿಸ್ಸಜನಪ್ರಕೃತಿರಮಣನುತ್ಯ ವನಾರವರಲು ಸುಳಮೆತನ್ಮಣ್ಣೋಳೊಡಬುಡನಿ16 ಸಣ್ಣ ವಸ್ಲ ನಂ || ಯೆತ್ತ ದಮುನವೇತಿ ನದೆಗೊಳ್ಳುಮುದಮುನವುತ್ತ ಕೋಪಂ ವಮುತ್ತ ದಮುನ ವಡೌ ಕುವಿನೆತೆ17 ತ್ತ ತ್ರಿತ್ರಿ ತ್ರಿವತ್ತ ದುರ್ಗ =ಮುಮತ್ತನವೇದೆ ನಿಗ್ಗೆ ಸಮಿಚಿದಮುವಿಲೋಧಿನಿರಲಪ್ಪಿ ತಾ ಣುತೃಕನಿ18 ಣ್ಮಕ ವಿಕ್ರಮುಮವಕ್ಕ ನವಕೃತನಿ ಸುತ್ತು, ಲೋಕಂ || ಲಕ್ಷಣಿ ದೇವಿಯ || ಗಾವಳಚೆ ಗಣಿ ಸದಿಚ್ಚವಿಸ್ತಣ್ಣಂ19 ೨ಕಂತಕೆಲಿಲಂತಕ್ಕ ದೇವಿಸಿಲಂವಿಗಿಳಕ್ಕ ನವಿನೆಮ್ಮ ಗಗ್ರಸಹಿಯೆನ[ಎ]ನೆಗ್ಗಲಳ್ಳು || ಅವಂ20 ಪರ್ಗಿತನ ಭವನಾದೆ ಸುಚರಿತ ನಿನಿತ ಗೋತ್ರ ಪ್ರಸುತ್ತಿಯಾದವನ ವಿಪ್ರಕಲಿತಕಲೊಮೆದಿನಿ21 ಯೊಳ್‌ಲಕೇಣಿವಗಲನಕದನೆರೋಸಂಪು || ಅದಟೆಗೌರನನವಿದದವಸನಜಿ ಚನುಸುಭತ ತ್ರಿ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ22 ೨ನಾಲಿಯತಲದಂಕ ರಂಮನತಿವೀಳೇಭಯಕರನಕ ದಾರನೋದ್ವೇದಕಲಿವಲೆಮೃಲಿಳ ವಿಭಾಗ ಕ್ಯಾನಿನರಸಿ23 ೨೦ಹತ್ಯನೆಮುಖ ಕಾದವಸೆಕರಂಬುಡಬೀತಿಯ ಗ್ಮ ೀಮಹೇಳದೇವರದೇಲಂ || ಕದವನುಲಿದಕ್ಕಿ ಗದವಬ್24 ರಮದ ರದವನಿಯುನಿ ಸುನಿನ್ನಿ ಣತ್ತು ಸರುಬಾವಂದ ವಂದೆ ಇಅಲಕ್ಕಿ ಳುಲುವುಂ ದದಮದವನಿ ಹನ ರಲೆಸಿಂ25 ೭ಹೇವದೇವನಗಿ ನೊ || ಅಬರಿಬ ೨ ಗಿ ೧೧ ಗನವದನವನ ವಸಂ ಫ್ರೂನ್ಯನ ಮೂರ್ತಿ ನಮನುಜಮ ನೋಜು ವನ ಯು ತ26 ೨ ನಿಧಿಯಸೆದು ರವಿನಯದಿಂವಿಚೆ ಬಲ್ಲಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಕುಳಕೆಳಕೆಲಂ || ಜೋಳಕಳಿಗಂಗನತುಳಿದುಮಾವಳ ವಸೆನೆಂ27 ೪೬ಣಿಕೆಯ್ಮ ಲಕ್ಷ್ಮಣೆಸಳಳ ನಮಡೇನನುದೆಳೆಯ ನುಸಿಕ್ಕಿ ಆಯುಟ್ಟಿ ಸಾಂದ್ಯ ಸಂಚಾಳಿ ಯೊತ್ತ ಲುತ್ತಿ ಮುಲ್ಲೊಸನ28 ೨೦ಡತದಪವೀರಲು ಭುಪಾಲಕ ತನಬಕುಂಭ ಜನಮೆವ್ರಿ ನಿ ಸರಳರಮಂಡಲಗೊಳಂ || ೧೦29 ೨೦ದವೆಲೊ ಪ್ಯೆ ತೋಪ್ಯೆ =ಕುಲಯಾಳೇವಪು ವಿನಂಕಿ ಬ್ಬಯಿ, ವಾ(ಬೊಂದನನೂಕಿ ಬ್ಬುವಾವ)30 ೨೧ ಬುವನಿಕೆಪೋಡಕ್ಕ ಯುದೆಸೆ ಯೊಳುನ್ನುಗ್ಗಿ ೨ ತಂದು ಲಬ್ಬಲ್ಲು, ಕಡಗಂದೆಯೋಂದಿರದೋಂದನೆಳೊಲನಿತುಂ31 ೨೨ ತೂರಗಾವಳಿನೋಂಬಿಬ ಯು ವ್ರಾ ಬಿದುಂವದನೊ ಜ್ಞೆ: ನಾಯತನ ತೇಸಂಭ್ರಮಧಿ ದವಮೋಧ್ಯಾ ನಯೊಡಿ32 ೨೩ದಂ || ತೆತ್ತ್ವನಜುಶಿ ಹರ್ಜೆಸಹೌವನ ಕಸರುತಂಸೇನಪಾವನಿ ಭಾಲಕಮನುಜಾಧಿಕನ ಶರನೆಂಹ್ಯ33 ೨೪ಸಾನಸ್ಥನಮಗಂ ಬಲಲ್ಯ ಲತ್ತ್ವೇ ಭಿತಂಮ || ೨ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿ ಸಮಸ್ತ ಭುವನಶ್ರಯುಂಶ್ರೀ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿ ನಿ ವಲ್ಲಭಂ34 ೨ ಮಹಾರಾಜಾಧಿರಾಜಪರಮೇಶ್ವರಂದಲ್ಯಾರಾವತೇ ಪ್ರವರವಿಥ್ವೇಶ್ವರನ ಯಾದಕುಲಂಜಾ ತ35 ೨ದ್ಮಮುನಿಸಪ್ವಸ್ಥಾನ ದೋದಾವಮನಿಮಲರಜಣಮಲಪರಲುಗಂಗದಣ್ಬೀಸುಂಡಕದವ36 ೨೯ಹೌದಂಡನೆಹಾಯಶಯಗೆಯಕಾಂ೧ನಿರಶನಿನರಸಿಧಿ ಗಿಲಿ ದುಗ್ಗು < ಷ್ಮಲ್ಲದಮೋಕರ ಕಮಚ್ಚರಿ ೪ ೮ಕಂ37 ೨೧ರೈವರವಂದಯಪುಹಲಲಯಂಗದಂ ದೀಂದ್ರುಂಡಮಾವರುಯರಗಡಂಡಮಗಾರಯನಿನುಗ್ಗಳೆಜೋಳೇ38 ೨ಳರಾಯುನ್ನಾ ಸನಾಚಾಯೌದಂದಾರದ್ಧ ರಾಜಸುಮುದ್ರಾ ರಣಿಕಾದವರಾಯಾಯ ಕಂವೃಪ = ಶೀಮತಿಯುನ್ನಿನಣ್ಣನ ||ಇಗ್ಗೂರು ತಾಲೂಕು181.(ಮುಂದೆ ಕಾಣುವುದಿಲ್ಲ)

text.location: Tiptur taluk, Tumkur district
text.remarks:
The mahâ-maṇḍalêsvara Aubhala-Râja's son Kêsava-Râjendra granted to the poet *(kavi)*
Lingarasa, as an agrahāra free of all imposts, Hariśvarapura. Imprecations.
text.text_original: ಹೊನ್ನವಳ್ಳಿ ಹೋಬಳಿ ಹರುಶನಹಳ್ಳಿ ಮಲ್ಲಿಕೇಶ್ವರ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದ ಉತ್ತರ ಕಡೆ ಗೋಡೆಯುಲ್ಲಿ^1 ಶ್ರೀಮನ್ಮಹಾಮಂಡಳೇಶ್ವರಳಭ^2 ಲರಾಜ ನಕುಮಾರಕೇಶ್ವರಮಾವೇಂದ್ರನು^3 ಕವಿಲಿಂಗರಸರಕೊಟ್ಟ ಸರ್ವಮಾನ್ಯ^4 ದಳಿಪ್ಪಾರಹರಿಶ್ಚಂದ್ರಪುರುಡಕ್ಕ^5 ತಪ್ಪಿದವನತಂಗುರುವಿನಕಂಡತಿಯು^6 ನತಾಯನತೋಗಿಯುನುಕಡವನು

cells.location: Tiptur taluk, Tumkur district
cells.dynasty: Hoysala
cells.king: vira-Ballâla-Dêva
cells.language: Sanskrit and Kannada
cells.remarks: Obeisance to S'ambhu &c, and to S'iva. Except different in form, in their real essence not different, that god of gods who is the three gods with no difference, grant happiness and health. Subduing with his own army the great Dhâre, considered the root (mûla) of the Mâḷava kingdom, making it over and thus increasing by his valour the conquests of the emperor, he lowered from his door-frame the flag of his fame as conqueror of the regions, even as the lord of the day (the sun) appears to sink down, -Ereyanga. To him and his wife were born three sons, -Ballâla, Vishṇu and Udayâditya. Chêra, cast away your enmity; Pândya, do not strive, Andhra, fly not to a hole (randhra); Odda, give up the thought of peril (godda-mana); Mâḷava, expose not your body in battle; you, Tiguḷa, move off (jagu!) ;-such are the proclamations heard of the heralds of the might of the king Ballu. First taking into his arms the Lakshmi of the Hoysala kingdom which was his inheritance, as the power of his valour increased he imposed his commands on the kings at all points of the compass, and capturing Talakâdu, became the first to the Ganga kingdom, -the promoter of the Yadu-vams'a, the king Vishnu. His farther praises. To him and his wife was born the king Narasimha; to whom and his crowned queen was born the king Ballu. When he mounted his horse for an expedition of victory, Kalinga went away to live in the woods; Tuḷuva, ruining his honour, fled; Konkaṇa suddenly packed up for the sacred desert; Gûrjara trembled; Mâḷava gained the thickets of the Vindhya mountains; Chôḷika spent his time on the sea-shore. Be it well. When, (with usual titles), nissanka-pratâpa Hoysala vira-Ballâla-Dêva, putting down the evil and upholding the good throughout the whole world, was in the residence of Dôra- samudra, ruling the kingdom of the earth in peace and wisdom :- A dweller at his lotus feet,-Having gained the highest renown (? in the service of) Narasimha, was Erega-chamûpa. Description of his exploits, in which Pâṇḍya is mentioned. Praise of Nâki- Râja or Hulleya-Nâka. The king Vishnu gave him the Honnavalli Twelve. His wife was Sôvala- Devi, and they had the sons Bikkeya and Dêmeya. Praise of heggade Ghaṭṭiga's valour in the battle field, the mantri Ghaṭṭi, a light to the Anûta-kula. Description of the attractions of Honnavalli. Be it well. (With various epithets), a successful judge, worshipper of the feet of the god Kali, sâmanta-gasani, Hulleya-Nâyaka-Chaundi-Seṭṭi and others (named) being present, -(on the date specified), for the offerings to the god Kali, the perpetual lamp, decorations, temple repairs, gifts of food to the head of the matha and ascetics, washing the feet of Amitarâsi-paṇḍita's disciple S'ivasakti-paṇḍita's disciple Mallikârjjuna-paṇḍita,-made grants of land (specified). 68 Tiptur Taluq Date ? 1237 A.D. The royal inspector heggade Nâkaṇṇa, (on the date specified), made for the same god a grant of a silk cloth, a tripod stand, and a metal tray. And the heggaditi.. chavve gave lamps, a censer, a water vessel ... *(rest effaced).*

23ಲ್ಲದತ್ಸೆವರಲಕ್ಕೈಪ್ರದವದದ . . ವೀರಬಲ್ಲಷ್ಠೀಪತಿಪರೈ . . . . . ಶೈಮವಂಭಾಸುರಕಂಜದೋಳಸಕಲಗಳು
24ಗಾಘನಾಕಾಬ್ಜಲೋಚಿನೀರಾಜಅಂಸು || ಪೆಸಣ್ತಯುಚ್ಚಂಬಲಪೂಂಜಿವಿಜಯಮಹಾಯಾರುಧನ್ಯಾಗಾಳುಕಲಿಂಗಂವನನಾ
25ಸೋಧ್ಯುಕ್ಕೃನಾದಂದಳಲುವನಲವಿಗೆಟ್ಟೋಳತಿಮದಕೊಂಕಣಾಭೋಂಕಣಪೂಣ್ಣಾ ರಣ್ಯಮಾಂಸಂವರಿಸಿದನಗದಿಗೆಂಗೂಜೀ
ರವರಾ
26 Cಳಪವಂದಿನ್ಮ ಕುಂಬ್ಲಪ್ಪ | ನವದಾನಜೇದಿನಿಕಬಲವೆ ಜೋಳಿಕಂವೇಲಿಗೊಂದೊ || ಸ್ಯಸಿ, ಸಮಭಿಗತಮಹಾಜನಪದ
27ಮಹಾಮಂಡಲೇಶ್ವರಂದ್ವಾರಾವತೀಪುರವವರಾಧೀಶ್ವರಂತಲವಲಜಲಧಿಬಡವಾನಲಂದಾಯಾದದಾವಾನಲಪಾಪಂ
28ಹ್ಯುಕ್ಕಲಕಲ್ಮಲನನೋದಂಡಗಂಡಜೀರುದಂಡಮಂಡಲಕೆಚೀಂಚಿತಾಚವರಮಂಡಲಸೂರ್ಜಾರಾಜಸಂಗ್ರಾಮಮುಖಮಕಲಿ
29ಶಕಾಲಕಾಮಸಕಲಧವರಿಂದ್ರವಂಸೋತ್ಪತ್ತ್ಯಾನಸಮ . . . ತಗನಾನಿರ್ನೋಣಸಂತಿಕಾಜೇವೀಲುಬುಧವರಪ್ರಸನಾದನಾಮಾ
ದಿಸ್ಪ
30 ಛಸ್ಸಿ ಸಹಿತೇ ಶ್ರೀಮನ್ಮ ಮಹಾಮಂಡಲೇಸ್ಥ್ವರಂದಕಡಕುಂಗುಂಗಲಗಂಗವಾದಿನೋಲಂ ಬವಾಡಿನವಸೇಕಾಪ
31ಮಂಗಲಗೊಂದೂಡುಜಲವೇಪೇಗಂಗನ್ನ ಸಹಾಯಸೂರಿಯಸಿಸ್ಕೃಪತಾಪಹೋಜಯ್ಯಳವಿದೇಲಲ್ಲಾ ಅಟೇದವರುಕಳಮ
32ಹೀಮಂಡಲದೊಳುದುಷ್ಟ್ಯನಿಗ ಹಸಿಪ್ಪ್ಯಕತಿಬಲಹಂಗೆಯು . . . . ಸುತ್ತುಂದೋರೇಷಮದ್ದದೇವತೇವಿವೇಣೋಲ್ಬಸುಮಿಸಂ
33ಧಾವಿನೋರೊಂದಿಂಪಿ ಸ್ಥೈರ್ಯಾಸ್ಥಾನ್ಗೊಯುಕ್ತೃಮಿರೇ . . . . . . ಪಾದವದ್ಯೋಲ್ವಿಜೇವಿ || ಅಸೀಗಲ್ಬನಾಲೇಂಹನನೂ
34ನಾಗೂತೋತ್ತೃಮವು . . . . . . ಒಲತುನತ . ನೇದವನಕಾರಗುಣಾವನ್ಯಮುಗ್ರುಯಿತುರ್ಜಾಮೂಹಂ ||
35ವಿಟ್ಟುಗು ವಕಂದೀಪಿಡಗಕಡಿಲಗಳಿಗುಪ್ರುಕುಂಬ . . . . . ತಿಪ್ಪಮುತ್ಸ ಗಳ್ಮಟ್ಟು ಗೀಟ್ರೇಬ|ಸರಾಥಭ್ರ್ರಾ
36ಶಲದಿಂದೋಣೆಗುವರಾ . . . . . . . . ಜಲ್ಲಕಾಂತೆಯವಿನೋದವದೆಶಕಣೆಯ್ಸಾಯ್ಯ
37ಸಂಗರಂ || ಸ್ಟೋಲಿವದಲ್ಯ . . . ಣಸಂಗರಂ . . ಸುಭದರುಶೀತ್ಮಿ ರಸಲುಕಾ . . . ಕೋತ್ಕರ್ಪ | ದಿನಿಕ್ಕಿ ಮುಮ್ರುಂತನಂದೆ
38ದದು . . ಳಸೇನಾದಿನ್ಯಾಸ್ತ್ರೋರಾಮ . ಭೂಧರವೆಂರಂತಕಂ .. ಬಲ್ಲಂ . . . ಜೇಮೂನಾಧನಿನುಂದ್ರಶೌರ್ಯ
39ಕಿಂ
40 ದಿಂಮುಪೊಂದ್ಯ . . . . . ಕೆಯುಪೊಲವಿಂದೊಮ್ಯರಾಯಂ .. ಕ್ಯಂ || ಅಗ್ಗಳಹೋಗ೯ . . . ಸೈಸಗರ್ಕಸಂ
ಮಾವನವದಾನ

40ಗುಣಾಭಿಷಾಣ . ಗ್ಗಡ . ನಂ . ದವಗ್ಗ . . ನಾ೦ಚಿತಾತ್ಮ=ಬಲನು ... ಕನೆಃ|| ರಣಕಾ就可以了 . . .
41 . . ದೊಗ್ಗ ರವದ್ವಿಂಧುರದೋಲತಾಗಿವರಾತಿಗಲ್ಲಿಯುವಸಂ[•]ವೈಕ್ತಿನಕೈದ್ವಿಪೇಚೇಕಜೇಶೈರ್ನಾವಕ . ನುನಿಜಮು
ಕಂದಪ್ಪ .
42ಸೆಂವದಾಗುಧರಖುಣಿ ವೃಧುನಾಕಿರಾಜವಿಭ್ರಮವನಿಸ್ಥ್ರಮನಸೃತಿಯಿಂ|ಅಂತುತಂಗಲ್ಲೆಕಿಖಲಮದಮಾರ್ತಂಗಸಿಂಗನಿಸಿ
43 . . . ವಮೃಳ್ಳಿಯನಾಕನೆಕೀತ್ಯಂತೆಂಥವೆಡೆ || ಒದವಿನವೀರವೈರಿಭುಜಗರ್ವಣರ್ವಾಲ್ಲೊಮೆಳ್ಳೆಯಮಾಂಕನೋೕವೆದೆ
ಮುಲಿದೆಯು
44ಕೊಳ್ಯ . . . . . . . . ನೋದೊಡೂ . . . . . ಹೃದಮದೊಳಭುಜಕೌಲೋಚಿತೋಕ್ಕೈಗಳ್ಮೋಣಾಡೇಹಿ
45ದಿದಿ . ೦ . . ಹೋಗುನೆತ್ತೆಸೆಗೊಂಬುದಾರತುಸಂಕಲಂ || ವರಮಣಿಮು . . . . ಮಪ್ಪಿನೆಗೆತನಗಾವಂ
ವಸುಂ
46ಧರೆಯುನೆಳಗಿನವಾಜಿಬೆಸಕೆಯ್ಯುಸನ್ನಗಲ್ಲಿಯುವಿಠಮಂಡಳೇಶ್ವರೆ . ಕೆವಿತ್ತುಗೊಂದವೆಷ್ಣುಮ.ಹೀಪತಿಹೋಂನವಳ್ಯಂ
ರಡುಮನೊಳ್ಳು
47ವೆತ್ತೆಸದವಹಳ್ಳೆಯನಾಯಕರನೇಂಕಿ | ತಾಕ್ಷ್ಯನಾಳೋ || ಆಪುರುಸಂಗೀತನಸತಿಸೇೋಳವೇಮಿನಹಾಪುತೀವಭಾಗ್ಯಜ್ಪನೆ
ದೋಮತ್ರ
48ದೇವತೆತಬಿತೆಸಿನೆ ಳಭಧರ್ಮಯುಕ್ಕೆ ನಾನಾಪರವದಾರವಾರಿಯುಮುಖ್ಯಬನಪವಣೆಸತ್ಯದಭುಕ್ತಿಪೆಪಿನಿಯೋಪ್ಪಿ ದಳಿಧಾರಿ
ತ್ರಿಹೊ
49೧ಗಳಲುವಿನೆಗಳಸುಕೃತಿತ್ಸಾಸುಂತಂ ||ಕಟ್ಟದಿರಲೊಲಂತ ಸುಭಟತನಿಚ್ಚಿ ಲುಮಮುದುಮದುತುದಿಕೆಳಮನಿಧುವಪ್ಯುಟ್ಟವರ
50ವರಮ್ಮ್ಯಾಗಂಗಿನೆಚ್ಚಿ ನೆತಲಿ ಕೆಸನಬಿಕ್ಕಿಯಂಜೆಮೇಯನುಂ ! ... ಧರಿಬಳಸನಹೋಕಿತೋತತಿಯಿ ದೆವೋಗಿಬಿಕೋಯನುನಟಿಸುಂ
51ಳಿದಾದಲukinದೊಂದುತ್ರಿ ರಿಶಿಪ್ರೆಗಳೋವೆತ್ತು ರಣಭೂಮಿ:ಕೆಯೋಳು ... ಟ್ಟದಕಾಲ್ಪುವೆತ್ತೆ ಸೈವನಕಾಣೆಸೆಟ್ಟಿ ಗೋಳಾಡಿ
ಸೆಟ್ಟಿಯುಂ
52ನಲ್ಲೆ್ಯನಹುಳ್ಳೆಮುಂಗುಣಗಣಾಗಣಿಯೆಮುರಿಕಾಣಸಂಕರಾಂತಕುಂಡುಟ್ಟುಂಗರಂಡದವೃತಿಮದೋಮಯನಾಯಕನಂಬರತ್ಯ್
53ಯೊಂಜಿಟ್ಟೆ . . . ಭಿಕೆ . ರಮತ್ಸುನವಿಂದಮದ್ವೇಷಭೂಮಿಯಂ || ಅರಿಬಳಮೊಂಬಜೆಟ್ಟಿರೋವಿಂ ದಿನತಂಡೆಮನೆಚ್ಚು ಮುಟ್ಟು
ತಂಡು-
54ರದೋಲೆಳಗಾಂತುನಿಂ . ದದೆಲೆಳ್ಳಿ ರನಿಸ್ವರ್ಗಿಯಾಗಿ . . ಯುಷ್ಯುತಂಪರಿಮುವಾಡುಮದನೋಲಹೆಗ್ಗದನಪ್ಪೆಗಣಜೀರಂಗ
ದೋಲು
55 . . . ಗಂಡಗುಣವಮುೇಯುದೋರೆರಂಗಂಭೂಮಿಯೊಳು || ಪಮಲಿನನೊದುಕೀರ್ತಿ=ಧರಣೊಂದಮದಯಾಪರನೊಂದವುಣ್ಣೆಸ್ನ
56ಸದದದೋದೊಂದೋತನೆಸೆಮಂತ್ರದೊಂತತದಿ . ನಂ ಜುಡುಪದಚಲಿಕೆವೆತ್ತೆ ... ನಿಧಿಯಮಸಲೀವೆದೆಯೋಮತೃವೆಟ್ಟೆಯಂ
57ಅನುಪಮತೇಜ್ಞಜನಮದನರೂಪನನೂತಕುಲಪ್ರಧೀಪನಂ || ನೋಡುವಕಣ್ಣಿಗಳಗಂ ತಣೇಪುನಗ್ದವನಗೆೋಜಿಕಾತಕಾ೦
ಗುಕೋಣದೌಡು
58ವದೇೆಮಭಿೋಗಳಪುಲಸುಂತಿಯಿಂಡುಲೋಲ್ಯುದಾಡಿತೋಗಾಡವತೋಗುಂತಗಡಿಗಡಿಸಿಬೆಳಿಸಿದ್ದಾಗುಂಗಧನಾಲೀನಾನಾಡಾ
ಡಿಯುರೊ
59ಅಡಿಯೋಗಳ್ಳಲವಲ್ಲೆಮುನೋಪ್ಪುಮಹೋನವಲ್ಯತಾಂ || ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟಗುಣಸಂವನ್ನನುನುದಿಂತಗೊಂದೋಂಗೋತೃಸವಿತೃ]
ನುಂಪಾರಾಗನಾಳ
60ತ್ರತೆತೃೆಪತವನಾಯ್ಯುಸ್ತ್ರನ್ನಾಕೋಪ್ಪು ವಕೀಕಲಿದೆಯೇವರಧಾರಾಧರಕರಪರಬಳನಾಧಿಕರಫ್ಫಣಾಮಂಗತಸಣಿಉಳ್ಳೆಯ
ನಾಯಕನು
61೧ಚೌಂಡಿಸಿಟ್ಟೆಯು . . ಸೆಟ್ಟಿಯುೕಕರನಾಯಕ . . ಸೆಟ್ಟಿಯೋಲಗದನಸ್ಮಪ್ರವೇಗಾವೂಡಾಗಲುಮಿಡ್ಡುಚಾಳುಕ್ಯಕವಿ
ಕ್ರಮ
62ಕಾಲದಸಕವರುಶೆ ೧೧೦೮ ನೇಯದುಮುಭಿರಕ್ತತ್ವರದವಿನಾಜುಖುದ್ದಶಮಿಯೋಹುನಾರಂಶಿತ್ಮೇಕಾಲದೋ

ಅಪೇರು ತಾಲೂಕು
61 ರನೈ್ಸೇದೈ ನಂದಾಪೀಡೆಯಗೊಂಭೋಗರಂಗಭೋಗಪಂಡುಖ್ಯೆ ಟಟಬೆಳೇಗೋವಧೆ ರಕಮವತಿಕಿತಪೋಥಾನರಾಹಾರದಾ
ನಕಂಹಾ
62 ಗಿಳಿತೇತರಸಿಪಂಡಿತರಸಿಪ್ನನಿಶ್ರೆ _ ಸಂಧಿತಸುನಿಕ್ರ ಸಂಡಿತರಸಮ್ಮಳಿಕಾಜ್ಞೆ=ನಮಿಸೀತರಕಾಲಂಚಕ್ಮಿ_ ೧ಾಧಾರಾ
63 ಪ್ರವೋತ್ಕಾಂವಮಾದಿಬೆಟ್ಟದ್ಯೆ ದೇವದಮುದಾನೀಕೇಳ್ಕಣಿಯಕೇಗಿದ್ದೆನ್ಯ ಸ ೬ ಅಕೆಯಯಕೇಗಳೈ ಇಬೆಟ್ಟದೃಲುಕ್ಕೇಂ
64 ಊರತಮುಂದಾನಪದಳಕೆಯೊ . ೨ ಆದಿಯ್ಕೀಜಿನಿಸೇಕೆ . ದೇವನಹಳೇಕೆಯೊಂ ೨೦೦ ತೊಟೇದಉಪ್ರತ್ಸೈಕ್ . ದೇಕುಇವ
65 ರ ೧ ಚಿಕ್ಕಚಿದಿಲೆಯಲುಗದ್ದೇ ಕೆಯೊ ೧೦ ಮತ್ತಂಸೋವಣೀಮಕಾಲಂಕಬ್ದಿ_ _ ೧ಾಧಾರಾಪ್ರಮುಸ್ಮಕವಮಾಡಿ ಕೊಟ್ಬದತೃ
66 ಹಿಮ್ಮುಕಣೀಟೆಯಲು . ಲಗದ್ದೇ ಸಿ ೧ ಕೊಂ
67 ಗಾಂ . ತ್ರಿಮೂಕೇಟೆಯಕೋಡಿಯಬೆಟ್ಟವೆಮತ್ವ _ ೧ ಹಿಮ್ಮೂ_ಕೇಟೆಯಕೋಡಿಯಲುಬೆಟ್ಟದಳೇ ಕೆಯೊ ೨೦೦ ಕೊಳ್ಳೇಣಗಳುಯಿಬೆ
68 ಟ್ಟದಳೇಕೆ ೨೦೦ ಹೊಂಬನಳ್ಯುಷ . ಲಬೆಟ್ಟದಳೇಕೆ ೧೦೦ ಕ . ಕಟ್ತಮಗ್ಗದೇ ಕೋ . ಲಗೆೊಂದನಕೇಟೆಯಲುಕೋ .
69 ರಯು . ನವ . . . ಗದ್ದೇಕೆಯೊ ೧೦ _ ರಾಜಾಧ್ಯಕ್ಷನಹೆಗೆ ದೇವಕಾಣ್ _ ೧_ಸಕವರು . ೧೦೦೦ಹೇಮುಅಣಿವಂವತೃಸರಸಾವೀ
70 ವಾಣುರುದ್ರತೃಯೋದಸಿಸೋಮವಾರದಮಾವೆ ಶ್ರೇಅದಿಶೇವರಕೆಯಾಂತೃಕೈ_ವಣಿಸೀಕೊಬೆಪ್ಪಟ್ಟಿಗೆ . ೦ ಅಡನ್ನಿ
71 ೧ ಪರಿ
72 ರ್ಮಾಣ ೧ ಹೆಗ್ಗತಿತಿ . ಜೇಪ್ಪೆವಾಧ್ಯಕೊಟೆಯನು . . ದೇವೀಗೆ ೧ ಆರತಿಗೆ ೧ ಧೂಪಗುಂಡಿಕೆ . ೧ ಠಲಿಯಲ್ಲಿಕ್ಲೊಂದು
73 . . . . . ಪರವಾಮಾ . . . ಕೋ
(ಮುಂದೆ ೪ ಪಂಕ್ತಿಗಳು ಹೋಗಿವೆ)

Footnote
40. ಣಗುಣಾಭಿಷಣ . ಗ್ಗಡ . ನಂ . ದವಗ್ಗ . . ನಾ೦ಚಿತಾತ್ಮ=ಬಲನು ... ಕನೆಃ|| ರಣಕಾ就可以了 . . .

text.location: Tiptur taluk, Tumkur district
text.remarks:
Obeisance to S'ambhu &c, and to S'iva. Except different in form, in their real essence not
different, that god of gods who is the three gods with no difference, grant happiness and health.

    Subduing with his own army the great Dhâre, considered the root (mûla) of the Mâḷava
kingdom, making it over and thus increasing by his valour the conquests of the emperor, he lowered
from his door-frame the flag of his fame as conqueror of the regions, even as the lord of the day (the
sun) appears to sink down, -Ereyanga. To him and his wife were born three sons, -Ballâla, Vishṇu
and Udayâditya. Chêra, cast away your enmity; Pândya, do not strive, Andhra, fly not to a hole
(randhra); Odda, give up the thought of peril (godda-mana); Mâḷava, expose not your body in
battle; you, Tiguḷa, move off (jagu!) ;-such are the proclamations heard of the heralds of the might
of the king Ballu.

    First taking into his arms the Lakshmi of the Hoysala kingdom which was his inheritance, as
the power of his valour increased he imposed his commands on the kings at all points of the compass,
and capturing Talakâdu, became the first to the Ganga kingdom, -the promoter of the Yadu-vams'a,
the king Vishnu. His farther praises. To him and his wife was born the king Narasimha; to
whom and his crowned queen was born the king Ballu. When he mounted his horse for an expedition
of victory, Kalinga went away to live in the woods; Tuḷuva, ruining his honour, fled; Konkaṇa
suddenly packed up for the sacred desert; Gûrjara trembled; Mâḷava gained the thickets of the
Vindhya mountains; Chôḷika spent his time on the sea-shore.

    Be it well. When, (with usual titles), nissanka-pratâpa Hoysala vira-Ballâla-Dêva, putting
down the evil and upholding the good throughout the whole world, was in the residence of Dôra-
samudra, ruling the kingdom of the earth in peace and wisdom :-

    A dweller at his lotus feet,-Having gained the highest renown (? in the service of) Narasimha,
was Erega-chamûpa. Description of his exploits, in which Pâṇḍya is mentioned. Praise of Nâki-
Râja or Hulleya-Nâka. The king Vishnu gave him the Honnavalli Twelve. His wife was Sôvala-
Devi, and they had the sons Bikkeya and Dêmeya. Praise of heggade Ghaṭṭiga's valour in the battle
field, the mantri Ghaṭṭi, a light to the Anûta-kula. Description of the attractions of Honnavalli.

    Be it well. (With various epithets), a successful judge, worshipper of the feet of the god Kali,
sâmanta-gasani, Hulleya-Nâyaka-Chaundi-Seṭṭi and others (named) being present, -(on the date
specified), for the offerings to the god Kali, the perpetual lamp, decorations, temple repairs, gifts
of food to the head of the matha and ascetics, washing the feet of Amitarâsi-paṇḍita's disciple
S'ivasakti-paṇḍita's disciple Mallikârjjuna-paṇḍita,-made grants of land (specified).

68	Tiptur Taluq

Date ? 1237 A.D.
The royal inspector heggade Nâkaṇṇa, (on the date specified), made for the same god a grant
of a silk cloth, a tripod stand, and a metal tray. And the heggaditi.. chavve gave lamps, a censer,
a water vessel ... *(rest effaced).*

||ಕಟ್ಟದಿರಲೊಲಂತ ಸುಭಟತನಿಚ್ಚಿ ಲುಮಮುದುಮದುತುದಿಕೆಳಮನಿಧುವಪ್ಯುಟ್ಟವರ50ವರಮ್ಮ್ಯಾಗಂಗಿನೆಚ್ಚಿ ನೆತಲಿ ಕೆಸನಬಿಕ್ಕಿಯಂಜೆಮೇಯನುಂ ! ... ಧರಿಬಳಸನಹೋಕಿತೋತತಿಯಿ ದೆವೋಗಿಬಿಕೋಯನುನಟಿಸುಂ51ಳಿದಾದಲukinದೊಂದುತ್ರಿ ರಮತ್ಸುನವಿಂದಮದ್ವೇಷಭೂಮಿಯಂ || ಅರಿಬಳಮೊಂಬಜೆಟ್ಟಿರೋವಿಂ ದಿನತಂಡೆಮನೆಚ್ಚು ಮುಟ್ಟುತಂಡು-54ರದೋಲೆಳಗಾಂತುನಿಂ . ದದೆಲೆಳ್ಳಿ ರನಿಸ್ವರ್ಗಿಯಾಗಿ . . ಯುಷ್ಯುತಂಪರಿಮುವಾಡುಮದನೋಲಹೆಗ್ಗದನಪ್ಪೆಗಣಜೀರಂಗದೋಲು55 . . . ಗಂಡಗುಣವಮುೇಯುದೋರೆರಂಗಂಭೂಮಿಯೊಳು || ಪಮಲಿನನೊದುಕೀರ್ತಿ=ಧರಣೊಂದಮದಯಾಪರನೊಂದವುಣ್ಣೆಸ್ನ56ಸದದದೋದೊಂದೋತನೆಸೆಮಂತ್ರದೊಂತತದಿ . ನಂ ಜುಡುಪದಚಲಿಕೆವೆತ್ತೆ ... ನಿಧಿಯಮಸಲೀವೆದೆಯೋಮತೃವೆಟ್ಟೆಯಂ57ಅನುಪಮತೇಜ್ಞಜನಮದನರೂಪನನೂತಕುಲಪ್ರಧೀಪನಂ || ನೋಡುವಕಣ್ಣಿಗಳಗಂ ತಣೇಪುನಗ್ದವನಗೆೋಜಿಕಾತಕಾ೦ಗುಕೋಣದೌಡು58ವದೇೆಮಭಿೋಗಳಪುಲಸುಂತಿಯಿಂಡುಲೋಲ್ಯುದಾಡಿತೋಗಾಡವತೋಗುಂತಗಡಿಗಡಿಸಿಬೆಳಿಸಿದ್ದಾಗುಂಗಧನಾಲೀನಾನಾಡಾಡಿಯುರೊ59ಅಡಿಯೋಗಳ್ಳಲವಲ್ಲೆಮುನೋಪ್ಪುಮಹೋನವಲ್ಯತಾಂ || ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟಗುಣಸಂವನ್ನನುನುದಿಂತಗೊಂದೋಂಗೋತೃಸವಿತೃ]ನುಂಪಾರಾಗನಾಳ60ತ್ರತೆತೃೆಪತವನಾಯ್ಯುಸ್ತ್ರನ್ನಾಕೋಪ್ಪು ವಕೀಕಲಿದೆಯೇವರಧಾರಾಧರಕರಪರಬಳನಾಧಿಕರಫ್ಫಣಾಮಂಗತಸಣಿಉಳ್ಳೆಯನಾಯಕನು61೧ಚೌಂಡಿಸಿಟ್ಟೆಯು . . ಸೆಟ್ಟಿಯುೕಕರನಾಯಕ . . ಸೆಟ್ಟಿಯೋಲಗದನಸ್ಮಪ್ರವೇಗಾವೂಡಾಗಲುಮಿಡ್ಡುಚಾಳುಕ್ಯಕವಿಕ್ರಮ62ಕಾಲದಸಕವರುಶೆ ೧೧೦೮ ನೇಯದುಮುಭಿರಕ್ತತ್ವರದವಿನಾಜುಖುದ್ದಶಮಿಯೋಹುನಾರಂಶಿತ್ಮೇಕಾಲದೋಅಪೇರು ತಾಲೂಕು61 ರನೈ್ಸೇದೈ ನಂದಾಪೀಡೆಯಗೊಂಭೋಗರಂಗಭೋಗಪಂಡುಖ್ಯೆ ಟಟಬೆಳೇಗೋವಧೆ ಇಬೆಟ್ಟದೃಲುಕ್ಕೇಂ64 ಊರತಮುಂದಾನಪದಳಕೆಯೊ . ೨ ಆದಿಯ್ಕೀಜಿನಿಸೇಕೆ . ದೇವನಹಳೇಕೆಯೊಂ ೨೦೦ ತೊಟೇದಉಪ್ರತ್ಸೈಕ್ . ದೇಕುಇವ65 ರ ೧ ಚಿಕ್ಕಚಿದಿಲೆಯಲುಗದ್ದೇ ಕೆಯೊ ೧೦ ಮತ್ತಂಸೋವಣೀಮಕಾಲಂಕಬ್ದಿ_ _ ೧ಾಧಾರಾಪ್ರಮುಸ್ಮಕವಮಾಡಿ ಕೊಟ್ಬದತೃ66 ಹಿಮ್ಮುಕಣೀಟೆಯಲು . ಲಗದ್ದೇ ಸಿ ೧ ಕೊಂ67 ಗಾಂ . ತ್ರಿಮೂಕೇಟೆಯಕೋಡಿಯಬೆಟ್ಟವೆಮತ್ವ _ ೧ ಹಿಮ್ಮೂ_ಕೇಟೆಯಕೋಡಿಯಲುಬೆಟ್ಟದಳೇ ಕೆಯೊ ೨೦೦ ಕೊಳ್ಳೇಣಗಳುಯಿಬೆ68 ಟ್ಟದಳೇಕೆ ೨೦೦ ಹೊಂಬನಳ್ಯುಷ . ಲಬೆಟ್ಟದಳೇಕೆ ೧೦೦ ಕ . ಕಟ್ತಮಗ್ಗದೇ ಕೋ . ರ್ಮಾಣ ೧ ಹೆಗ್ಗತಿತಿ . ಜೇಪ್ಪೆವಾಧ್ಯಕೊಟೆಯನು . . ದೇವೀಗೆ ೧ ಆರತಿಗೆ ೧ ಧೂಪಗುಂಡಿಕೆ . ೧ ಠಲಿಯಲ್ಲಿಕ್ಲೊಂದು73 . . . . . ಪರವಾಮಾ . . . ಕೋ(ಮುಂದೆ ೪ ಪಂಕ್ತಿಗಳು ಹೋಗಿವೆ)Footnote40. ಣಗುಣಾಭಿಷಣ . ಗ್ಗಡ . ನಂ . ದವಗ್ಗ . . cells.remarks: Obeisance to Gaṇâdhipati. Obeisance to S'ambhu &c. Be it well. (On the date specified), when the mahârâjâdhirâja râja-paramêsvara vira-pratâpa Sâdâsiva-Dêva-mahârâya was ruling the kingdom of the earth :—the mahâ-maṇḍalêsvara Râma- Râja ...... Râja-ayya... mahâ-arasu having granted it to us,—in order to gain the favour of Nârâ- ṇa,—in the Honnavalli-śime in the Hoysaṇa-nâḍ, the śime belonging to our office of Nâyak, we remit the marriage dues payable to our palace from each family. Imprecations.

Obeisance to Mahâdêva. (In the year specified), the Hâlukuraki Jeṭṭi Poṭtaya's son ........
fought with the robbers in ...... . and gained the world of gods.
text.text_original: ದಬ್ಬೀಗೆಟ್ಟದ ಹೋಬಳಿ ಬಿನಕನಕೆರೆ ಕ್ಯಾನಭೋಗೇದಾಸಪ್ಪನವರಲ್ಲಿದ್ದ ತಾಮ್ರಶಾಸನಟಿಪಟೂರು ತಾಲೂಕು5 ಉಲಂಜಿಪೋಧಮಃ | ಯುದ್ಧಂಪ್ರ್ಯಾ೦ಕುಂಗೇಮಿಭೂಮಿಹ6 ಸುಚಾವಕರ್ಮಣಿಪೇದಾದ್ಧನಿನೋ | ತೃತ್ಸಂಯುಕ್ತಮವರಹರಿರಿ7 ಕುಲಪತಿಸೇಪ್ರಾಂತೆಯಾವಹವಾರಃ | ತೇಏನಸಂತಿ8 ಭವಮಿತಸ್ಫುಲತಾನ್ಯಾನಿಯಿವಿಷ್ಟಾಂತ್ರಿಪ್ರಜಾಸಜ್ರೀವಂ9 ತೇ. . ವುಮಧುನಿವಾಹಸಸ್ಯನ್ಯನಮಸಿ . . ಧತ್ವೇಜೀ10 ವಯುತ್ತಿಜಲ್ಪಧನಸ್ಯಕ್ರಾಂತಸಂಹಲ್ಮದಯುತೃ11 ನ್ನಿ ದ್ಧಿಕುರುತೇಬೂಹೋಜತಿದವಿದ್ಯೇಷ್ಮಮೂರ್ತ್ಯಷ್ಟುಕಂ | ತ12 ತ್ರಾನ್ಮದನಬೋಧನ್ಮೈಕಸುಲಭನ್ಯಾಂತೀಕ್ಷವ್ಯಾಯ್ಮದ್ಯೋರೇಷ್ಮ13 ಪ್ರಾಜ್ಞಜ್ಯೋತ್ಛೌಷ್ಯಭುವದವರಾಧ ವ್ಯಯಶಸ್ನೇಸೋಮಾರ್ಕಸಂವಣಂ14 ಕಾಯ್ಮೋಃ | ತತ್ಸಸೂತ್ರಉನನ್ಯೋದೇರಾಜಾಯದudarಗೀನ್ಯ ಹೋಮಯಾ |15 ಉತ್ತರೋಲೈಸ್ಮ್ಯಪ್ರಾ೯ಣಂಶುಚೀತ್ಯಾಃಕುಲಗುರುವಿಧಿಷಃ | ತಸ್ಮಿ16 ನ್ಸಸಮುನ್ಯ ತೇವರ್ಮತೀಮಾಶೃಮಣೋವಿಪ್ರೇಷಧೂಪಃ || ವಿಶುದ್ಧಗುಣಾವ್ಯ17 ತೇಶ್ರೀಷೇಚಿರೇಸ್ತುಗಮೀರ್ಯೋ | ತನಾವದವಧ್ಯಾತವಾ18 ಸ್ಕನೂಜಷಿಬ್ರುಕ್ಯುಬೋಪಕ್ಷಿನ್ಯುಗತ್ಯಃಕಕಶ | ಯಸ್ಯೋದ್ಯೋದಯೆಪಾ19 ದಪಸವಹಸನವೀಹೇಕ್ಷ್ಯತೇಜೋಮೌಳೀಧ್ರಿಯುವ್ಯಂತೇ | ತ20 ನ್ನ್ಯಾಂದಂಬುಸಿದ್ಧೀಸುರದ್ಯುಮಣಿವಸ್ತ್ರನುವ್ರತಾವಿಕಶೇಷಾಂಗಸೇನಾ21 ಸಿತ್ರೇತಿಷ್ಟೆತ್ಯು ಪ್ರಣಿನವಿನುಶೋಕಗ್ಲತಿರಶಿಮಿನ |22 ೨. ಶೂನ್ಯಾಕಾಶಾದಿತ್ಯಪ್ರೀಮಮಹನಿನಶಾತಮುಸ್ಮಿದ್ರಮಧ್ಯಂಕ23 ಜಿರಪುಷ್ಪಸ್ಕೃತಿ ಕಳೂಪ ಭುಹರರಿಹರಸಿ . . .24 ನೇ ಪತ್ತದ ಮುಖಭಾಗ25 ತಸ್ಮಿ  ಜಾತಹೇರಿರುಹನ್ನೇಸ್ರುಬೌಭೂಪಣ್ಮರಿಭಾ26 ರ್ಗ್ಯಾಅತೋಂಕರಕ್ರೆದ್ದ್ಯದಿಜಅದ್ದ್ಯಾ ಯುರೇರಾಜ್ಯಲ27 ಕಕ್ಷ್ಯಾಂ | ೯37 ೧ಡಾವಿವರವ್ರನಾವನಸಿ | ಅ೦ಕೇತಸ್ತೃಮಹಿಷಮೂಳೆಯಸಿರಸ38 8 . . ಕೌಯೇಷ್ಯಕೇತಜೀವೇನಾಚೀಯೇರುಮುಕಸ್ಥ ನ್ಯಿಥ39 39 .. ಬ್ರಷ್ಟ ನಿಸ್ಟ್ಯೇನಭಃ | ಸೂರ್ಯಚಂದ್ರಮೃದುನೋ ಪತ್ರಾಪಯಶ40 ಣ್ಮನಾ . . ಸವವ್ಯಯಂತ, ತಾತಿಸಸವಮಂಗಲಮಮ್ಯ . .41 40 . . ಧೀಕೆಯುಪಾಲುಲೋಕೇದೇವೈ ಶಕಸಿದಾಥಿಸುಸವತ್ಪರ್ವಮಾ42 ನೀಕ್ಷ್ಯನಾಸಿತ್ಯೇಕಾದಶಚಂದಿವನಲೀಚಡಾತುಷಕರೇವತಾಂ o . .110 ಮಕ್ಕಳುದೇವಭಾಟರು | ಗೌತಮಗೋತ್ರದಹ111 ಣ್ಣಲಾಯನಸೂತ್ರದವೇದಮೂರ್ತಿಗಳಮಕ್ಕಳು112 ಕಾಳಣ್ಣಂಗಳು | ವಿಶ್ವಮಿತ್ರಗೋತ್ರದಪಕ್ಷಲಾಯನ113 ಅತ್ರೇಯಗೋತ್ರದಪಕ್ಷಲಾಯನಸೂತ್ರ119 ದನರಸಿಂಹಭಟರಮಕ್ಕಳುಹೊರವರು | ಆ120 ಶ್ರೇಯಸಗೋತ್ರದಳಶಲಾಯನಸೂತ್ರದಗುಮಣಗ121 ಳಮಕಳುಸೇಂಮಣ್ಣಂಗಳು | ವಾರಾಹಗೋತ್ರದಅಪ122 ಸ್ತಂಬಸೂತ್ರದಕಂಬಲದಕಿಣ್ಣಭಟರಮಕಳುದೇ123 ವಣಬಟರು | ಭಾರದ್ವಾಜಗೋತ್ರದಆಪಸ್ತಂಬ124 ಸೂತ್ರದಸಕಲವಿದ್ಯಾಚೆರ್ತವೃತ್ತಿಗಳುವ125 ರ ನೇ ಪತ್ರದ ಮುಂಭಾಗ126 ಕಳುಅಳಿನದವರು | ವತ್ಸಗೋತ್ರದಅಪಸ್ತಂ127 ಬಸೂತ್ರದನಜಂದಿಕಿಯಹರಿಯಪಂಗಲಮಕಳು128 ವಿಷ್ಣುಕೃಮಿವರು | ಸಾಲಂಕಾಯನಗೋತ್ರದಅಪ129 ಸ್ತಂಭಸೂತ್ರದಮಲಿಕವಿಮಿತರಮಕಳುನರಿ130 ಸಿಂಹಭಟರು | ಗಾದ್ಯಗೋತ್ರದಅಪಸ್ತಂಭಸೂತ್ರ131 ನರಸಿಂಹಶ್ರಿಶ್ರೀನಿವಾಸಭಟರು | ವಸಿಷ್ಟಗೋತ್ರ132 ದಆಪಸ್ತಂಭಸೂತ್ರದಹೊಮವಾಡಿಪೇಣಭಟರು133 ಮಕ್ಕಳುಪತ್ರೇಥ್ವರಭಟರು | ಅತ್ರೇಯಗೋತ್ರದ134 ದೇವ ಹಣ್ಣನಸೂತ್ರದದಕ್ಷಿಣಪಂಗಲಮಕಳುಲಂಗ135 ಣ್ಣಂಗಳು | ಅತ್ರೇಯಗೋತ್ರದದವಿಜ್ಞಾನಸೂತ್ರದಹ136 ರ್ಭಿಚಾರ್ಯ್ಯುನಿಲಾಸನದವೀಬ್ರಾಕರದೇಂವಮಕಳು137 ಶ್ರೀಧರಭಟರು | ಅತ್ರೇಯಗೋತ್ರದದವ ಹಣ್ಣನಸೂ138 ತ್ರದಶೇಷ ಹಳಬೆಟ್ಟದೇವಪಂಗಲಮಕಳುನರಾ139 ಯಣಭಟರು | ಕಾಶ್ಯಪಗೋತ್ರದದವ ಹಣ್ಣನಸೂತ್ರ140 ದಲಿಂಗಣ್ಣಂಗಲಮಕಳು ಅಣ್ಣಣ್ಭಟರು | ಪಾವದ141 ಗಣ್ಯವತ್ಸಗೋತ್ರದಅಪಸ್ತಂಭಸೂತ್ರದದಬಮಿಣ್ಣಂಗ142 ಳಮಕಳುಅಂಧಾನಿಗಳು | ಕೌತ್ಸಗೋತ್ರದಅ143 ಪಸ್ತಂಭಸೂತ್ರದ ಕಾವಣಣಂಗಲಮಕಳುಹರಿ144 ಣ್ಣಂಗಳು | ಶಂಡಿಲ್ಯಗೋತ್ರದಕತ್ಯಾಯನಸೂ145 ತ್ರದವ್ಯಂಯುಪಾಸಿಂಗಣ್ಣಂಗಲಮಕಳುಯೋಗಂತಿಪಟೂರು ತಾಲೂಕು144ಣ್ಣಂಗಲು | ಕುತ್ಸ್ಯಗೋತ್ರ ದಕತಾತ್ಯಾಯನಸೂತ್ರದ145ಅನಿಮನ್ಮು ಭಟ್ಟರಮಕಳ ವಸೀಹಪ್ಪೆ146ರು |8 ನೇ ಪತ್ರದ ಹಿಂಭಾಗ147ಕೌಂಡಿನ್ಯಗೋತ್ರ ದಕತಾತ್ಯಾಯನಸೂತ್ರದ148ದೈವಣಭಟ್ಟರಮಕಳಂಗಂಗಲು |149ಅಬ್ರಿಕಾನಮತುಕೋತ್ರ) ವನಮಾಪ್ಯನಿಂಶಭೂಸು150ಅಂಕ | ವನಲವಿಸೀಸವಾಸಸ್ಥಳೇಭಿಕ್ಷುಸ151ಮನ್ಯಿತನಿಧಿನಿಕ್ಷೇಪವಾಪಾನಸಿದ್ಧ152ಸಾದ್ಯಜಲಾನೃತಃ | ಅಕ್ಷಿಣಾಗಾಮಿನಿಹೀ153ತಶಶಾಲ್ಕಕಾರಾದಿ ರೂಂಟವತಿ | ಉತ್ಪನೋತ್ಪ154ನ್ನವನಮಾಪ್ಯನಿಂಶಪಂಜೆಚ ಸಂಯುಕ್ತಃ | ತ್ರಿಂಶ155ಪ್ಪತಿಭಿನೋಯೋಗವಾಗೋಗೇದಕ್ಷಿಣಾನ್ವಿತಃ156ರಾಜನ್ಮಹರಿಹರಣ್ಣಾಯಂವಿರಮವಾಚಕ್ಯ157ಸುನಿಧಿಂತಥಾಕಳವಿಸೀಪೇ ಚ್ಭ್ಯಾದಾನಂ158ಬಹ್ಯಾಹ್ಮಣಡಸ್ಸೆ ಜ್ಜೆ | ಶಿವನಿಷ್ಠಾ ಬ್ಬ್ಯಾಮನ್ಸಾದ್ರೈವ159ಹೇಯು ವರನಯುಪಿತಾರಾಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಃ | ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರಂವದ್ಧಾ ನಾ160ದವ್ಯನ್ವೆ ವೃತ್ರ್ಯಾತುಪ್ರವಾಪಸನ್ಮಹಂ | ತದ್ಯಾ ಕ್ರಮಕ್ಲ161ಪ್ಪವಾನ್ಯೆ ದಗ್ಧದ್ಧಿತಕೇನಸಂಮತಃ | ದತ್ತೈವ162ಕೃಪ್ಪ ಮಿವಿಲಂಭೂಸುರಾದ್ಯಕತಾರೀಹ163ಹೋರರಾಜಾ | ತಿಸೋ ವ್ಯತ್ಯತಿ ಶ್ರಿಯಪತಯೇದೀಪ್ತಿ164ತಶ್ವವಾಯುರಯುತ್ತಿ ಗೃಹೋಪ ಜ್ಞಾಕಂಡ್ಯೆ ಕೃಕಂ | ಪಾ165ದಾದ್ಯತ್ತಿ ಂಧಿಜಾಗೆ) ವ್ಯಕ್ಯಃ | ಸಂಮಾಪನೇಯಾಂದಧರ್ಮಸೇ166ತುನ್ಯಉಪಾತಾoಕಾಲೇಕಾಲೇಕಾಲೀಣಯೋ ರಜದ್ವಿಃ ಸರ್ವಾ೯167ನೇತಾನ್ಭಾವಿನಾಪಾರ್ಥಿವಾನಿ = ವೇಂದ್ರಾನನ ಭೂಯೋಭೂಯೋ168ಯಾಚತೇಕ್ಷೀರರಾಘವಧ |9 ನೇ ಪತ್ರದ ಮುಂಭಾಗ169ಏಕೈ ವಗಿನೀಲೋಷೋ ಸರ್ವೇಷಾಮೇವಭೂಭುಜಾಂ | ನಭೋೇ170ಜ್ಯ್ಕಾನಗರಕಾಗ್ರಾ) ಪ್ರವೃಪು ದತ್ತ್ವಾ ವಸುಂದರಾ | ಆಕ171ಲ್ಲೆಯುಕಕರಾಗ್ರೇ ಸಾಸಗೋಗಾಜೀವಪದಪ್ರದೌ | ಸ172ಕರೆಭೇಸೋ ಕರತಾತ್ಕಗಿಸಗೋಗಾಕೋಟಿಫಲಪ್ರದಃ | ಸ್ವ173ದತ್ತಾಂ ದ್ವಿಗುಣಾಂಡುಣ್ಯಂ ಪರದತ್ತಾನುಪಾಲನಂ | ಪ174ರದತ್ತಾಪಹಾರೇಣಸ್ವದತ್ತೋ ನಿಷ್ಪಲಂಭವೇತ್ | ಸ್ವ175ದತ್ತಾಂ ಪರದತ್ತಾಂ ವಾಹೋರೇತೇತಿ ವಸುಂಧರಾಂ | ಪ176ಷ್ಟಿ ವರ್ಷ ಸಹಸ್ರಾಣಿ ಸ್ವರ್ಗಮೋದಾಯತೇ ಕೃಮಿಃ |181 ದಾನಪಾಲನಯೋರ್ಮಧ್ಯೆದಾನಾಚ್ಛ್ರೇಯೋನುಪಾಲ182 ನಂ । ದಾನಾತ್ಸ್ವರ್ಗ್ಗಮವಾಪ್ನೋತಿಪಾಲನಾದಚ್ಯುತಂ183 ಪದಂ । ರಾಜಣ್ಯೋಹಾರಿಹರಸ್ಯಾನ್ಯಾಂಧರ್ಮಕಲ್ಪಮ184 ಹೀರುಹಃ । ಜೇಯಾಧಾಭೂಮಿಸೂಮೋಮಾಕ್ . . .185 ಷ್ಟಿಧಿಕಪ್ರದಃ । ಇದಂಹರಿಹರೇಣಾಸ್ಯನೋಶಾ186 ಸನೇಧರಣೋಬೂಜಾಂ । . . . . . ಲಿಖಿತಂವಿರೋಗಧಾ187 ಕ್ಷ್ಯಸಶಾಸನ ಶ್ರೀೀ ಶ್ರೀೀ ಶ್ರೀೀ ಶ್ರೀೀ ಶ್ರೀೀ ಶ್ರೀೀ• ಶ್ರೀವಿರೂಪಾಕ್ಷೀ* ಕನ್ನಡದರ್ಶನಲ್ಲಿ

cells.location: At Jôgihalli (Chikṇāyakanhalli hobli), on a stone in the Daļavāyimatha.
cells.king: vira-Râma-Dêva-Râya
cells.language: Sanskrit and Kannada
cells.remarks: Obeisance to S'ambhu &c. Be it well. (On the date specified), the rājâdhirâja râja-paramêsvara vira-pratâpa vira-Râma-Dêva-Râya, seated on the throne in Ghanagiri-nagara, was ruling the earth :—And Mudiyappa-Nâyaka was in the city called Chikkanâyakanahalli, in the Poysala-sîme to the west of Ghanagiri-nagara, ruling the kingdom ;—his powerful [general], a vira-Mahêsvara, Kanada Silapant dalavâyi, had a tank and garden made for the matha of the obtainer of the pure S'ivâchâra of good people, the mahâ-mahattu of heaven and earth, . . . . . . .
cells.text_roman:
namas tuṅga-&c. ||

1ನಮಸ್ಸುಂಗಿರಿತೇಸ್ಕಂಬೆಜೊಂದ್ಚಾರಮಚಾರವೆ | ತ್ರೈಲೋಕ್ಯನಗರಾರಂಭಮೂಲಸ್ವಂಭೋಯುಖಂಭಣೆ |
2ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿಶ್ರೀಜಯಾಭ್ಯುದಯಶಾಲಿವಾಹನಶಕವರ್ಷ ೧೪೮೪
3ನೆಯದುಂದುಭಿಸಂವತ್ಸರದಮಾಘಬ ೧೪ ಲು ಶ್ರೀ
4ಮದ್ರಾಯಜಾಧಿರಾಜರಾಜಪರಮೇಶ್ವರಶ್ರೀವೀರಪ್ರತಾಪ
5ಶ್ರೀವೀರರಮಾದೇವರಾಯರುಗಣಗಿನಿನಗರದಲ್ಲಿ
6ಸಿಂಹಾಸನಾರೂಢರಾಗಿಪ್ಪು ಥ್ವಿನಿಯುವಾಲುತ್ರೆಯುಳುವನಗಿ
7ರಿನಗರಕ್ಕೆ ಪಶ್ಚಿಮಭಾಗದಲ್ಲಿಯಸ್ಪಳದಚೀಮೆ
8 . . . . ದ್ಧಾಂಧಾಚೀಕ್ಕನಾಯಕನಹಳ್ಳಿಯೊಂಬಪಟ್ಟೆ ತಾಳ್ದ್ಲಿಮುದಿ
9ಯಪ್ಪನಾಯಕಂದಂರಾಜವಜ್ಞವಾಳತ್ತಾಯಉಳರತಾಗೆ . . .
10ನ್ದದೋತ್ದಂದೇವದೇವೀರಮಹೇಶ್ವರದಕ್ಷನಾಥದೇವಲಂಪತದಳವಾಯಿ
11 . . . ಪ್ಪು . . ಮತ್ಮಕರೆತೂಂಟ್ಬುರಿಯ . . . ಮಾಡಿಪ್ರೀಸ್ರೀಮತ್ಸನಜನೆಕು
12ಧರ್ಮಚಾರಸಂಪನ್ನ ರಾಜದದೇವಾವಪೃಥ್ವಿಮಹಾ . . .

cells.remarks: Obeisance to Gaṇâdhipati. Obeisance to Yôganâtha, made manifest by Bharitaprakâsa. Obeisance to S'ambhu &c. He who established the lord who is the protection of the three worlds, and of the destruction of evil qualities, the seed-plot for the birth of all good fortune, in Prakâsapura, which he protects from day to day,—the celebrated guru Bharitaprakâsa designated as Sôma, may he protect you. From Sômêsa, the glory of kings, and Bijjala, was born the victorious vira-Narasimha. Chief of the Kalyâṇa king's elephant army was the famous Malyana. In his line was Nâcharasa, who, by Sômala, begat king [Nara]simha's minister, by the favour of the guru possessed of all wealth, Gôpâla, whose wife was Mâdhavi, of the Agastya-gôtra. Be it well. (With usual titles), the uprooter of the Magara kingdom, the setter up of the Chôla kingdom, the supporter of the Pândya kingdom,—the nissauka-pratâpa-chakravartti Hoysala bhujabala vira-Narasimha-Dêvarasa, (on the date specified),—in order that Seṭṭiyakere in the Âsandi-nâḍ, with all its hamlets, and all the rents and taxes (specified) payable from it, amounting to 35 gadyâṇa 7 paṇa,—and adjoining to this Seṭṭiyakere, Hosagere, a hamlet of Huliya ṇa in Âsandi-nâd, with all the rents and taxes (specified) payable according to the rate in Huliyara, amounting to 5 gadyâṇa 7 paṇa 1 hâga e bêle,—these two places, with their hamlets and all the rents and taxes (specified), amounting to 41 gadyâṇa 4 paṇa 1 hâga 1 bêle payable from them to the palace,—should be formed into an agrahâra, bestowed it upon the great minister Gôpâla-dannâyaka born of Sômala-Dêvî by his beloved minister (*tamma priya-pradhânar*) Nâcharasa, of the Agastya-gôtra. And Gôpâla-dannâyaka, in the same manner, giving to that Hosagere and to Seṭṭiyakere with its hamlets the name of Bharitaprakâsapura, and dividing it into 47 shares, bestowed 36 upon chief Brahmans of various gôtras. Of the remaining 11 shares, he gave 1 share as the khaṇḍika-vṛitti, to which the Brahmans added 4 kandugas of rice-land and 400 of dry field, for ? tolls and loads. And this khaṇḍika-vṛitti Gôpâla-dannâyaka himself took charge of, with the income from which to himself carry on the work of merit without interruption. text.location: At S'eṭṭikere (S’eṭṭikere hobli), on a stone in the Yôga-Māthava temple.
text.remarks:
Obeisance to Gaṇâdhipati. Obeisance to Yôganâtha, made manifest by Bharitaprakâsa. Obeisance to S'ambhu &c. He who established the lord who is the protection of the three worlds, and of the destruction of evil qualities, the seed-plot for the birth of all good fortune, in Prakâsapura, which he protects from day to day,—the celebrated guru Bharitaprakâsa designated as Sôma, may he protect you.

From Sômêsa, the glory of kings, and Bijjala, was born the victorious vira-Narasimha. Chief of the Kalyâṇa king's elephant army was the famous Malyana. In his line was Nâcharasa, who, by Sômala, begat king [Nara]simha's minister, by the favour of the guru possessed of all wealth, Gôpâla, whose wife was Mâdhavi, of the Agastya-gôtra.

Be it well. (With usual titles), the uprooter of the Magara kingdom, the setter up of the Chôla kingdom, the supporter of the Pândya kingdom,—the nissauka-pratâpa-chakravartti Hoysala bhujabala vira-Narasimha-Dêvarasa, (on the date specified),—in order that Seṭṭiyakere in the Âsandi-nâḍ, with all its hamlets, and all the rents and taxes (specified) payable from it, amounting to 35 gadyâṇa 7 paṇa,—and adjoining to this Seṭṭiyakere, Hosagere, a hamlet of Huliya ṇa in Âsandi-nâd, with all the rents and taxes (specified) payable according to the rate in Huliyara, amounting to 5 gadyâṇa 7 paṇa 1 hâga e bêle,—these two places, with their hamlets and all the rents and taxes (specified), amounting to 41 gadyâṇa 4 paṇa 1 hâga 1 bêle payable from them to the palace,—should be formed into an agrahâra, bestowed it upon the great minister Gôpâla-dannâyaka born of Sômala-Dêvî by his beloved minister (*tamma priya-pradhânar*) Nâcharasa, of the Agastya-gôtra.

And Gôpâla-dannâyaka, in the same manner, giving to that Hosagere and to Seṭṭiyakere with its hamlets the name of Bharitaprakâsapura, and dividing it into 47 shares, bestowed 36 upon chief Brahmans of various gôtras. Of the remaining 11 shares, he gave 1 share as the khaṇḍika-vṛitti, to which the Brahmans added 4 kandugas of rice-land and 400 of dry field, for ? tolls and loads. And this khaṇḍika-vṛitti Gôpâla-dannâyaka himself took charge of, with the income from which to himself carry on the work of merit without interruption. The remaining 10 shares he gave for the offerings and all the decorations of the god Yôganâtha he set up in

పురిగురుం౶వరుగరుతూ౶గలు౶మోదలవగద్దెవళియభూమియబితువృష్టింపూంవ్య్ని౶64 మంఠరభూమియగద్దె౶గలిబత్తువష్ట్యదిం౶అలదదనికి . యుదవకెశజణె౶ఆలుబృందిగీవు౶కేశ్ళ౶గళమేల౶ంక్ణఅనెపదదల౶కల్కొసంగలిగ్రీవు౶ నీలవాలిశక౶తంశగళ65 జీవవాల్కనురశఱణాలిశ౶నపాఒనికిన౶తివెల్లవక్కేప్రూహెత్య్వవహూనింగిఅశెకిజకుశరరణారెత్రెంట౶లుమోదలలోదగద్ది౶గట్టిన్భుమియశంకుబఅలియుబలహవస్ప్రి66 యును౶తి౶మంఠరపనామయక౶రంగొండుగళ౶దెవానవనరుగళొబ౶ప్త పురిగొరహడికముపittu_ట్టెయవారుశవమరిమాదెయలుఅజింద్య్రాక్ష్యన్యాదియా67 గినదనుసము ! శ్రియోజోగనాధ్నెసమ్యతపదిశెనలదవులశశిశెకాక్యంగంగుముఖ్యవాదఎల్లాధవ్య్ం గంగలణఅశిక్షషమహాజనుగళుఅందమునదెవనూ సవ్వె68 దసొనపజొనెవందొంపులరియు అనుసాసినివనాదవెళితుందవక్ష్య్౶న్యాఇయురగిసదెసువరు । అదెవరతడైత్రెపితె౶వెపలదపంజెత్ళ్వంవ్యంగలళ్మిమహాజనుగళుకొణతైయు69 దెడెకొణదెవనరు । అదెవరతెల్లిపురజానెనియోగెణ్ణిమహాజనగళకిధావగండ్గ్యగద్ది౶ఇనూలుబిడ్డలమభొగీసి౶ణదెవరబ్బిగ్గెసెనల్య్వుపరిగూపరాణవహేళువ70 రుపహొద్ధత్తెఱగన్నిప్రి cells.remarks: 70 Chiknayakanhalli Taluq Seṭṭiyakere. And having made the Brahmans who held the 37 shares consent to defray for ever the fixed rent and other dues (specified), whatever they might be, on those 10 shares, Gôpāla-daṇṇāyaka made them over to the god Yôganātha. From those 10 shares—for the daily offerings of the gods Yôganātha, Lakshmī-Nārāyaṇa, Gôpāla, Vighnēśvara, and the goddess Durggā, and for the livelihood of the nambis who perform service to those gods, 6 gadyaṇa,—for the livelihood of the decorators (or dancing girls), 6 gadyaṇa,— for that of the attendants, 4 gadyaṇa,—for that of the cooks, 4 gadyaṇa,—for that of the water-carrier servants, 2 gadyaṇa,—thus for these 5 classes of officials, 22 gadyaṇa :—for 2 drummers, 1 body-guard to protect from injury, 1 garland-maker, and 1 outsider (or sweeper),— for the livelihood of these 5 officials, or with another garland-maker, 6,—22 gadyaṇa :—for the livelihood of Bharitēya-daṇṇāyaka, in the two offices of manager and treasurer, 40 gadyaṇa,—for that of Singēya-daṇṇāyaka, in the two offices of sēnabôva and inspector, 40 gadyaṇa,—for that of Gôpāla-daṇṇāyaka's daughter Bāyakka, in the two offices of care of all the god's gardens and lands, and of the granary, 20 gadyaṇa :—for that of the preparer of milk and rice, cooked food and pig- ments, 2 gadyaṇa,—for that of the three, the oilmonger, potter and washerman, 2 gadyaṇa,—for that of the Vaishnavas, 3 gadyaṇa ;—for the livelihood of all these and the expense of sandal, camphor, incense and all other articles needed for the ceremonies, the produce and all returns from 8 vrittis are assigned. For the expense of the feast given once a year by Gôpāla-daṇṇāyaka in honour of the lord Bharitaprakāśa Yōgēśvara, the produce and all returns from 1 vritti are assigned. For the upkeep of the temple and all other buildings, for bricks, plaster, ? stopping up cracks, fort angles, and all such work, for the expense of planting the god's gardens, the livelihood of the gardeners, and for ornaments for the god,—for all this, the produce and all returns from 1 vritti are assigned.—According to these regulations will be expended the income and all returns from the god's 10 shares. And the Brahmans made a grant of lands (specified) for the gardens of the god Yôganātha. All the grain from the old town of the hamlet of Seṭṭiyakere, and the dues from the fair belong to the god. And the Brahmans assigned lands (specified) for the expense of an annual feast as above. And they gave to Gôpāla-daṇṇāyaka lands (specified) as a prīti-godagi, and also lands (specified) as a koḍagi to him and to Bharitēya-daṇṇāyaka and Singēya-daṇṇāyaka. Further directions to the Brahmans to keep up the various tanks and lands, and to maintain the services without interruption. And they assigned land (specified) for the duty of reading the purāṇa before the god for 4 ghalige in the evening, for repeating the śruti in the aghnishthage matha for 4 ghalige in the morning, and for hearing the (lessons of the) children without fail during the remainder of the day. Also a grant of land was made for a Brahman to remain in the town and perform the duties of astrologer. (On the date specified), in the same reign as above and by the same person a grant was made by the guild of Banajigas or merchants, (dignified as usual with numerous high sounding epithets). The particulars are effaced. Date 1573 A.D. May it be prosperous. Obeisance to S'ambhu &c. Be it well. (On the date specified), when the mahârâjâdhirâja râja-paramêśvara vîra-pratâpa S'rî-Ranga-Dêva-Râya-mahârâya, seated on the jewel throne in the city of Penuguṇḍe, was ruling the kingdom of the earth in peace and wisdom :- The mahâ-maṇḍalêśvara Srîpati-Râja Vallabha-Râjayya-Dêva-mahâ-arasu granted to the five classes of artificers included in the Pañchâlas of the Bûdihâla-śîme a śâsana as follows:-The tax on bench or anvil (ade) payable by you in the Bûdihâla-śîme belonging to our office of Amara-Nâyaka, we remit to you, in order that merit may accrue to our father Ranga-Râjayya. You, your sons and posterity, as long as sun and moon endure, may live in peace without paying any ade-vaṇa (the tax above mentioned). Imprecations. 72 Chiknâyakanhalli Talûq *Date* 1187 *A.D.* Obeisance to S'ambhu &c. The spray of the Ganges as it falls (from his head) appearing like a chaplet of pearls, the serpent twisted in peace in his top-knot,—that god grant us peace and wealth. As the lines of gods come to worship the feet of S'ankara, the rays from the jewels in his top-knot blaze out like a jewelled lamp,—that god of gods, may he grant as long as the world lasts, the de- sires of king Nṛisimha. To his crowned queen Êchale and to king Nârasimha was born the valiant Ballâla. When (with the titles of Vishnuvarddhana), Sanivâra-siddhi, Giridurggamalla, the nissanka-pratâpa Hoy- saḷa vira-Ballâla-Dêva was in the residence of Dôrasamudra, ruling the kingdom of the earth in peace and wisdom :— A dweller at his lotus feet,—(with various praises) was Balleya. His father was sâmanta-Bhîma, Chaṭṭiyakka his mother, Mâcha and sâmanta-Chaṭṭa his younger brothers, with sâmanta-Malla and Gôvi-Dêva. Talekâḍ he captured, he subdued Kongu lifting it up with all his limbs,—Vishnu,—and taking the heads of Chôḷa's chieftains, seized his territory. As soon as they saw the tiger on his flag, all the enemies fled. Bearing in her heart the lotus feet of Siva, doing all reverence to the mahantas, was Sôvala-Dêvi. Praises of Maralla-Dêvi, the wife of the lord Balleya,—Brahma having made this husband and wife to appear as if one. Chikka-Bôdihâḷ Mâchi-Gauḍa and Kêta-Gauḍa, washing the feet of Hâruva Mahadêvarasa, made a grant of land (specified) for the offerings to the god Dammêśvara, the decorations, and gifts of food. And for the same purpose, washing the feet of (with usual ascetic virtues) Huliyera Hiriya- Kriyâsakti-dêva's disciple Hâruva Mahadêvarasa's son Tippa-jiya, the maṇḍalika Hiriya-Balleyya- Nâyaka made a grant of land (specified). Some other grants by Gauḍas (named). (On the date specified), was this śâsana of the god Dammêśvara written. Imprecations. The sculptor Bammôja's son Suriyâchâri wrote (i. e. engraved) it. *Date* 1525 *A.D.* *(Nâgari characters).* The first part corresponds with Tiptur No. 1 above, down to line 50. By Tippâji and Nâgalâ-Dêvi he had the sons king Vîra-Nṛisimha and king Krishna-Râya. Vîra- Nârasimha, seated on the jewel throne in Vijayanagara, by his fame and policy put to shame Nriga, Naḷa, Nahusha and all other kings. As far as Sêtu and Sumêru, and from the eastern to the western mountains, he ruled the kingdom, winning the hearts of all. Many gifts did he make in Kanaka- sadasi, in the temple of Virûpâksha, in the city of the lord of Kâlahasti, in Venkaṭâdri, and Kânchî, in S'rîsaila, S'ôṇasâila, in the great Harihara, in Ahôbala, and Sangama, in S'rîranga, Kumba- ghôṇa, in the great Nandi- tîrtha, in Nivṛitti, in Gôkarṇa, and Râmasêtu, and many other sacred places. Fartlier praises, giving a long list of the names of gifts he made. Having for a long time ruled the earth, this great king departed to the Indra-lôka, on which, greater than him, the king Krishna-Râya bore up with ease the earth on his shoulder like a jewelled epaulette. His praises, mentioning the great gifts he made, and saying that in all the countries to Chiknayakanhalli Taluq which he made expeditions of victory he founded lofty temples of the gods andset up pillars of his fame so high that they arrested the progress of the sun. In Kânchi, Srîsaila, S'ônâchala, Kanaka- sabhâ, Venkatâdri, and many other temples and sacred places did he make the tulâ-purusha and other great gifts according to the śâstras. When (with usual and various titles) this great king,—whom the Anga, Vanga, Kalinga and other kings served, addressing him with such words as Look on us, great king! Victory! Long life!,—seated on the jewel throne in Vijayanagara, Krishna-Râya, surpassing by his policy Nṛiga and all other kings, and satisfying the desires of the needy from the eastern to the western moun- tains and from Himichala to Sêtu:-(on the date specified), in the presence of the god Virûpâksha on the bank of the Tungabhadrâ, he granted to (with praise of his learning and virtues) Lakshmî- dhara-bhaṭṭa, son of Krishna-bhaṭṭa, the new village of Lakumâpura, otherwise called Krishna-Dêva- mahârâya-samudram, (its boundaries), in the Bâdihâl-sîme belonging to the Magare-nâḍ-venthya, with all usual rights. And that proprietor, retaining for himself 6 shares, gave the remainder of the 30 shares to Brahmans. (Details of the donees and boundaries). This copper śâsana of the king Krishna-Râya was composed with soft words by Sabhâpati. And by the king's order Mallana's son, the carpenter Vîraṇâchârya, engraved it. Usual final verses. (signed, in Kannada)—śrî-Virûpâksha. Date ? 1172 A.D. Obeisance to S'ambhu &c. Be it well. (with various epithets, all effaced), his elder brother's rutting elephant, ...... His father was sâmanta-Bhîma, his mother Chhaṭṭiyakka, his younger brother Mâcha, ... Gôvi-Dêva his son ...... When sâmanta-Ballâla was in the residence of Puliyara, ruling the kingdom in peace and wisdom ;—a dweller at his lotus feet,-to China-gâvunda and Sugarve was born Mâdi gavuṇḍa (and so on for several generations). With all these sons, Mâdi-gavuṇda, for the god Suggêsvara of Nêrila- kere which he was ruling, (on the date specified),-washing the feet of, (with the usual ascetic virtues), the Magare-nâd râja-guru, Aṇuvaragê Jñânasakti-Amarachandrabhûshaṇa's son Guru- bhakta,-made grants of land (specified). Imprecation.

drummers, 1 body-guard to protect from injury, 1 garland-maker, and 1 outsider (or sweeper),—
for the livelihood of these 5 officials, or with another garland-maker, 6,—22 gadyaṇa :—for the
livelihood of Bharitēya-daṇṇāyaka, in the two offices of manager and treasurer, 40 gadyaṇa,—for
that of Singēya-daṇṇāyaka, in the two offices of sēnabôva and inspector, 40 gadyaṇa,—for that of

sires of king Nṛisimha.

(with the titles of Vishnuvarddhana), Sanivâra-siddhi, Giridurggamalla, the nissanka-pratâpa Hoy-
saḷa vira-Ballâla-Dêva was in the residence of Dôrasamudra, ruling the kingdom of the earth in
peace and wisdom :—
   A dweller at his lotus feet,—(with various praises) was Balleya. His father was sâmanta-Bhîma,
Chaṭṭiyakka his mother, Mâcha and sâmanta-Chaṭṭa his younger brothers, with sâmanta-Malla and
Gôvi-Dêva.
   Talekâḍ he captured, he subdued Kongu lifting it up with all his limbs,—Vishnu,—and taking
the heads of Chôḷa's chieftains, seized his territory. As soon as they saw the tiger on his flag, all
the enemies fled. Bearing in her heart the lotus feet of Siva, doing all reverence to the mahantas,
was Sôvala-Dêvi. Praises of Maralla-Dêvi, the wife of the lord Balleya,—Brahma having made this
husband and wife to appear as if one.
   Chikka-Bôdihâḷ Mâchi-Gauḍa and Kêta-Gauḍa, washing the feet of Hâruva Mahadêvarasa, made
a grant of land (specified) for the offerings to the god Dammêśvara, the decorations, and gifts of
food. And for the same purpose, washing the feet of (with usual ascetic virtues) Huliyera Hiriya-
Kriyâsakti-dêva's disciple Hâruva Mahadêvarasa's son Tippa-jiya, the maṇḍalika Hiriya-Balleyya-
Nâyaka made a grant of land (specified). Some other grants by Gauḍas (named).
   (On the date specified), was this śâsana of the god Dammêśvara written. Imprecations.
   The sculptor Bammôja's son Suriyâchâri wrote (i. e. engraved) it.

                                 *Date* 1525 *A.D.*
                              *(Nâgari characters).*

   The first part corresponds with Tiptur No. 1 above, down to line 50.
   By Tippâji and Nâgalâ-Dêvi he had the sons king Vîra-Nṛisimha and king Krishna-Râya. Vîra-
Nârasimha, seated on the jewel throne in Vijayanagara, by his fame and policy put to shame Nriga,
Naḷa, Nahusha and all other kings. As far as Sêtu and Sumêru, and from the eastern to the western
mountains, he ruled the kingdom, winning the hearts of all. Many gifts did he make in Kanaka-
sadasi, in the temple of Virûpâksha, in the city of the lord of Kâlahasti, in Venkaṭâdri, and Kânchî,
in S'rîsaila, S'ôṇasâila, in the great Harihara, in Ahôbala, and Sangama, in S'rîranga, Kumba-
ghôṇa, in the great Nandi- tîrtha, in Nivṛitti, in Gôkarṇa, and Râmasêtu, and many other sacred
places. Fartlier praises, giving a long list of the names of gifts he made.
   Having for a long time ruled the earth, this great king departed to the Indra-lôka, on which,
greater than him, the king Krishna-Râya bore up with ease the earth on his shoulder like a jewelled
epaulette. His praises, mentioning the great gifts he made, and saying that in all the countries to

Chiknayakanhalli Taluq
which he made expeditions of victory he founded lofty temples of the gods andset up pillars of his
fame so high that they arrested the progress of the sun. In Kânchi, Srîsaila, S'ônâchala, Kanaka-
sabhâ, Venkatâdri, and many other temples and sacred places did he make the tulâ-purusha and
other great gifts according to the śâstras.
When (with usual and various titles) this great king,—whom the Anga, Vanga, Kalinga and
other kings served, addressing him with such words as Look on us, great king! Victory! Long
life!,—seated on the jewel throne in Vijayanagara, Krishna-Râya, surpassing by his policy Nṛiga
and all other kings, and satisfying the desires of the needy from the eastern to the western moun-
tains and from Himichala to Sêtu:-(on the date specified), in the presence of the god Virûpâksha
on the bank of the Tungabhadrâ, he granted to (with praise of his learning and virtues) Lakshmî-
dhara-bhaṭṭa, son of Krishna-bhaṭṭa, the new village of Lakumâpura, otherwise called Krishna-Dêva-
mahârâya-samudram, (its boundaries), in the Bâdihâl-sîme belonging to the Magare-nâḍ-venthya,
with all usual rights.
And that proprietor, retaining for himself 6 shares, gave the remainder of the 30 shares to
Brahmans. (Details of the donees and boundaries).
This copper śâsana of the king Krishna-Râya was composed with soft words by Sabhâpati.
And by the king's order Mallana's son, the carpenter Vîraṇâchârya, engraved it.
Usual final verses.
(signed, in Kannada)—śrî-Virûpâksha.

Date ? 1172 A.D.

Obeisance to S'ambhu &c.
Be it well. When, (with usual Châlukya titles), Jaganêkamalla-Râya Permmâdi-Dêva was in
the residence of Kalyâṇa, ruling the kingdom of the earth in peace and wisdom :—
And, (with usual titles, all effaced), Vira-Ganga ...... was in the residence of Dôrasamudra,
ruling the kingdom in peace and wisdom ;—the sâmanta ...... (with various epithets, all effaced),
his elder brother's rutting elephant, ...... His father was sâmanta-Bhîma, his mother Chhaṭṭiyakka,
his younger brother Mâcha, ... Gôvi-Dêva his son ......

When sâmanta-Ballâla was in the residence of Puliyara, ruling the kingdom in peace and
wisdom ;—a dweller at his lotus feet,-to China-gâvunda and Sugarve was born Mâdi gavuṇḍa (and
so on for several generations). With all these sons, Mâdi-gavuṇda, for the god Suggêsvara of Nêrila-
kere which he was ruling, (on the date specified),-washing the feet of, (with the usual ascetic
virtues), the Magare-nâd râja-guru, Aṇuvaragê Jñânasakti-Amarachandrabhûshaṇa's son Guru-
bhakta,-made grants of land (specified). Imprecations.
Tikkarasa's son Sudra-dêva wrote it. The carpenter Mâdôja engraved it...............

Date ? 1137 A.D.

(On the date specified), when the mahâ-maṇḍalêsvara Tribhuvanamalla, the capturer of Tala-
kâdu, bhujabala Vira-Ganga Hoysala-Dêva was in the residence of Dôrasamudra in the Gangavâdi
96000, ruling the kingdom in peace and wisdom :-And the sâmanta Ghasapi Chaṭṭayya was ruling
the Haliyara-vṛitti in peace ;-Mayana Kêtana made a grant of land (specified) for the god Malli-
kârjjuna of Handarakere. Imprecation.

cells.remarks: 74 Chiknayakanhalli Taluq Date 1181 A.D. Obeisance to S'ambhu &c. overset{A}{Om}. Obeisance to S'iva. Be it well. When, (with usual Châlukya titles), Jagadēkamalla-Permmâdi was in the residence of Kalyâna, putting down the evil and upholding the good in the Seven-and-a-half-Lakh country, ruling the kingdom in peace and wisdom :— A dweller at his lotus feet,—Be it well. When, (with usual titles) the nissanka-pratâpa Hoysala Ballâla-Dēva was in the residence of Dôrasamudra, putting down the evil and upholding the good in the Gangavâdi Ninety-six Thousand, ruling the kingdom in peace and wisdom ;— A dweller at his lotus feet,—Be it well. Entitled to the band of five chief instruments, (with numerous epithets, including) supporter of the four samayas—Mahēsvara, Bauddha, Vaishnava, and Arhat ; his elder brother's rutting elephant ; the son of sâmanta-Bhima ;—with these and many other titles, was the mahâ-sâmanta Gôvi, whose descent was as follows ;—His father was sâmanta-Bhima, his mother Chațțiyakka, his younger brothers Mâcha, Chațța and sâmanta-Malla, his son Balla. When that sâmanta-Ballâla was in the residence of Huliyera, ruling the kingdom in peace and wisdom ;—A dweller at his lotus feet,—To Mayda-gauda and Dêkalle-gauḍi was born Bomma-gauḍa (and so on for several generations). Be it well. Bôchi-gâvuṇḍa and Mayda-gâvuṇḍa, for the offerings of the god Mallikârjjuna of Kaheganôḍu, the decorations, and gifts of food to ascetics, (on the date specified),—washing the feet of (with the usual ascetic virtues) Dêvēndra-paṇdita's disciple Rudrâsakti-paṇdita,—Bôchi-gâvuṇḍa made grants of land (specified), with an oil-mill and certain dues (specified) on loads. Imprecations. Gôvinda-jîya's writing. Date 1187 A.D. Obeisance to S'ambhu &c. overset{A}{Om}. Obeisance to S'iva. Be it well. When, (with usual Châlukya titles), Jagadēkamalla Permmâdi-Râya was in the residence of Kalyâna, putting down the evil and upholding the good in the Seven-and-a-half-Lakh country, ruling the kingdom in peace and wisdom ;— A dweller at his lotus feet,—Be it well. When, (with usual titles), the nissanka-pratâpa Hoysala Ballâla-Dēva was in the residance of Dôrasamudra, putting down the evil and upholding the good in the Gangavâdi Ninety-six Thousand, ruling the kingdom in peace and wisdom ;— A dweller at his lotus feet,—(with titles as in No. 13 above) was the mahâ-sâmanta-Gôviya, whose descent was as follows ; (as in No. 13). Be it well. When, entitled to the band of five chief instruments, the mahâ-maṇḍalika Balli-Dêvarasa was in the residence of Huliyera, putting down the evil and upholding the good, ruling the kingdom in peace and wisdom ;—His other half, the senior queen and crowned consort, (with praises), for the god Kali of Têkuravațți, the land that she ruled,— Be it well. (With various descent), worshipper of the feet of the senior queen Mârauvve-Dêvi, (with other epithets), Bamma-gâvuṇḍa, for the god Kali of Têkuravațți, (on the date specified),—washing the feet of (with the usual ascetic virtues) Sômēśvara-paṇdita's disciples Bamma-jîya and Kalyâṇasakti-paṇdita,—made grants of land (specified). Imprecations. Chiknayakanhalli Taluq Date 1384 A.D. (In the year specified), vira-Bukka-Râya's son, the Suratâla of Hindu Râyas, subjugator of hostile kings, Harihara-Râya's son vira-Bukka-Râya,-when the army went to the Oragal country, and the Turukas came and attacked Kottakoṇḍa,-the nâyakâchârya of that vira-Harihara-Râya's house, (with various epithets), Kâchi-Nâyaka's son Bâcheya-Nâyaka's son Kampana, when the Turuka horse mounted up on An .. ya,-Sâluva Kâya-Dêva's son, the maṇḍalika Sâluva (with numerous epithets) the ? shelter of the good in Talakâḍ the heroic land on the Kâvêri, terrifier of the Turuka army, Sâluva Râma-Dêva, fought and went to svargga. Date. Date 1194 A.D. Obeisance to S'ambhụ &c. Be it well. When, (with usual Châlukya titles), Jagadêkamalla-Râya Permmâḍi-Dêva was in the residence of Kalyâṇa, putting down the evil and upholding the good in the Seven-and-a-half- Lakh country, ruling the kingdom in peace and wisdom :- A dweller at his lotus feet,-Be it well. When, (with usual titles), nissanka-pratâpa Hoysana Ballâḷa-Dêva was in the residence of Dôrasamudra, putting down the evil and upholding the good in the Gangavâḍi Ninety-six Thousand, ruling the kingdom in peace and wisdom ;- A dweller at his lotus feet,-(with description) was Keleyabarasi. Their father sâmanta-Bhîma, Chatiyakka their mother; then follows mention of Mâcha, sâmanta-Chatiga and his younger brother sâmanta-Malla, Biṭṭi-Dêva Balla, Echaleya, Sôvala-Dêvî and the couple Mârala-Dêva and the lord Balleya. When sâmanta-Balleya-Nâyaka's son vira-Nârasinga-Dêva was in the residence of Huliyera, ruling the kingdom in peace and wisdom ;-A dweller at his lotus feet,- (in the year specified), naming it Chaudêśvara, Chuṇḍa-gauda and his four sons (named) made grants of land (specified) for the god. And for the perpetual lamp Tippa-jiya made a grant to Maluku- jiya's dīksha son Amitarâsi. Imprecations. Date ? 1215 A.D. (The first part is effaced). Be it well When, (with usual titles), nissanka-pratâpa Hoysana vira-Ballâḷa-Dêva was in the. residence of Dôrasamudra, ruling the kingdom of the earth in peace and wisdom :- A dweller at his lotus feet,-Balleya was born to Sriyâ-Dêvi and to the lord Gôvi-Dêva. The father sâmanta-Bhîma (and so on, as in No 16 above, down to Sôvala-Dêvî). Trampling on Chôḷa and Kaḷinga, beating and throwing down the Mâḷava army, destroying the army of Nepâla, plundering and driving away Pâṇḍya,-he slew all the braves that came to make battle, the king Balle. Far- ther praises of Balleya. Then follow a number of gauḍas, who, (in the year specified)¹, washing the feet of Bûdihâḷ Jinua-jiya and Kalam-jiya, granted lands (specified) for the god Kalli at the northern sluice of the Sâvidêvi tank. Imprecations. Date 1149 A.D. Obeisance to S'ambhụ &c. Be it well. When, (with usual Châlukya titles), Jagadêkamalla Permmâḍi-Dêva was ruling as far as the tusks of the elephants at the points of the compass :- The origîna has hyô emba sauvachara-perhaps meant for Yuva. 76 Chiknayakanhalli Taluq A dweller at his lotus feet,—Be it well. When, (with usual titles), bhujabala Vīra-Gaṅga Nārasiṅga-Hoysaḷa-Dēva, putting down the evil and upholding the good in the Gaṅgavādi Ninety-six Thousand, was ruling the kingdom in peace and wisdom ;— A dweller at his lotus feet,—Be it well. When, entitled to the band of five chief instruments, mahā-sāmanta, worshipper of the feet of Chāndrāyaṇa-munindra, obtainer of a boon from the goddess Padmāvatī, (with other epithets), the mahā-sāmanta Gōvi-Dēva, putting down the evil and upholding the good in the Magare-nāḍ Three Hundred, was ruling the kingdom in peace and wisdom ;— A dweller at his lotus feet,—Be it well,—was Taṇḍaga Mācharasa, whose descent was as foll- ows ;—Ruling as a king the Morasūr Thirty-six, he speedily captured the Kīruvanūr Twelve, Hōchaṇa, what champion in the world can stop his sword? His eldest son, (with praises), was Ēcha-bhū- pa. To Ēcharasa and Mārabarasi was born as their eldest son Mudda, whose younger brother was Dēkarasa Hearing that the cows had been carried off, Dēka went forth with haste and that mo- ment attacked the robbers. Description of the battle. Fighting and recovering the cows, Dēkarasa went to heaven. His eldest son, extolled as Bāṇa and Mayūra in the world, was Mācharasa, who erected Śiva temples. Being thus minded towards Śiva-dharmma, Mācharasa of Taṇḍaga, (on the date specified), washing the feet of Amritarāsi-dēva of the Taṇḍaga Mūlasthāna, made grants of land (specified). And setting up the gods Ēchēśvara and Muddēśvara, he made grants (specified) in the same manner for them. Imprecations. Date 1636 A.D. May it be prosperous. Obeisance to S'ambhu &c. Be it well. (On the date specified), when the rājādhirāja rāja-paramēśvara vīra-pratāpa Ven- kaṭapati-Dēva-mahārāya, seated on the throne in the city of Peṇugoṇḍe, was ruling the kingdom of the earth :—Of the ...... gōtra and Pāvala-sūtra, Sante-Bennūr Nichcha-Mada[vaniga] vīra- Hanumappa-Nāyaka, in the Garuga village in the Vibhūtipura-sime belonging to the Magara-nāḍ- veṇṭhe which Venkatesapati-Dēva-mahārāya had favoured to him for the office of Amara-Nāyaka, made a grant of lands (specified) for the god Salāsiva which the minister Kalasappayya had set up in Hanumasāgara. Usual final verses. Footnote 1.

cells.location: At Heggere (Būdihāḷu hobli), on a stone in the basti.
cells.dynasty: Hoysala
cells.king: Narasimha-Dêva
cells.language: Kannada and Sanskrit
cells.remarks: Having the supreme profound *syâd-vâda* as a fruit-bearing token, may it prevail, the doctrine of the lord of the three worlds, the Jina doctrine. Be it well with Varddhamâna. In the growing doctrine of Varddhamâna was Koṇḍakuṇḍa, who moved about four inches above the ground. Be it well. When, (with usual Châḷukya titles), Bhûvallabha-Râya-Permmâdi-Dêva was in the residence of Kalyâṇa, putting down the evil and upholding the good in the Seven-and-a-half-Lakh country, ruling the kingdom in peace and wisdom:— A dweller at his lotus feet,—causing *dhagad-dhagil-dhaṇḍhagil* in the cities of his enemies, *garilari-garilari* in the heads of the kings of hostile countries, *chimilchimi-chimilchimi* in the bowels of hostile kings,—who without trembling could fight with the Râja of the Male-râjas when the flame of his anger burst forth ? His son (with praises) was Vishnu-bhûpâlaka. Be it well. When, (with usual titles), the capturer of Talakâḍu, vira-bhujabaḷa Vishnuvarddhana- Hoysala's kingdom was extending on all sides, to continue as long as sun moon and stars;— His son (with praises) was Narasimha-bhûpa. A worshipper of whose feet, (with a great number of epithets, including) boon lord of Huliyera-pura, born from the milk ocean of the member of Śântala-Dêvi, the son of sâmanta-Chaṭṭa, making fruitful the desires of the sixteen supplicants,¹ all the members of his body excited to ecstasy by great poems filled with the nine sentiments and soft pleasing prose and verse, the sandal ornament on the sloping forehead of the disdainful Maleya woman, the musk ornament on the cheek of the Choḷa (woman), the cord round the loins of the Lâṭa woman, a wavy garland between the breasts of the Ândhra woman, a jewel bracelet to the Gurjjara woman, a bee kissing the lotus face of the dignified Gauḍa woman, a jewel mirror to the moon face of the ever praised and virtuous loving Karṇṇâṭa woman, *gêl-aṅka-tala-prahâri*, *doddanka-badiva*, his father's rutting elephant, Biṭṭi-Dêva-sâmanta, long may he live. Praises of his valour. To describe his descent:—*Sthira-gambhîra*, when through great misfortune Noḷamba's senior queen was taken cap- tive, having attacked the hostile band with speed and slain them with *taḷa-prahâra*, that king with gratitude gave him the name of Vira-taḷa-prahâri; by which when the world was celebrating him, he slew Doḍḍanka in Châḷukya Âhavamalla's camp (or capital) in sports, and was honoured with the title Doḍḍanka-baḍiva. To his son Âhavamalla and Honnavve was born sâmanta-Bhîma. A fierce lion to the elephant the vastly proud enemies, having brought pleasure to the mind of king Vishnu by rushing upon and killing Sitagara-gaṇḍa in his camp or (capital), he received from the king the title of Sitagara-gaṇḍa. Their father sâmanta Bhîma, their mother Chaṭṭiyakka, were Mâcha, sâmanta Chaṭṭa, sâmanta Malla, and Gôvî-dêva. Praises of the valour of sâmanta Chaṭṭa. His younger brother Gôvî-Dêva's fame was spread through all the world, and sâmanta Chaṭṭa's wife was ________________________ 78 Chiknayakanhalli Taluq Sântale (her praises). Having the eminent virtues and good character of Sthira-gambhîra, who was equal to her in giving support to the four samayas,—the Mahêśvarâgama, the Jina śrî-dharmma, the sad-Vaiṣṇavâśrita, and the Bauddhâgama, -say ? When the king Narasimha-Dêva was ruling, older than sâmanta-Gôvinda, Chattama his father, Sâtavve his mother, the lord Mâchi-Dêva his father's elder brother, his grandfather Bhîma,-who would not praise Vishnu-sâmanta ? To this the king Narasimha gave Hemegere for the expenses of the elphants. Be it well. The lay-disciple of Chandrâyana-dêva, of the śrî-Mûla-sangha Dêsiya-gaṇa Pustaka- gachchha and Koṇdakundânvaya, the mahâ-sâmanta Gôvi-Dêva, in memory of the departure (or death) of his wife Mahadêvi-Nâyakiti, had caused to be made the Chenna-Pârśva basadi of Heggere. For the eight kind of ceremonies at which, and gifts of food to the rishis,-washing the feet of Guna- chandra-siddhânta-dêva's disciple Mâlukanandi-siddhânta-dêva, -S'ântala-Dêvi's son sâmanta Biṭṭi- Dêva, for his own prosperity, (on the date specified), made grants of land (specified); with certain dues (specified) on loads of pepper, areca-nut and betel-leaf. And heggade Jakkana, in memory of his mother-in-law Mahadêvi-Nâyakiti, granted for the basadi, lands (specified). Imprecations. So as to be adorned with suitable words and abundant sentiments, this Jina śâsana was compos- ed by the celebrated Dêvabhadra-munipa. Pratses of Harihara-Dêvi.1 Be it well. The mahâ-sâmanta Ballayya-Nâyaka granted land (specified) as a sthaja-vṛtti for the basadi of Heggere. Footnote 1. *Shôdas*′ar, a class of famous S'aivas, Lingavanta's.—*Kittel's Dicty.*

text.location: At Heggere (Būdihāḷu hobli), on a stone in the basti.
text.remarks:
Having the supreme profound *syâd-vâda* as a fruit-bearing token, may it prevail, the doctrine
of the lord of the three worlds, the Jina doctrine. Be it well with Varddhamâna. In the growing
doctrine of Varddhamâna was Koṇḍakuṇḍa, who moved about four inches above the ground.
Be it well. When, (with usual Châḷukya titles), Bhûvallabha-Râya-Permmâdi-Dêva was in the
residence of Kalyâṇa, putting down the evil and upholding the good in the Seven-and-a-half-Lakh
country, ruling the kingdom in peace and wisdom:—
A dweller at his lotus feet,—causing *dhagad-dhagil-dhaṇḍhagil* in the cities of his enemies,
*garilari-garilari* in the heads of the kings of hostile countries, *chimilchimi-chimilchimi* in the bowels
of hostile kings,—who without trembling could fight with the Râja of the Male-râjas when the flame of
his anger burst forth ? His son (with praises) was Vishnu-bhûpâlaka.
Be it well. When, (with usual titles), the capturer of Talakâḍu, vira-bhujabaḷa Vishnuvarddhana-
Hoysala's kingdom was extending on all sides, to continue as long as sun moon and stars;—
His son (with praises) was Narasimha-bhûpa. A worshipper of whose feet, (with a great number of
epithets, including) boon lord of Huliyera-pura, born from the milk ocean of the member of Śântala-Dêvi,
the son of sâmanta-Chaṭṭa, making fruitful the desires of the sixteen supplicants,¹ all the members
of his body excited to ecstasy by great poems filled with the nine sentiments and soft pleasing prose
and verse, the sandal ornament on the sloping forehead of the disdainful Maleya woman, the musk
ornament on the cheek of the Choḷa (woman), the cord round the loins of the Lâṭa woman, a wavy
garland between the breasts of the Ândhra woman, a jewel bracelet to the Gurjjara woman, a bee
kissing the lotus face of the dignified Gauḍa woman, a jewel mirror to the moon face of the ever
praised and virtuous loving Karṇṇâṭa woman, *gêl-aṅka-tala-prahâri*, *doddanka-badiva*, his father's
rutting elephant, Biṭṭi-Dêva-sâmanta, long may he live. Praises of his valour. To describe his
descent:—*Sthira-gambhîra*, when through great misfortune Noḷamba's senior queen was taken cap-
tive, having attacked the hostile band with speed and slain them with *taḷa-prahâra*, that king with
gratitude gave him the name of Vira-taḷa-prahâri; by which when the world was celebrating him, he
slew Doḍḍanka in Châḷukya Âhavamalla's camp (or capital) in sports, and was honoured with the
title Doḍḍanka-baḍiva. To his son Âhavamalla and Honnavve was born sâmanta-Bhîma. A fierce
lion to the elephant the vastly proud enemies, having brought pleasure to the mind of king Vishnu
by rushing upon and killing Sitagara-gaṇḍa in his camp or (capital), he received from the king
the title of Sitagara-gaṇḍa. Their father sâmanta Bhîma, their mother Chaṭṭiyakka, were Mâcha,
sâmanta Chaṭṭa, sâmanta Malla, and Gôvî-dêva. Praises of the valour of sâmanta Chaṭṭa. His
younger brother Gôvî-Dêva's fame was spread through all the world, and sâmanta Chaṭṭa's wife was
________________________

78                          Chiknayakanhalli Taluq

Sântale (her praises). Having the eminent virtues and good character of Sthira-gambhîra, who was
equal to her in giving support to the four samayas,—the Mahêśvarâgama, the Jina śrî-dharmma,
the sad-Vaiṣṇavâśrita, and the Bauddhâgama, -say ? When the king Narasimha-Dêva was ruling,
older than sâmanta-Gôvinda, Chattama his father, Sâtavve his mother, the lord Mâchi-Dêva his
father's elder brother, his grandfather Bhîma,-who would not praise Vishnu-sâmanta ? To this
the king Narasimha gave Hemegere for the expenses of the elphants.

Be it well. The lay-disciple of Chandrâyana-dêva, of the śrî-Mûla-sangha Dêsiya-gaṇa Pustaka-
gachchha and Koṇdakundânvaya, the mahâ-sâmanta Gôvi-Dêva, in memory of the departure (or
death) of his wife Mahadêvi-Nâyakiti, had caused to be made the Chenna-Pârśva basadi of Heggere.
For the eight kind of ceremonies at which, and gifts of food to the rishis,-washing the feet of Guna-
chandra-siddhânta-dêva's disciple Mâlukanandi-siddhânta-dêva, -S'ântala-Dêvi's son sâmanta Biṭṭi-
Dêva, for his own prosperity, (on the date specified), made grants of land (specified); with certain
dues (specified) on loads of pepper, areca-nut and betel-leaf.

And heggade Jakkana, in memory of his mother-in-law Mahadêvi-Nâyakiti, granted for the
basadi, lands (specified). Imprecations.

So as to be adorned with suitable words and abundant sentiments, this Jina śâsana was compos-
ed by the celebrated Dêvabhadra-munipa.

Pratses of Harihara-Dêvi.1

Be it well. The mahâ-sâmanta Ballayya-Nâyaka granted land (specified) as a sthaja-vṛtti for
the basadi of Heggere.

Footnote
1. *Shôdas*′ar, a class of famous S'aivas, Lingavanta's.—*Kittel's Dicty.*

cells.remarks: May it be prosperous. Be it well. (On the date specified), the mahâ-maṇḍalêśvara S'ripati- Râja s son Râjayya-Dêva-mahâ-arasu's son Vallabharâja-Dêva-mahâ-arasu granted for the god Jina of the basti in the Bûdihâla-sime belonging to the Hoysala kingdom in Magara-nâḍ which he was ruling, in order to restore the mânya of the Heggere basti, a śâsana as follows ;-Gutti Haradare- Sûryya's son Chinna vara Gôyinda-Setti having made petition that the mânya of the god of the Heg- gere basti should be maintained,-in order to comply with his petition, and for our own prosperity, we grant the lands (specified) aggregating 15 kolaga of rice-land as a dêvadâya-mânya, with from this time forth the annual rotation of water at the time of crop. Such is the śâsana of a gift of land restoring the dêvadâya of the basti, granted by S'ripati-Râja's Vallabharâja-Dêva-mahâ-arasu. Imprecation. Also a grant of dry field (specified) in Heggere-sthala.

May it be prosperous. Be it well. (On the date specified), the mahâ-maṇḍalêśvara S'ripati-
Râja s son Râjayya-Dêva-mahâ-arasu's son Vallabharâja-Dêva-mahâ-arasu granted for the god Jina
of the basti in the Bûdihâla-sime belonging to the Hoysala kingdom in Magara-nâḍ which he was
ruling, in order to restore the mânya of the Heggere basti, a śâsana as follows ;-Gutti Haradare-
Sûryya's son Chinna vara Gôyinda-Setti having made petition that the mânya of the god of the Heg-
gere basti should be maintained,-in order to comply with his petition, and for our own prosperity,
we grant the lands (specified) aggregating 15 kolaga of rice-land as a dêvadâya-mânya, with from
this time forth the annual rotation of water at the time of crop. Such is the śâsana of a gift of land
restoring the dêvadâya of the basti, granted by S'ripati-Râja's Vallabharâja-Dêva-mahâ-arasu.
Imprecation.

Also a grant of dry field (specified) in Heggere-sthala.

cells.language: Kannada and Sanskrit
cells.remarks: Obeisance to Sâmbhu &c. Invocation of Sîva. May he protect the king Narasimha. Among those born as lords of Dvârâvati,—the Hoysaṇas, with the tiger crest, in Sasapura,—was Vinayâditya. (Omitting laudations) to him and to Keḷeyabbe was born Ereyanga. [To him was born Vishnu], and to Vishnu, Narasiṁha. To whom and to Êchale was born Ballâḷa. That vîra- Ballâḷa-Dêva's son,— Be it well. When, (with usual titles), the uprooter of the Magara kingdom, displacer of the Pâṇḍya kingdom, setter up of the Chôḷa kingdom, vîra-Nârasiṁha-Dêva was in the residence of Dôrasamudra, ruling the kingdom in peace and wisdom :— Dwellers at his lotus feet,—Be it well. The beloved of all fortune, Âhumalla-Nâyaka's eldest son sâmanta Bhîmeya-Nâyaka, the boon lord of Huḷiyâra-pura, sâmanta Chatteya Nâyaka's younger brother sâmanta-Gôvi-Dêva, sâmanta Chaṭṭeya-Nâyaka's eldest son Biṭṭeya-Nâyaka, Gôvi-Dêva- Nâyaka's son maṇḍalika Balleya-Nâyaka, long may they live. Balleya was born to Sîyâ-Dêvi and to Gôvi-Dêva. To Balleya-Nâyaka and to Sâvala-Dêvi was born Chikka Balleya-Nâyaka, long may he live. Be it well. When the mahâ-maṇḍalika, sitagara-gaṇḍa, Gôvi-Dêva-Nâyaka's younger brother Chaṭṭeya-Nâyaka's son, the mahâ-maṇḍalika, boon lord of Huḷiyâra-pura, (with various epithets) Kappayya-Nâyaka was in the residence of Huḷiyâra, ruling the kingdom in peace ;— 80 Chiknayakanhalli Taluq A dweller at his lotus feet,—Be it well. The mahâ-nâlpraphbu, the Huliyara heggade Nambiyya and others (named), all the farmers of the nâd, granted Sûjinahalli, three parts for the god Kali of Heggere and two parts for the god Galagêśvara, for the decorations and illuminations, perpetual lamp, offerings, *tâmbûla* and all ceremonies, (on the date specified),—Huliyara Kappeya-Nâyaka, washing the feet of Heggere Basavarâsi's .. *Îyga-jîya*'s son-in-law Kala-jîya's feet,—made over the grant. Îyga-jîya gave his share in Sûjinahalli to his *dêksha* son Timma-Seţţi in equal parts. Imprecation. Footnote 1. The is described as pancha-kalyāṇābhyudaya-Śaka-varsha.

Obeisance to Sâmbhu &c. Invocation of Sîva. May he protect the king Narasimha.
Among those born as lords of Dvârâvati,—the Hoysaṇas, with the tiger crest, in Sasapura,—was
Vinayâditya. (Omitting laudations) to him and to Keḷeyabbe was born Ereyanga. [To him was
born Vishnu], and to Vishnu, Narasiṁha. To whom and to Êchale was born Ballâḷa. That vîra-
Ballâḷa-Dêva's son,—
Be it well. When, (with usual titles), the uprooter of the Magara kingdom, displacer of the
Pâṇḍya kingdom, setter up of the Chôḷa kingdom, vîra-Nârasiṁha-Dêva was in the residence of
Dôrasamudra, ruling the kingdom in peace and wisdom :—

Dwellers at his lotus feet,—Be it well. The beloved of all fortune, Âhumalla-Nâyaka's eldest
son sâmanta Bhîmeya-Nâyaka, the boon lord of Huḷiyâra-pura, sâmanta Chatteya Nâyaka's younger
brother sâmanta-Gôvi-Dêva, sâmanta Chaṭṭeya-Nâyaka's eldest son Biṭṭeya-Nâyaka, Gôvi-Dêva-
Nâyaka's son maṇḍalika Balleya-Nâyaka, long may they live. Balleya was born to Sîyâ-Dêvi
and to Gôvi-Dêva. To Balleya-Nâyaka and to Sâvala-Dêvi was born Chikka Balleya-Nâyaka, long
may he live.
Be it well. When the mahâ-maṇḍalika, sitagara-gaṇḍa, Gôvi-Dêva-Nâyaka's younger brother
Chaṭṭeya-Nâyaka's son, the mahâ-maṇḍalika, boon lord of Huḷiyâra-pura, (with various epithets)
Kappayya-Nâyaka was in the residence of Huḷiyâra, ruling the kingdom in peace ;—

80                                       Chiknayakanhalli Taluq

    A dweller at his lotus feet,—Be it well. The mahâ-nâlpraphbu, the Huliyara heggade Nambiyya
and others (named), all the farmers of the nâd, granted Sûjinahalli, three parts for the god Kali of
Heggere and two parts for the god Galagêśvara, for the decorations and illuminations, perpetual
lamp, offerings, *tâmbûla* and all ceremonies, (on the date specified),—Huliyara Kappeya-Nâyaka,
washing the feet of Heggere Basavarâsi's .. *Îyga-jîya*'s son-in-law Kala-jîya's feet,—made over the
grant. Îyga-jîya gave his share in Sûjinahalli to his *dêksha* son Timma-Seţţi in equal parts.
    Imprecation.

1. The is described as pancha-kalyāṇābhyudaya-Śaka-varsha.
